jobs.excerpt: Our Mission Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.

Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across 200+ specialties and +12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power. In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.

We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.

Your Impact on our mission:

As a Specialist, Customer Experience at Zocdoc, you will embody our core values in all interactions, working diligently to deliver exceptional customer service to our provider accounts. You’ll be evaluated on your ability to upsell features and offer tailored solutions to our customers. You will play a vital role in fostering authentic connections, inspiring engagement, and ensuring that healthcare providers can easily access the benefits of Zocdoc's platform through calls, emails, and chat.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

  • Super-positive and empathetic: you see the best in people and know how to bring it out
  • A team player, who enjoys working in a highly collaborative (and extremely fun!) team environment
  • Passionate about bringing solutions to providers
  • Excited to learn new techniques and systems

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this mid-level development role, with 3-7 years of experience, the compensation range is $2,800 - $6,000 USD per month. This range is designed to reflect the skills, experience, and value brought to the team, ensuring competitive and fair pay within the industry.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer II who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As a Software Engineer II, you will be responsible for solving our most challenging problems along with a highly-motivated team.

In this role, you will work closely with other engineers across multiple teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative products. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include partnering with other engineers to design, develop, and deliver new features. As your skills grow so will the size and scope of the projects which you’ll be involved in. Sezzle has a strong culture for promotion with defined paths through Engineering that matches all levels. You’ll be working as part of a full-stack Engineering team which has varied disciplines.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and maintain new innovative product features focused on actively learning new areas of the product
  • Collaborate with owners for different product features to gain insight and offer constructive suggestions for improvements
  • Be an active participant in design/architecture discussions sharing your ideas while building the next generation of features for the Sezzle platform
  • Hands-on with our codebase and a contributor to code reviews
  • Mentor other engineers who are starting along their career path
  • Work with the team to continuously build and deploy scalable solutions
  • Assist in planning, estimations, and completion for projects brought up by the team stakeholders
  • Be on a on-call rotation to respond to production incident.

What We Look For:

  • Experience solving technical problems as part of a team
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Familiarity with modern Frontend Development, with React experience preferred
  • Ability to solve problems with backend-focused languages like Go or similar compiled statically typed language
  • Intermediate understanding of relational databases like MySQL

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Knowledgeable in writing automated tests for applications (unit, integration, end-to-end)
  • Familiar with the basic principles and design of RESTful APIs
  • Basic knowledge of a Microservice Architecture
  • Close familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.description:
About V2

V2 Strategic Advisors is where velocity meets voltage - a boutique management and technology consulting firm that has spent 20+ years transforming media and advertising sales organizations. We're the firm that global and high-growth organizations call when they need more than a strategy deck - they need results.

Our edge? We offer a rare blend of management consulting, data, analytics, AI, and systems integration - all under one roof, powered by best-in-class platforms including Salesforce, Databricks, Snowflake, HubSpot, and leading AI platforms like Claude and Gemini. We understand the nuances of our clients' most complex challenges and deliver solutions that move the needle.

We're a lean, elite team of consultants, technical architects, and data experts who operate with the rigor of global management consulting and systems integration consultancies and the energy and agility of a startup. We approach every day with a sense of purpose to deliver with excellence, grow our capabilities, and find fulfillment in what we do. If that sounds like your kind of environment, keep reading.

The Opportunity

We're scaling our internal operations to match our growing market footprint, and we need a sharp, hands-on Management & Technology Consulting Operations Manager to own it.

This isn't a support role. You'll be a proactive, hands-on partner to our VP of Operations and our IT Manager, driving V2's internal operations end-to-end. That means owning core business processes and reporting, leading vendor and system renewals and product evaluations, supporting internal audits and annual policy updates, and driving key technology initiatives from penetration testing to agentic workflow development, all with a true consulting mindset. You'll operate across strategy and execution, equally comfortable improving how the business runs day-to-day and configuring a system at a keyboard.

You’ll leverage your experience in management and/or technology consulting to help innovate and streamline V2’s consulting operations. If you thrive at the intersection of operations, technology, and security - and you can drive initiatives forward with minimal oversight and sound judgment - let's talk.

What You'll Own

    Business operations & process improvement. Own and continuously improve the internal processes that keep V2 running smoothly, from operational workflows and cross-team handoffs to reporting cadences and resourcing. Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the business, propose fixes, and drive them to completion. Support budget tracking and operational reporting that gives leadership visibility into how the firm is running.

    Program & project leadership. Own project plans, timelines, and status reporting for key Operations & IT initiatives, keeping the VP and IT Manager informed without needing to be asked. Coordinate cross-functional dependencies and vendors, including penetration testing firms and platform vendors, to keep initiatives on schedule and on budget.

    Security, risk & data governance. Manage the annual/ongoing penetration testing cycle: scoping, vendor coordination, and remediation tracking. Design and help implement a data retention policy across core systems, including Google Workspace, Salesforce, and Slack, balancing compliance, storage cost, and usability.

    Systems & AI-enabled workflows. Build and iterate on agentic and AI-assisted workflows — using platforms like Claude and Gemini — to automate manual operations and IT tasks. Administer and optimize core platforms including Salesforce, Okta, 1Password, CrowdStrike, Asana, and Google Workspace, identifying and closing configuration or license-utilization gaps.

    Strategic & advisory support. Bring an outside-in, consulting perspective to internal operations, flagging inefficiencies, proposing options, and recommending best practices rather than waiting to be told what to build. Partner directly with the VP of Operations and the IT Manager as a thought partner on tooling, process, and technology roadmap decisions.

    Vendor, systems & compliance lifecycle management. Own the renewal calendar for core software and vendor contracts, ensuring timely review, negotiation, and decision-making well ahead of renewal dates. Lead product evaluations for new tools and platforms, running structured assessments, requirements, vendor comparisons, cost-benefit analysis, and rollout recommendations, to ensure V2 invests in the right technology. Support internal system audits, coordinating with stakeholders to assess controls, close gaps, and document findings. Drive the annual refresh of IT policies, keeping V2's governance, security, and usage policies current with the evolving tech and risk landscape.

    Tactical operations & IT support. Provide day-to-day operational and IT support, access provisioning, ticket triage, and tool onboarding, to keep the team unblocked, without this becoming the majority of the role.

What You Bring

  • Consulting experience and orientation. You understand the nuances of operations in consulting organizations, including resource planning, timesheets & utilization, program budgeting & milestones oversight, project-management-related IT systems, consulting talent development strategies, and other areas. You bring structured thinking, options, and recommendations to the table, not just execution.

  • Operational rigor. You know how to design, document, and improve a process, and you have a track record of making a business run more smoothly, not just its tech stack.

  • Project management discipline. You're comfortable running multiple initiatives in parallel, with clear prioritization, planning, and on-time delivery.

  • Technical versatility. You can go deep enough into a platform to configure or troubleshoot it directly, not just talk about it in a slide.

  • Security and governance fluency. Working knowledge of IT security and compliance fundamentals, penetration testing coordination, access management, and data retention/governance policy. You don't need to be a security engineer, but you need to be conversant enough to manage vendors and translate findings into action.

  • Vendor and lifecycle management savvy. You can run a product evaluation from requirements to recommendations, proactively manage renewal timelines, and support audits and policy updates without letting anything slip through the cracks.

  • Sound judgment. You know when to escalate, when to decide, and when to flag risk, especially around security and data.

  • Clear communication. You translate technical detail into business language for leadership, and vice versa.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You thrive in a lean team where priorities shift, and role boundaries are fluid.

  • Startup DNA. You've operated in a small, fast-moving team where the same person may set strategy and execute it — and you loved it.

  • Hands-on platform experience. Experience configuring, administering, or optimizing enterprise SaaS platforms such as Salesforce, Okta, 1Password, CrowdStrike, Google Workspace, Gemini, Claude, or Asana is strongly preferred.

  • AI-driven workflow experience. Experience supporting or building AI-driven / agentic workflows is a strong plus.

  • 3–6+ years of experience in management and/or technology consulting operations.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

Why V2?

Because you won't find another firm doing exactly what we do, and you won't find another role like this one. You'll be close to the action, building something real, with people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. V2 was built on the idea that consulting could be done better. We're still proving it every day.

If you're ready to bring the voltage, we want to hear from you.

Job Title: Safeguarding Officer

Location: UK, Remote

Direct Reports: N/A

Key External Contacts/Relationships: Including but not limited to: donors, survivor support services in country, third parties, including community members, beneficiaries.

Job Purpose: To support the Global Safeguarding Lead (GSGL) to strengthen and embed safeguarding across all programmes and headquarters functions

About HALO:

HALO is the leading global NGO addressing the impact and drivers of conflict in 30 countries and territories, with over 8,000 staff. Most of our staff are local employees and include a growing number of women.

Our primary duty is to serve people affected by conflict, clearing landmines and the explosive remnants of war that threaten lives and livelihoods long after fighting has finished. We make land safe where war has ended, while also assisting those affected by active conflict and endemic violence.

HALO addresses human suffering caused by armed violence in some of the world’s most fragile places, securing weapons and ammunition and working with both state and community actors to reduce the prevalence of armed violence.

About the role:

The Safeguarding Officer plays a key role in supporting the Global Safeguarding Lead (GSGL) to strengthen and embed safeguarding across all programmes and headquarters functions. The postholder will provide expert guidance and support to programme teams, help drive continuous improvement through safeguarding self-reviews and action plans, contribute to safeguarding case management and investigations, and support the design and delivery of safeguarding training and awareness initiatives across the organisation.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the monitoring and review of safeguarding self-reviews and action plans across programmes, providing practical support and guidance to ensure progress against agreed objectives. This may involve occasional international travel.
  • Lead or support safeguarding risk assessments across programmes and functions, ensuring mitigation measures are identified, implemented and reviewed to reduce the risk of harm.
  • Support programme teams to assess, strengthen and monitor safeguarding capacity within implementing partners, contractors and external stakeholders.
  • Support the GSGL in the design, development, and delivery of safeguarding training programmes, ensuring staff at all levels understand their safeguarding responsibilities and are equipped to apply them effectively.
  • Develop engaging safeguarding communications, awareness-raising resources, and training materials that are accessible, inclusive, and appropriate for diverse audiences and reinforce a speak up culture.
  • Support the development, implementation and monitoring of community-based safeguarding reporting and complaints mechanisms to ensure they are accessible, trusted and survivor-centred.
  • Support safeguarding case management processes, ensuring responses are survivor-centred, confidential, timely and aligned with organisational policies and international best practice.
  • Coordinate with HR, legal, security and programme teams on cases that involve employees, partners or contractors.
  • Work collaboratively with recruitment teams across regions and programmes to promote and strengthen safeguarding practices throughout the recruitment and onboarding process.
  • Coordinate and facilitate the safeguarding Community of Practice, bringing together safeguarding leads and focal points across the organisation to share learning, strengthen collaboration, and promote best practice.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of safeguarding systems, processes, and initiatives in response to organisational priorities and emerging needs.
  • Support statutory and donor reporting obligations, including serious incident reports to the Charity Commission and notifications to institutional donors.
  • Support Managers and safeguarding focal points in the field/country offices to apply policy consistently.
  • Monitor developments in sector standards and regulatory requirements and flag implications for policy or practice.

We're looking for someone who can translate tool-specific complexity into visual patterns that scale, unlock complex engineering tools for AI agents to work with, and help our users automate their day-to-day in days, not months.

We are looking for an experienced UI/UX Designer to shape how engineers interact with complex simulation and analysis tools through our automation platform, from visual programming interfaces to AI-powered workflow building.

As part of a tightly knit product trio with your Product Manager and Tech Lead in our most technical product team, you'll help define how we integrate engineering tools into our platform. You'll work on translating tool-specific details into abstracted, interchangeable nodes, evolving our 3D viewer to support growing engineering domains, and designing AI-based experiences that help engineers build valuable automations in days instead of months.

At Synera, design isn't a handoff. It's a core part of how we build. You'll bring structure to technical ambiguity, collaborate closely with developers, and ensure that what we ship at lightning pace is not just functional, but truly intuitive for engineering users.

You'll do discovery, map complex and highly technical user journeys, and see the design cycle through concept to high-fidelity prototype. As one of four Synera UI/UX designers, you'll get your hands dirty: From designing individual node interfaces and creating patterns that scale across multiple engineering domains to our AI-based workflow builder that helps users translate their expertise into reliable automations.

Working closely with our users from mechanical engineering, CFD, and optimization backgrounds, you'll get firsthand feedback and real use cases to continuously refine the user experience.

If you're eager to own design at the intersection of complex engineering tools and AI automation, and have a visible impact from day one, we'd love to meet you.

📣 Drive discovery & feedback loops

As part of the product trio with your Product Manager and Tech Lead you shape the product vision, gather requirements, and turn complexity into clarity. You'll translate technical tool specifications into user-friendly abstractions and be the voice of the user in a team that values engineering precision and usability equally.

⏱ Deliver Value Quickly but with Quality

As a fast-growing start-up, it's all about speed for us. You balance creativity with pragmatism to ensure high-quality designs while meeting sprint goals. We ship iteratively, and your designs will have a fast, visible impact, helping users achieve valuable automations in days versus months.

You'll actively participate in design critiques among designers and help raise the bar across the company. We believe in growing together and maintaining a consistent, intuitive design system across the product.

⚡In the first 6 months: You start to take ownership of the design for engineering integration projects, developing new building blocks for our automation platform.

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary range is:

Requirements

jobs.excerpt: Meet the Moment with AlteryxWe're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done.
jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Senior Partner Sales Engineer

Public Sector and U.S. South | Partner-led Alteryx One outcomes

The opportunity

Data, automation and AI are reshaping how work gets done. Alteryx One brings data, analytics and AI together in a governed, accessible platform, enabling organizations to turn trusted workflows and business logic into repeatable, agent-driven outcomes.

The Senior Partner Sales Engineer is the technical and strategic lead for a focused portfolio of partners and partner-led opportunities. You will help global and regional systems integrators, solution providers, distributors and technology partners position, architect, prove, deliver and scale Alteryx One solutions. You will work across partner leadership, partner architects, Alteryx account teams, Product, Engineering and customer stakeholders to convert ecosystem potential into measurable customer outcomes.

This role has a specific mandate across Public Sector and the U.S. South. sales segment. It combines partner practice development with hands-on presales execution, including public sector account planning, mission-oriented use cases, secure hybrid architectures, technical evaluations and production adoption.

What success looks like

  • Priority partners can independently qualify, position, demonstrate, architect and deliver Alteryx One solutions.

  • Partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities advance through stronger discovery, technical validation and executive alignment.

  • Proofs of concept and Partner Acceleration Program investments start with a named customer, measurable outcome, delivery capacity and path to production.

  • Joint solutions become reusable offerings, reference architectures, demos and managed service patterns that partners can take to additional accounts.

  • Public Sector customers receive architectures and value cases aligned to mission outcomes, security, governance, auditability and responsible AI.

  • Technical outcomes are evidenced through milestones, technical win rate, POC-to-production conversion, active usage, partner readiness and contribution to pipeline, renewal and expansion.

What you will do

Own partner technical strategy and practice development | approx. 20%

  • Build technical account plans for assigned partners, aligned to their GTM priorities, industry strengths, delivery capacity, target accounts and services economics.

  • Establish trusted-advisor relationships with partner executives, practice leaders, solution architects and sales engineers.

  • Segment partners by readiness and potential, then focus investment on those able to sell, build, support and scale repeatable customer outcomes.

  • Align with Partner Alliance Managers and field leadership on joint priorities, coverage, account mapping and measurable success criteria.

Architect differentiated Alteryx One solutions | approx. 25%

  • Lead discovery and architecture workshops that connect business outcomes to AI-ready data, analytics, automation, governance and deployment requirements.

  • Design secure cloud, hybrid and on-premises patterns across Alteryx One, modern data platforms and enterprise applications.

  • Position governed business logic as the foundation for reliable agentic outcomes, with workflows that are visible, understandable, repeatable and auditable.

  • Guide partners on Agent Studio, Alteryx MCP Server, AI Tool Palette, Ask Alteryx, Live Query, Workspace Execution and relevant Designer capabilities, distinguishing released functionality from preview or roadmap items.

  • Develop joint architectures and integration patterns with Snowflake, Databricks, Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft and other strategic technologies without displacing partner or platform-native services.

Lead partner-led technical sales and proof execution | approx. 20%

  • Support qualified partner-led opportunities from discovery through technical close, including demonstrations, whiteboarding, solution design, objection handling, security review and executive presentations.

  • Structure POCs and Partner Acceleration Program engagements around a named sponsor, funded problem, baseline, acceptance criteria, partner capacity, production owner and repeatable 5-to-10-account thesis.

  • Drive clear qualify, design, prove and produce gates. Stop or reset activity when customer demand, product fit, security, partner economics, delivery ownership or production criteria are not credible.

  • Capture reusable evidence, including reference designs, demo assets, customer proof, lessons learned and delivery handoffs.

Advance Public Sector outcomes | approx. 15%

  • Partner with Public Sector AEs, alliance leaders and delivery partners to identify mission-critical workflows in cross-government operations, defense and intelligence, public health, finance and revenue, infrastructure, transportation, human services and public safety.

  • Translate agency priorities into measurable outcomes such as improved service delivery, stronger forecasting, resource optimization, faster disaster response, better data quality and auditable decision processes.

  • Address public sector requirements for secure data access, hybrid deployment, governance, lineage, regulatory compliance, accessibility and responsible AI in coordination with Alteryx specialists.

  • Support partner-led account planning, capture activity and technical responses for relevant procurement motions. Never overstate certifications, authorizations, product availability or customer evidence.

Enable partners to operate independently | approx. 10%

  • Create role-based enablement for partner sellers, presales teams, architects and delivery consultants, combining messaging, discovery, demos, architecture and implementation readiness.

  • Coach partner technical teams through hands-on builds, certification pathways, technical win plans and delivery quality reviews.

  • Build scalable assets such as demo environments, solution blueprints, reusable workflows, industry playbooks, competitive guidance and facilitator kits.

  • Measure enablement by observed capability and customer execution, not attendance or activity volume alone.

Represent the partner and operate with discipline | approx. 10%

  • Bring structured partner and customer feedback to Product and Engineering, influence priorities with evidence and close the loop with the ecosystem.

  • Maintain current knowledge of Alteryx One, data and AI market trends, competitors, partner roadmaps, security practices and commercial dependencies.

  • Track technical milestones, partner readiness, risks, outcomes and attribution in the relevant operating systems; provide concise MBR and QBR insight.

  • Represent Alteryx at partner events, executive briefings, technical communities and customer forums.

What we are looking for

Required experience and capability

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in enterprise presales, solution engineering, solution architecture or technical consulting across data, analytics, automation, AI or adjacent enterprise software.

  • At least 3 years working directly with partner ecosystems, including GSIs, regional SIs, solution providers, distributors, ISVs or hyperscalers.

  • Demonstrated success building partner technical capability and supporting partner-sourced or partner-led enterprise opportunities through technical close.

  • Hands-on ability to lead discovery, design architectures, build compelling demonstrations and define outcome-based POCs.

  • Working knowledge of data preparation, analytics, workflow automation, governance, AI/ML and agentic AI concepts, including APIs, OAuth, MCP, LLM integration and human oversight.

  • Experience with public cloud and modern data platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Snowflake or Databricks, plus hybrid and on-premises integration patterns.

  • Practical proficiency with SQL and at least one relevant analytics or programming environment such as Alteryx, Python or R.

  • Executive presence and the ability to translate technical complexity into business, partner and mission outcomes for CxO, architecture, security, data and line-of-business audiences.

  • Strong commercial judgment, prioritization and written communication; willing to challenge weak qualification and ungrounded roadmap assumptions.

  • Ability to travel up to 40%, based on territory and business needs.

Preferred and differentiating experience

  • Experience supporting U.S. Public Sector agencies and the partner ecosystem that serves them, including mission, procurement, security and delivery stakeholders.

  • Alteryx experience or certification, with the ability to ramp rapidly across Alteryx One, Designer and cloud modules.

  • Applied experience with GenAI or agentic architectures, including RAG, MCP-based tool use, prompt and context design, evaluation, guardrails and responsible AI.

  • Experience creating partner practices, packaged offerings, reference architectures, marketplace propositions or managed services.

  • Cloud, data platform, architecture, security or AI certifications relevant to the territory and partner portfolio.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

How performance will be measured

Goals will be set by territory and partner portfolio. The role will be assessed on verified outcomes, not raw activity counts.

Commercial contribution

Partner-sourced and influenced pipeline progression; technical win rate; renewal and expansion influence; marketplace or consumption impact where applicable.

Partner capability

Partners independently qualifying, demoing, architecting and delivering; readiness progression; quality of partner technical plans.

Proof to production

POC-to-production conversion; time to agreed technical decision; adoption owner and support handoff; active usage and customer evidence.

Reusable scale

Validated solutions, accelerators, reference architectures and 5-to-10-account activation plans adopted by partner teams.

Execution quality

HLD and technical close plan quality; risk and milestone hygiene; accurate product positioning; Product and Engineering feedback closure.

Compensation:

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation is determined by several factors, including but not limited to relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The base salary range for this role in the United States is $112,945–$123,879 with an On-Target Earnings (OTE) range of $161,350–$176,970..

In addition to base pay and commission eligibility, this role includes clear forms of additional compensation, such as:

  • A monthly Connectivity Plus stipend of $150 to support remote work-related expenses

  • An annual $200 home office reimbursement

Alteryx offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and flexible time off

  • Mental health support and wellness reimbursement

  • Career development and education assistance


Why Alteryx

At Alteryx, you will help partners and customers move from fragmented data work and AI experimentation to governed, production-scale outcomes. You will work at the intersection of business teams, IT, data platforms and AI ecosystems, turning trusted analytic workflows into systems that drive consistent decisions and action.

We value problem solvers, innovators and high performers who challenge the status quo, keep their commitments and help the whole team succeed. Candidates who meet many, but not every, requirement are encouraged to apply. Alteryx is committed to building an inclusive workplace with a wide range of backgrounds, identities and experiences.

Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Benefits & Perks:

Alteryx has amazing benefits for all Associates which can be viewed here.

For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Alteryx will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

This position involves access to software/technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

jobs.title: Practicum Advisor
jobs.excerpt: Who we areAt Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe education is more than the pursuit of knowledge – it is a catalyst for transformation.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe education is more than the pursuit of knowledge – it is a catalyst for transformation. Our mission, grounded in democratizing education, is to create access for learners from every background and empower them to achieve their aspirations and advance their careers.

We are committed to delivering rigorous, flexible programs that are both personally fulfilling and professionally rewarding, while contributing to the betterment of society. Since 2004, Yorkville has been among Canada’s few private, for-profit, fully accredited degree-granting universities, with campuses in Ontario, British Columbia, and New Brunswick. Together with Toronto Film School, we offer creative and academic pathways at both the college and university levels, cultivating a multidisciplinary environment where innovation and the arts converge.

Our community is vibrant and diverse. Many of our learners are adults balancing education with careers and personal commitments. Every member of our team – whether in teaching, operations, or technology – is dedicated to removing barriers and expanding access. Together, we deliver flexible, industry-informed learning that leads to meaningful opportunities.

At our core is human connection – guiding people to reimagine their futures in a community defined by opportunity, creativity, and growth.

Who we need

Reporting to the Manager of Practicum Applications, we are hiring a Practicum Advisor to support students in the Master of Arts in Counselling Psychology program as they prepare for practicum. As our new Practicum Advisor, you will guide students through pre-practicum requirements, helping them understand what they need to complete and supporting their progression through each stage of the process. You will review applications and documentation, track student progress, and collaborate with university teams to help ensure students are prepared to move forward with their placements in accordance with university requirements.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada.

What's in it for you

Impact on a critical stage of the student journey. Practicum is an important milestone for Master of Arts in Counselling Psychology students as they move from academic learning toward applied professional experience. You will help students navigate the requirements leading up to this stage, providing the clarity, guidance, and follow-through they need to feel prepared and confident as they progress toward practicum.

Influence on student readiness and progression. You will play an important role in helping students successfully move through the pre-practicum process. By reviewing applications and documentation, clarifying requirements, tracking progress, and coordinating with students, potential supervisors, practicum sites, faculty, and university teams, you will help identify and resolve issues that could otherwise delay a student's progression. Your work will contribute to a well-coordinated experience and help ensure students are ready to move forward with their placements.

Specialized knowledge and career growth. You will build expertise in practicum processes, graduate education, student advising, and the requirements involved in preparing counselling psychology students for field training. Working across student services, faculty, practicum sites, and supervisors will give you broad exposure to the academic and administrative processes behind experiential learning while strengthening skills you can continue to build on within student services and post-secondary education.

How you will make an impact

  • Guide students through the pre-practicum process. You will provide clear, responsive support to Master of Arts in Counselling Psychology students as they prepare for practicum. You will answer questions, clarify requirements, and provide direction on the documentation and steps students need to complete.
  • Review and coordinate practicum applications. You will review practicum applications and supporting documentation for completeness and accuracy, following established university requirements and processes. You will communicate with students when additional information or action is needed and help keep applications moving forward.
  • Track student progress. You will monitor students as they move through the different stages of the pre-practicum process, maintaining accurate and confidential electronic records. You will manage a high volume of information and follow up on outstanding requirements to help students stay on track.
  • Communicate and collaborate. You will correspond with students and work with practicum sites, potential supervisors, faculty, and university colleagues to support a well-coordinated practicum process. You will communicate professionally and thoughtfully, helping ensure everyone has the information they need.
  • Support continuous improvement. You will help maintain and update pre-practicum documents, resources, and presentations as requirements and processes evolve. You will contribute to the day-to-day effectiveness of the team and take on additional activities that support students and the practicum application process.

What you bring

  • The education. You have a Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Social Sciences, or a related field, providing you with a strong foundation for understanding and supporting the needs of a diverse graduate student population.
  • The organizational skills. You are highly organized and comfortable managing a large volume of detailed and confidential information. You can work independently, prioritize competing needs, maintain accurate records, and contribute as a collaborative member of a team.
  • The technical skills. You are proficient with Microsoft Office, Adobe, and data management tools, and you are comfortable learning new systems and software. You can use technology effectively to organize information, maintain documentation, and support day-to-day processes.
  • The communication and relationship-building skills. You can build trusting relationships and communicate professionally with graduate students, prospective students, faculty, university staff, and other professionals. You know how to adapt your communication to different audiences, provide clear information, and navigate challenging conversations with diplomacy and sound judgment.
  • The ability to navigate complex situations. You bring strong conflict resolution and crisis management skills and can remain thoughtful and professional when situations are sensitive or challenging. You approach barriers with empathy, cultural sensitivity, and an understanding of the diverse experiences and needs of graduate students.

Why work at Yorkville University?

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we are united by a shared purpose: placing the student experience at the heart of everything we do. Whether you are teaching, designing curriculum, advising students, advancing technology, or supporting operations, your work directly fuels learning potential, strengthens inclusive communities, and fosters purposeful curiosity.

Here, professional growth is part of our culture. In your role, you will have opportunities to help the launch of career-relevant programs, expand your expertise, and access tuition-free courses across our institutions - from certificates to master’s degrees. Curiosity, initiative, and innovation are encouraged, and your ideas can move from vision to reality.

Our scale offers the best of both worlds: the reach and stability of a national institution combined with the agility of a mid-sized organization, where contributions are visible and valued. You will be part of a diverse and inclusive community where authenticity is celebrated, collaboration is expected, and impact is shared - on students, colleagues, and your own professional journey.

At Yorkville and Toronto Film School, your work does more than make a difference. It empowers others to achieve their possible, while giving you the opportunity to realize yours.

Compensation philosophy

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe compensation should be fair, straightforward, and supportive of your growth. Our salary ranges reflect progression from learning in the role to excelling, with each offer based on skills, experience, and role complexity.

This position offers a minimum annual salary of $50,000, a midpoint of $53,500 and a maximum of $55,000. Established hires typically start near the midpoint, while the upper range is reserved for those with deep expertise and sustained contributions. Offers below the midpoint recognize strong potential with room to grow.

We strive for equitable, consistent pay, though rates may vary within the same role based on performance, specialized knowledge, and impact.

Base salary is one part of a broader package that includes paid time away, retirement savings matching, and extended health coverage with 80% of premiums paid. After 12 months of full-time employment, there is also tuition-free access to all our education programs.

We welcome conversations about compensation throughout the hiring process.

Join us

We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we seek, express your interest.

What you can expect from our hiring process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining Yorkville University and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual interview with the Manager of Practicum Applications and Team Lead, Practicum Applications to discuss your experience and approach to supporting students, managing detailed administrative processes, and collaborating as part of a team.

Diversity, equity, and inclusion are critical components of life at Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, and we are committed to making these values an integral part of our culture. We encourage applications from all qualified applicants, including women, persons with disabilities, Black, Indigenous and People of Colour (BIPOC), people from the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Transsexual, Queer, Questioning, Two-Spirit, Intersex, Asexual + (LGBTQ2SIA+) community and other equity-seeking groups.

Yorkville University is committed to providing accessible employment practices that comply with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation for disability, please notify Human Resources at 1-877-429-4029.

Position Title: J Street U Campus Fellowship

Reports To: J Street U Regional Coordinator

Location: All Universities with J Street U Chapters

Duration: 2026-2027 School Year

Looking to bring a pro-Israel, pro-Peace, pro-Democracy community to your campus? Apply to be a campus fellow today!

Program Description

J Street U is launching a paid fellowship program to establish and grow our presence on priority campuses nationwide. This fellowship serves as a catalyst for bringing J Street U to new campuses and to students who would benefit from being part of our community. Campus Fellows will receive $750 per semester to lead grassroots organizing efforts and establish J Street U programming on their campus. This role is designed for motivated students who can independently launch initiatives while working collaboratively with regional staff. Fellows will serve as the primary J Street U representative on campus, building community and connecting students to our broader movement.

About J Street

J Street is the political home for pro-Israel, pro-peace Americans working for the future of Israel as the democratic homeland of the Jewish people. The organization believes that preserving Israel’s Jewish and democratic character depends on achieving a two-state solution, resulting in a Palestinian state living alongside Israel in peace and security.

J Street focuses its work in three main areas: (1) Advocating and demonstrating support for pro-Israel, pro-peace policies in Congress, the media and the Jewish community; (2) Endorsing and raising money for federal candidates who share J Street’s agenda; and (3) Educating the public and raising awareness of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and the two-state solution.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be an enrolled undergraduate student on a campus with no existing J Street U chapter or limited J Street U presence
  • Ineligible to apply for the Dounn Congressional Fellowship program during fellowship term

Time Commitment

  • 3-5 hours per week
  • Two semesters (full academic year commitment)

Responsibilities May Include:

  • Plan and execute 6 J Street U programs throughout the academic year (3 per semester)
  • Represent J Street U at campus orientation, information sessions, and activities fairs each semester to engage new students.
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings with interested students to encourage deeper involvement
  • Develop and maintain relationships with campus Hillel and other relevant student organizations
  • Serve as primary campus liaison for J Street U activities and initiatives
  • Participate in bi-weekly check-in meetings with assigned regional coordinator
  • Attend monthly J Street U National calls

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Strong relational and interpersonal skills
  • Careful attention to detail
  • Interest in and/or knowledge of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict

Learn More about J Street’s Work

To Apply for the Position

We are excited to receive applications from a broad range of applicants as we grow our organization to better reflect the diversity of the communities that care about our mission. While we will prioritize applications from current J Street U students, all motivated pro-Israel pro-peace students are encouraged to apply. Applicants are considered on a rolling basis.

Please submit the items listed below:

  1. Cover letter that explains why you are interested in this unique experience
  2. Resume
  3. List of three references
  4. Answer the following prompt: In 300-500 words, what role do you think J Street U can play on your campus ?

At J Street we value an inclusive, welcoming, and diverse workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to understanding and valuing each other’s perspectives at all levels of the organization thereby creating a culture that allows us to better serve our employees, and the communities we work with. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law. This policy applies with regard to all aspects of one’s employment and fellowship, including hiring, transfer, promotion, compensation, eligibility for benefits, and termination.

Admission decisions will be made on a rolling basis. We encourage applicants to submit their materials as early as possible to ensure ideal placement in a congressional office. Applicants who move on to further consideration may be contacted for a telephone interview after review of their application, and may need to submit additional materials.

jobs.excerpt: Ranked among the largest accounting and consulting firms in the country and consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work, Cherry Bekaert delivers innovative advisory, assurance and tax services to our clients.
jobs.description:
Ranked among the largest accounting and consulting firms in the country and consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work, Cherry Bekaert delivers innovative advisory, assurance and tax services to our clients. At Cherry Bekaert we create shared success through teamwork, energy, and expertise. We approach today’s toughest business challenges with a client-first mindset, working together to create exceptional value. We are all committed to making a difference for our people, our clients, our community, and our professions. To meet this commitment, Cherry Bekaert will provide you with the space to pursue growth and development opportunities that will guide and support you at each stage of your personal and professional journey.

As a result of continued growth, Cherry Bekaert’s Risk Advisory Services team is seeking an IT Senior Associate who is passionate about helping organizations navigate technology risk while enabling business growth. You will work with organizations to evaluate not only the effectiveness of their IT controls and risk management programs, but also the technology infrastructure that supports business operations and growth. Successful candidates understand how core infrastructure components, including networks, servers, cloud platforms, databases, identity and access management, and enterprise applications, scale alongside evolving business needs. Given the client-facing nature of this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your leadership capabilities while building trusted relationships with key decision makers as you deliver value across a broad scope of projects, including but not limited to:

  • IT Risk Assessment

  • IT General Controls (ITGCs)

  • Internal Audit

  • SOX Compliance

  • IT Governance

  • Cybersecurity Risk Management

  • Technology Infrastructure Review & Roadmapping

  • Control Design and Optimization

As an IT Risk Advisory Senior Associate, you will:

  • Perform IT risk assessments that identify technology, operational, cybersecurity, and compliance risks and translate findings into practical recommendations

  • Execute IT internal audits and evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of IT General Controls (ITGCs), automated controls, application controls, and business process controls

  • Support SOX readiness and SOX 404 compliance initiatives, including access management, change management, computer operations, system development lifecycle controls, and risk and control matrices

  • Evaluate IT governance structures, policies, third-party risk practices, and controls using frameworks such as COSO, COBIT, and NIST

  • Assess cybersecurity governance and risks associated with cloud technologies, artificial intelligence, automation, business continuity, disaster recovery, and other emerging technologies

  • Lead client walkthroughs, interviews, meetings, and status discussions while managing engagement timelines, budgets, communications, and reporting deliverables

  • Assess technology infrastructure, enterprise applications, and supporting control environments to advise organizations on how they can scale systems, processes, and risk management practices to support business growth, operational resilience, and strategic objectives

  • Build trusted client relationships, support engagement planning and quality reviews, and mentor associates and interns

What you bring to the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Accounting, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Minimum of 3+ years of demonstrated experience in IT audit, IT risk, internal audit, SOX compliance, information security, or IT risk advisory

  • Experience evaluating IT General Controls, automated controls, and business process controls, supported by a strong understanding of risk management and internal control concepts

  • Understanding of core technology infrastructure concepts, including networks, cloud environments, databases, operating systems, and enterprise applications, and how these technologies support scalability, operational efficiency, and business growth

  • Strong analytical, communication, and report-writing skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a client-service environment

  • Ability to travel as need to support client engagements, not expected to exceed 25%

Additional, preferred qualifications:

  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) credential, or progress toward one of these certifications

  • Experience with SOX 404 compliance, IT risk assessments, internal audit, cybersecurity risk assessments, COSO, COBIT, or enterprise resource planning environments such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or Microsoft Dynamics

  • Experience evaluating IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, ERP environments, or technology-enabled business transformations, including considerations related to growth, system scalability, and organizational change

  • Familiarity with governance, risk, and compliance platforms, data analytics, or automation tools

What you can expect from us:

  • Our shared values that foster inclusion and belonging including uncompromising integrity, collaboration, trust, and mutual respect

  • The opportunity to innovate and do work that motivates and engages you

  • A collaborative environment focused on enabling you to further your career growth and continuous professional development

  • Competitive compensation and a total rewards package that focuses on all aspects of your wellbeing

  • Flexibility to do impactful work and the time to enjoy your life outside of work

  • Opportunities to connect and learn from professionals from different backgrounds and with different cultures

Benefits Information:

Cherry Bekaert cares about our people. We offer competitive compensation packages based on performance that recognize the value our people bring to our clients and our Firm. The salary range for this position is included below. Individual salaries within this range are determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education, knowledge, skills, and geographic location. In addition, we offer a comprehensive, high-quality benefits program which includes annual bonus, medical, dental, and vision care; disability and life insurance; generous Paid Time Off; retirement plans; Paid Care Leave; and other programs that are dedicated to enhancing your personal and work life and providing you and your family with a measure of financial protection.

Pay Range:

jobs.title: Product Manager, HealthTech
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are We are a fast-growing vertical SaaS company that leverages innovation and disruptive technologies to improve consumer experiences, outcomes, and predictability in elective medicine.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We are a fast-growing vertical SaaS company that leverages innovation and disruptive technologies to improve consumer experiences, outcomes, and predictability in elective medicine. Our team thrives on challenges, embraces change, and is dedicated to transforming our industry.

Adoreal is scaling rapidly, and the way we build is changing just as fast. We are moving from a world where product hands off specs and Figma files to engineering, to one where product and design build working software alongside engineering. This role is built for that future, but it starts, as great product work always has, with deep knowledge of the space and the customer.

While we are a remote-first company, we are currently only able to hire candidates located in the following U.S. states: CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MN, OK, OR, PA, RI, TX, UT, and WA. We hope to expand to additional states in the future.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a Product Manager who knows their space cold and is excited to build, not just specify. The foundation of this role is what it has always been: understanding the customer deeply, knowing the problems worth solving, and having the judgment to know what good looks like. On top of that foundation, you will be hands-on with the tools that are compressing the distance between an idea and working software, building alongside engineering rather than handing off to them.

This is a high-growth opportunity. We need someone who can drive impactful product work today and grow into a product leadership role as we scale.

Responsibilities

You will own the full arc of a product area: understanding the customer and the domain deeply, defining where we should go, and increasingly, helping build it.

  • Develop genuine, deep expertise in your space and your customers. The most valuable thing a PM brings is real understanding of the people who use our platform, the way they work, and the problems worth solving. We are automating the ceremony-heavy parts of the job specifically so you can spend more time here.
  • Translate that understanding into product direction: define, prioritize, and execute a roadmap that aligns with Adoreal's mission, and think big about what is now possible as build time compresses.
  • Build working software against our actual code base using AI development tools, alongside engineering. You will investigate feasibility yourself, understand what already exists in the platform, surface complexity early, and come to engineering with informed questions and functioning work rather than a spec to be interpreted. Depending on the work, that might be an early prototype, or it might be closer to production-ready. The point is that you are building, not just describing.
  • Partner closely with design from the start. Product and design work side by side. This is a collaboration, not a sequential handoff.
  • Build and maintain the context that makes these tools effective: clear product requirements, deep customer and platform knowledge, and the documentation that lets AI tools produce work that looks and behaves like Adoreal. The quality of what we build depends entirely on the quality of the thinking and context behind it.
  • Generate user stories and engineering-ready tickets from your research and your work, and collaborate with engineering through refinement, where they review, improve, and extend what you bring rather than building from scratch.
  • Use platform data and analytics to make informed decisions, identify friction in the experience, and make proactive, intelligent recommendations.
  • Decide when to build and when to integrate, balancing speed, complexity, and long-term maintainability.
  • Set a high standard for product excellence and help establish best practices across the team as our way of working evolves.

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years in software product management, ideally including complex, high-trust, or regulated environments such as healthcare or fintech.
  • A demonstrated track record of understanding what customers actually want — you can point to specific times you talked to customers, synthesized what you heard, and changed the product because of it. Healthcare or clinical customers strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand intricate workflows and systems and translate them into product and technical requirements.
  • Genuine technical fluency. You do not need to have shipped production code, but you should be comfortable reading it, reasoning about how systems connect, working in tools like a code editor and terminal, and understanding the tradeoffs engineers care about.
  • Hands-on, specific experience with AI development tools or products used to build real solutions for customers or clients — not just experimentation. You should be able to name the tools you've used (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, v0, Replit Agent, Windsurf, or similar), describe what you built with them, and speak to the outcome for the customer.
  • A builder's instinct. You would rather show a working thing than describe a hypothetical one.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex requirements and foster collaboration across design, engineering, and the broader business.
  • Experience building infrastructure and integrations related to financial or payment processing systems.
  • An analytical, data-driven mindset, with comfort using analytics, experimentation, and KPIs to guide decisions.
  • Proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and rapid change. Our tools, processes, and what is possible are all evolving quickly, and we are figuring a lot of it out as we go.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with operational or back-office systems and the workflows that run a business behind the scenes, the kind of platforms where data integrity, process automation, and connected systems really matter.
  • Experience in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment.
  • A track record of adopting emerging technology thoughtfully and bringing a team along with you.
  • Background in healthcare, wellness, aesthetics, or another vertical SaaS environment is a plus.
  • Experience implementing an ERP or business central experience is a plus.

Benefits

What We Offer

At Adoreal, we believe in supporting our team’s well-being and growth through comprehensive benefits and a collaborative, people-first culture. As a globally remote company, we prioritize flexibility, inclusivity, and teamwork rooted in the Adoreal principles.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Healthcare coverage for you and your family
  • Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • Performance-based bonuses and company equity opportunities
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible schedules
  • Collaborative and thriving team culture guided by Adoreal’s core values

Why Adoreal?

Joining Adoreal means becoming part of a high-performing, ambitious team that works hard, achieves extraordinary results, and enjoys the rewards that follow. Every employee receives equity, aligning us all in our shared success. Promotions and growth opportunities are limitless, driven only by your performance and dedication to our core principles:

  • We do what is best for the company, not what is best for individuals of the company—we take pride in our work, but not in pride itself—the success of Adoreal is more important than our egos.
  • We always share relevant information and admit our mistakes freely and openly (even when it is worrisome or uncomfortable to do so). Candid communication and a solution-oriented mindset is rewarded.
  • We innovate by finding the right problems, then solving them. We thrive on change that minimizes complexity and improves situations for our stakeholders.
  • We incentivize efficient results & people over process and focus only on the work that creates the most value for our stakeholders.
  • We are quietly confident and openly humble, being tenacious in our quest to perform and inspire others with our thirst for excellence.
  • We do not bow up and knock down—we care about our teammates and treat all of them with respect, regardless of their level within the company.
  • We are steadfast in our pursuit to better our company, our colleagues, and ourselves. When we hire, we only hire people who bleed our principles and who will hopefully be our replacement one day.

At this time, Adoreal is not offering visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must have current and valid authorization to work in the country where they are applying. We comply with all applicable employment and immigration laws, including U.S. regulations, and encourage applicants to verify their work authorization status before applying.  

Adoreal is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and fair workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable U.S. law (EEOC) or local employment regulations where we operate. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
Accommodations for disabilities are available upon request throughout the recruitment process.

*We are not working with search firms for this role, thank you*

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Adoreal has become aware of fraudulent job offers being sent by people falsely claiming to represent us. To protect yourself:

  • Verify the sender's email address matches our official domain before responding.
  • Be cautious of offers that come with no prior application or interview process.
  • Never share personal details, banking information, or Social Security numbers as part of a job offer or interview.
  • Legitimate offers will never ask you to pay money upfront for equipment, training, or onboarding.
  • If something feels off — urgency, poor grammar, unusual payment requests — trust your instincts and pause before responding.

If you receive a suspicious email or offer claiming to be from Adoreal, please don't respond to it directly. Report it as spam through your email provider and reach out to us at with any concerns.

jobs.excerpt: About the EngagementAllShore Talent is supporting a large Adobe implementation initiative requiring experienced professionals across Content Supply Chain, Experience Platform & Digital Marketing, and Program & Delivery workstreams.
jobs.description:
About the Engagement

AllShore Talent is supporting a large Adobe implementation initiative requiring experienced professionals across Content Supply Chain, Experience Platform & Digital Marketing, and Program & Delivery workstreams.

This is a high-priority, multi-resource engagement supporting complex Adobe implementations across enterprise environments. The initial engagement is expected to run for approximately six (6) months, with potential for extension and future project opportunities based on performance, business needs, and continued expansion of Adobe-related programs.

Resources will work as part of distributed delivery teams supporting architecture, implementation, integration, configuration, data, marketing technology, analytics, operations, and program delivery.

Because of the scale and pace of the program, candidates should be comfortable working within cross-functional teams, collaborating remotely, and contributing quickly within established project environments.

Due to the critical nature and urgency of this hire, we are unable to accommodate extended notice periods, such as 30 days.

If you are not immediately available or cannot start within a short timeframe, please let the recruiter know whether you would be able to engage on a part-time basis while completing your notice period. For example, you may be able to support 20 hours per week during morning hours until you are available to transition to full-time.

Please be as specific as possible about your availability so we can determine whether an interim arrangement may be feasible.

Position Overview

We are seeking a senior Adobe Enterprise Architect to define and lead the future-state architecture for complex enterprise Adobe Experience Cloud environments.

This individual will operate across multiple Adobe products and the client's broader enterprise ecosystem, determining how content, customer data, analytics, identity, personalization, journey orchestration, commerce, CRM, cloud platforms, and external systems should work together.

This is a broad, cross-platform architecture role. It is not focused on implementing one Adobe product and is not a platform-administration position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior architecture leader and trusted advisor for enterprise Adobe transformation initiatives.
  • Lead discovery with executive, business, marketing, product, data, security, and technology stakeholders.
  • Assess the current Adobe ecosystem, enterprise platforms, integrations, data architecture, operating model, and technical debt.
  • Define current-state, transition-state, future-state, and North Star architectures.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable enterprise technology strategies.
  • Define how content, data, identity, analytics, personalization, decisioning, and activation flow across platforms.
  • Design integration approaches between Adobe products and CRM, commerce, cloud, data warehouse, identity, consent, DAM, and activation platforms.
  • Establish architecture principles, technical guardrails, integration patterns, governance standards, and decision frameworks.
  • Develop phased transformation roadmaps, dependencies, sequencing, and investment priorities.
  • Lead architecture reviews and guide Solution Architects, Consultants, Engineers, Developers, Product Owners, and delivery teams.
  • Create and present architecture diagrams, roadmaps, decision documents, and executive recommendations.
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex cross-platform architecture decisions.

Relevant Adobe Specialties

  • Adobe Experience Platform, Real-Time CDP, and enterprise data architecture.
  • Adobe Experience Manager, DAM, Workfront, and content supply chains.
  • Customer Journey Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Journey Optimizer, Campaign, and Target.
  • Adobe Commerce, customer identity, governance, enterprise integrations, and APIs.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of enterprise architecture, solution architecture, digital transformation, martech, data, or enterprise technology consulting experience.
  • Significant experience leading enterprise-scale Adobe Experience Cloud transformations.
  • Broad architecture experience across at least three Adobe products or capabilities.
  • At least one official Adobe certification is required; the exact certification must be clearly listed on the resume.
  • Demonstrated ownership of enterprise current-state, future-state, and transition-state architecture.
  • Experience creating multiyear Adobe platform or digital-transformation roadmaps.
  • Experience integrating Adobe products with enterprise data, CRM, identity, commerce, cloud, content, and activation platforms.
  • Experience advising Vice President, C-suite, or comparable executive stakeholders.
  • Strong executive presence, facilitation, presentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to independently lead a complex engagement involving multiple products, teams, and business units.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multiple Adobe certifications or certification aligned with AEP, AEM, CJA, Analytics, AJO, Target, Workfront, Commerce, or another Experience Cloud product.
  • Experience across four or more Adobe Experience Cloud products.
  • Consulting, systems integration, or digital agency experience.
  • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with privacy, consent, security, identity, and data governance.

What Success Looks Like

  • Client leadership has a clear and achievable future-state Adobe architecture.
  • Adobe products operate as an integrated ecosystem rather than isolated tools.
  • Delivery teams have clear architectural direction and decision guardrails.
  • The client views this individual as a trusted strategic and technical advisor.

Important Notice for Applicants:
