Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Content Strategist / Information Architect for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Content Strategist / Information Architect shapes how content is planned, structured, and organized across the program's public-facing websites and applications so that users can find, understand, and act on information efficiently. This role guides content strategy across its full lifecycle, from audience research and planning through development, ongoing management, governance, and publishing, while contributing information-architecture expertise to usability testing, content governance, and search discoverability.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $87,000 – $95,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer content strategy and information architecture across the full content lifecycle, from planning and development through management, governance, and publishing.

  • Develop and maintain user personas, user stories, and journey maps for key audience segments, identifying content needs, gaps, and opportunities to inform strategy.

  • Build and maintain content taxonomies, metadata schemas, and information architecture models that support findability, reuse, and consistent navigation across websites and applications.

  • Define content structure and organization standards (e.g., page templates, content types, metadata tagging conventions) for content authors and editors to follow, coordinating with SEO on structural elements that support discoverability at the point of creation.

  • Review content within the CMS for clarity, findability, accessibility, and usability, recommending structural, navigational, or governance improvements informed by data and user needs.

  • Establish and document information-architecture standards and permissions structures that support consistent content governance and auditability.

  • Ensure content structure and metadata remain consistent across distribution channels and rendering formats during publishing.

  • Design and participate in usability testing, contributing IA-specific test scenarios (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, navigation tasks) and translating findings into structural recommendations.

  • Partner with SEO and digital strategy teams on keyword-informed taxonomy and site-structure decisions that support both user experience and organic search performance.

  • Support development of journey maps tied to specific audience events or milestones to identify structural and content gaps.

  • Contribute content-structure findings and recommendations to required lifecycle and performance reporting.

  • Maintain awareness of accessibility requirements (Section 508, WCAG) as they inform content and navigation structure decisions.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • This position requires an active Secret Clearance.

  • BA in Communications, English, Information Science, Technical Communication, or UX Writing.

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in content strategy, information architecture, or UX-focused content work, ideally within a large public-facing website or application environment.

  • Demonstrated experience building taxonomies, sitemaps, content models, and/or metadata frameworks.

  • Experience developing personas, journey maps, and other user-research-informed strategy artifacts.

  • Familiarity with usability testing methods (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, moderated user testing) and translating findings into actionable structural recommendations.

  • Working knowledge of content management systems and accessibility standards (Section 508/WCAG).

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting a DoD, federal, or other large-scale government-facing digital program.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Optimal Workshop, Figma, or similar IA/UX research tools.

  • Background in editorial or content operations in addition to information architecture.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

This role is accountable for selling integrated and standalone solutions to both CPG brands and retail partners, helping them activate regenerative agriculture across their businesses, supplier networks, and product portfolios. You will work with partners to determine the right combination of verification, certified claims, and regenerative procurement pathways based on their business objectives, and sustainability commitments.

This is not a transactional sales role. You are a category builder and trusted advisor, supporting brands and retailers through the commercial and operational realities of regenerative sourcing. You will engage sustainability, procurement, innovation, and executive leadership teams to design partnerships that deliver measurable, verified impact while creating long-term commercial value.

jobs.excerpt: The DRG Coder is responsible for reviewing inpatient medical records and accurately assigning diagnosis and procedure codes using ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS to determine the appropriate Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) assignment.
jobs.description:
The DRG Coder is responsible for reviewing inpatient medical records and accurately assigning diagnosis and procedure codes using ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS to determine the appropriate Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) assignment.

This role ensures coding accuracy, reimbursement integrity, and compliance with federal and state regulations, payer guidelines, and internal policies. In an Independent Practice Association (IPA) and Management Services Organization (MSO) environment, the DRG Coder partners with utilization management, care management, finance, and provider network teams to support accurate payment, risk adjustment, quality reporting, and medical expense analysis.

What You'll Do

  • Review inpatient hospital records and assign accurate diagnosis and procedure codes
  • Determine the appropriate MS-DRG or APR-DRG assignment based on coding and clinical documentation
  • Conduct coding validation and auditing to ensure compliance with payer and regulatory requirements
  • Identify documentation gaps and communicate opportunities to providers, hospitals, and Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) teams
  • Analyze denials and underpayments related to coding and DRG assignment
  • Support retrospective and concurrent reviews of high-cost admissions and outlier cases
  • Collaborate with utilization management, case management, finance, and contracting teams to optimize reimbursement and cost containment
  • Assist with internal and external audits, including RAC, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial payer reviews
  • Provide education and mentoring to coding staff and other stakeholders
  • Monitor changes in coding guidelines, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements
  • Prepare reports and summaries related to coding accuracy, financial impact, and audit findings
  • Maintain confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA and company policies
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree in Health Information Management, Nursing, or related field
  • Have at least 5 years of inpatient coding experience
  • Have at least 2 years of advanced DRG validation, auditing, or hospital reimbursement experience
  • Certifications One or more of the following required: • CCS, RHIA, or RHIT from American Health Information Management Association • CIC from AAPC
  • Have advanced knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, MS-DRG, and APR-DRG methodologies
  • Proficiency in coding software, electronic medical records, and Microsoft Office applications
You're great for the role if:
  • Experience working with Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial health plans
  • Experience in a delegated IPA, MSO, or managed care environment
  • Have a strong understanding of Medicare reimbursement and payer audit processes
  • Ability to interpret complex clinical documentation
  • Knowledge of utilization management, case management, and managed care operations
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions

  • This position is remotely based in the U.S. The home office is located at 600 City Parkway West 10th Floor, Orange, CA 92868.
  • This role is required to attend occasional in-person meetings with internal departments and external providers/hospitals, training, or audit purposes.
  • The national target pay range for this role is between $28.00 - $32.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job-related factors.

CircusTrix dba

Sky Zone

Franchise Business Consultant

Full-time

Remote with travel

**Must reside in Maryland, New York, or New Jersey**

Reports to: VP of Franchise Operations

Travel: Up to 50%

WHO WE ARE:

At Sky Zone, our mission is to enrich lives through the power of boundless play – whether that’s on the trampoline court, behind the scenes, or at the corporate level. We believe play fuels confidence, connection, and joy, and we’re proud to create experiences that reflect that purpose in everything we do.

As the leader in active indoor entertainment, we host unforgettable birthdays, team events, and school parties across the country. Backed by our parent company, CircusTrix, and recognized as a top franchise and growth brand, we continue to raise the bar for innovation and impact in the industry.

Our culture is shaped by our core values: We Play Without Limits, Ignite Innovation, Grow Together, Fuel Joy, and Serve Big, Give Bigger. Whether in a park or a boardroom, these values guide how we lead, collaborate, and show up for each other and for the communities we serve.

WHO YOU ARE:

You are a collaborative business partner who thrives on helping independent owners succeed. With deep experience in franchise operations and financial management, you know how to balance brand standards with entrepreneurial spirit. You enjoy building trust, solving complex challenges, and uncovering new opportunities for growth. Above all, you see franchisees as partners and their success as the key to strengthening the entire Sky Zone brand.

HOW YOU BRING OUR MISSION TO LIFE:

You help empower franchisees by unlocking growth potential, strengthening operations, and creating guest experiences that fuel joy at every park. You achieve this by –

Franchisee Partnership & Engagement

  • Building and maintaining strong, collaborative relationships with franchise owners and their leadership teams.
  • Conducting needs assessments to understand franchisee challenges, opportunities, and long-term business goals.
  • Providing tailored recommendations and action plans that respect franchisee autonomy while reinforcing brand standards and proven systems.
  • Serving as a liaison between franchisees and the corporate support team, ensuring alignment, consistency, and two-way communication.

Strategic Planning & Growth

  • Guiding franchisees in developing and executing strategic business plans that support both local growth and overall brand performance.
  • Advising on market trends, expansion opportunities, and competitive positioning to drive profitability.
  • Partnering with owners to evaluate new revenue streams, from memberships and birthday parties to food & beverage programs and seasonal initiatives.

Operational Excellence & Brand Standards

  • Providing operational consulting to help franchisees adopt best practices and increase efficiency.
  • Monitoring compliance with brand standards, policies, and procedures, and coaching owners on maintaining consistency across all guest experiences.
  • Conducting business reviews and sharing benchmarking data to highlight performance trends and identify opportunities for improvement.

Training & Development

  • Delivering coaching and mentorship to franchisees and their management teams on leadership, operational, and financial skills.
  • Leading workshops and regional meetings that enhance franchisee knowledge in areas such as sales, marketing, guest experience, and team development.
  • Providing franchisees with tools and resources that make it easier to implement proven strategies and achieve sustained results.

Financial Guidance & Accountability

  • Analyzing financial statements (including P&Ls, sales metrics, and benchmarking reports) with franchisees to identify strengths and opportunities.
  • Supporting franchisees in setting budgets, managing costs, and reaching financial targets.
  • Partnering with owners to adopt company-wide initiatives and growth drivers while adapting them to local markets.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensuring franchisee operations comply with legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
  • Advising on risk mitigation strategies and ensuring brand protection in all aspects of business operations.
  • Acting as a subject matter expert in park operations, financial acumen, and franchise system standards.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • Extensive franchise leadership experiencewith 7+ years in franchise consulting, business development, or multi-unit operations.
  • Proven success in driving growth and strengthening franchise businesses.
  • Strong financial expertise with hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency with business tools including CRM systems and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Clear and compelling communication and presentation skills that inspire confidence, drive collaboration, and build strong relationships with diverse partners.
  • Creative problem-solving ability fueled by curiosity, resourcefulness, and a solutions-first mindset.
  • Adaptability and agility to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment while keeping both performance and guest joy at the center of decision-making.
  • Physical requirements include the ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working on a computer and communicating via phone and Teams, as well as the ability to move around during park visits, with or without reasonable accommodation.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS:

Franchisees are at the heart of Sky Zone’s growth and success, and their ability to thrive directly shapes the experiences we deliver to millions of guests. As a Franchise Business Consultant, you play a critical role in bridging the franchisor–franchisee relationship, ensuring that independent owners have the tools, strategies, and support they need to succeed. Through guiding franchisees toward stronger operations, smarter financial decisions, and consistent brand standards, you help fuel both their profitability and the joy our parks bring to every community we serve.

Compensation range is $100,000-$125,000 + bonus opportunitybased on qualifications, experience, and performance. Full-time employees at CircusTrix enjoy a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage along with a 401k plan with company matching. Eligibility for 401k is based on age and tenure requirements.

While we anticipate the application window will close on this date, Sky Zone reviews applications on a rolling basis and will consider candidates until the position is filled.

jobs.excerpt: POS-26210The HubSpot Customer Success Strategy and Operations team is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team.
jobs.description:
POS-26210

The HubSpot Customer Success Strategy and Operations team is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team.

In this role, you will combine deep data insights with business expertise to deliver comprehensive solutions that tackle critical challenges and enhance operational efficiency and strategic outcomes. You will work directly with global leaders across HubSpot to deeply understand business performance while driving growth and productivity through data-driven decisions and strategic insights. You will develop innovative go-to-market and operational strategies, including business/pricing model transformation, retention-driving plays, and supporting our annual Customer Success revenue plan.

Data Analysts act as the technical backbone of the operation, exercising a high degree of technical autonomy to navigate enterprise-scale environments. You will be responsible for architecting scalable, reproducible data assets that serve as the single source of truth for the organization.

In this role, while you operate with a high degree of autonomy - leveraging AI tools to elevate analytical standards and drive strategic impact - you’ll benefit from the support of the Operations Analytics community, sharing ideas, debating approaches, and receiving feedback.

We are looking for people who have:

  • Academic or professional experience with a heavy quantitative, analytical focus.
  • Track record as a go-to expert for the business, playing a pivotal role in driving data-driven decision-making and shaping strategic decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to build deep relationships and present strategies and outcomes to C-suite executives.
  • Passion for fostering a high-performing culture, participating in the analyst community and providing coaching and mentorship to junior analysts.
  • Experience working with large datasets, particularly regarding data mining, manipulation, and exploration in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience using AI to elevate analytical standards and scale project execution without sacrificing rigor.
  • Ability to write performant, complex SQL queries and perform analysis in code-based or notebook environments to ensure workflows are reproducible and efficient.
  • Experience building commercial models (e.g., ROI, LTV) and forecasting trends to inform near-term operational decisions.

In this role, you will:

  • Be a driving influencer on the use and application of analysis; deliver what’s needed, and show what’s possible.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand your team’s data and business needs; become an expert in translating these needs into specific analyses with actionable insights.
  • Conduct quantitative analysis of user behavior to uncover issues or opportunities to improve our customers’ experience.
  • Collaborate across teams and business functions to infuse strategic, open ended research with quantitative insights.
  • Communicate insights to your stakeholders with a data-driven point of view and plan for action.
  • Navigate an enterprise-scale data environment and own the development of scalable assets that drive efficiency and data consistency.
  • Inform specific, near-term operational decisions and product roadmaps, leveraging reproducible analysis to ensure stakeholders act on high-integrity data.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:
$118,500—$189,600 USD

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Category: Health Care

Location:


Job Title:Remote Administrative Assistant – Behavioral Health (U.S.)
Location: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time, 40 hours per week
Working Hours: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, including a one-hour break
Contract Term: 12–18 months, based on organizational needs, performance, and mutual fit
Position Summary
The Behavioral Health Administrative Assistant will support the day-to-day administrative operations of a busy behavioral health practice.
This is a hands-on remote administrative role involving electronic health records, patient information, data entry, payment processing, pharmacy prior authorizations, insurance-related follow-up, telephone and electronic communication, and general administrative support.
The successful candidate will regularly interact with:
  • Patients.
  • Therapists.
  • Psychologists.
  • Psychiatric providers.
  • Pharmacies.
  • Insurance companies.
  • Healthcare institutions.
  • Internal administrative team members.
Because of this regular communication, the person must have excellent written and verbal English communication skills, clear and easily understandable spoken English,professionalism on the telephone, patience, and strong customer-service skills.
The ideal candidate has 3–5+ years of administrative experience in a healthcare environment, understands the sensitivity of protected health information, is comfortable using electronic health record systems, and can work independently while following established
clinical and administrative procedures.
Key Responsibilities
1. Administrative & Data Entry Support
  • Enter and update patient, demographic, billing, insurance, clinical-administrative, and other required information accurately within the electronic health record.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and organized electronic patient records.
  • Review information carefully for missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially incorrect details.
  • Follow up appropriately when additional administrative information is required.
  • Complete routine data-entry and administrative tasks accurately and efficiently.
  • Maintain organized electronic documentation and filing systems.
  • Ensure information is entered into the appropriate system and patient record.
  • Follow established workflows when updating or modifying healthcare information.
  • Escalate questions requiring clinical or professional judgment to the appropriate clinician.
2.Electronic Health Record Support
  • Work confidently within the practice's Electronic Health Record (EHR) / Electronic Medical Record (EMR) environment.
  • Enter, update, organize, and retrieve patient administrative information.
  • Maintain accurate patient demographic and insurance information.
  • Upload and organize relevant administrative documentation.
  • Review records for completeness.
  • Ensure documents and information are associated with the correct patient.
  • Follow practice standards for EHR documentation and information handling.
  • Protect patient information at all times.
Prior experience with an EHR or EMR system is required. Experience with
behavioral-health-specific systems is an advantage.
3. Pharmacy Prior Authorizations
  • Submit pharmacy prior authorization requests on behalf of psychiatric providers.
  • Retrieve required clinical, medication, insurance, and patient information from the electronic health record.
  • Complete electronic and written prior authorization submissions accurately.
  • Verify that required documentation is included before submission.
  • Monitor the status of outstanding prior authorizations.
  • Follow up with pharmacies and insurance companies as required.
  • Communicate approvals, denials, requests for additional information, and outstanding requirements to the appropriate provider or administrative team member.
  • Maintain accurate records of prior authorization activity.
  • Support appeals-related administrative documentation when requested by the clinical team.
  • Follow open requests through completion rather than allowing them to remain unresolved.
4. Insurance & Healthcare Organization Communication
  • Communicate professionally with health insurance companies, pharmacies, healthcare institutions, and other external organizations.
  • Contact insurance companies when information, authorization status, eligibility details, or administrative clarification is required.
  • Document relevant information received during telephone calls or electronic communication.
  • Route information promptly to the correct internal team member.
  • Follow up on unresolved administrative matters.
  • Maintain professionalism even when dealing with complicated, delayed, or repetitive requests.
  • Never provide clinical advice or make decisions requiring licensed professional judgment.
5. Patient Communication & Telephone Support
  • Communicate professionally and compassionately with patients by telephone and approved electronic communication channels.
  • Respond to routine administrative questions within the scope of the position.
  • Obtain or clarify demographic, insurance, payment, pharmacy, scheduling, or other administrative information when required.
  • Route clinical questions to the appropriate licensed professional.
  • Maintain a calm and respectful tone when communicating with patients who may be frustrated, anxious, confused, or experiencing difficult circumstances.
  • Clearly document relevant telephone conversations and required follow-up.
  • Protect patient privacy when discussing sensitive information.
  • Avoid discussing protected information where conversations could be overheard.
Because this position involves regular telephone communication, clear, fluent, and easily understandable spoken English is an important requirement.
6. Payment Processing
  • Process patient payments accurately and securely.
  • Follow established procedures for handling payment information.
  • Respond appropriately to routine payment-related questions.
  • Maintain accurate payment records.
  • Protect financial information and payment details.
  • Never store financial information outside approved systems.
  • Escalate billing disputes or questions outside the scope of the role to the appropriate team member.
7.Google Workspace & Communication Support
Use Google Workspace extensively for day-to-day communication and administrative work.
The successful candidate must be comfortable using:
  • Gmail
  • Google Calendar
  • Google Drive
  • Google Docs
  • Google Sheets
  • Google Meet
  • Google Chat
  • Google Voice
Responsibilities include:
  • Responding promptly to internal Google Chat messages.
  • Using Google Voice for approved business telephone communication.
  • Managing and organizing electronic information in Google Drive.
  • Creating and editing documents through Google Docs.
  • Entering and organizing information in Google Sheets.
  • Participating in virtual meetings through Google Meet.
  • Maintaining professional written communication through Gmail.
  • Using Google Calendar as required for coordination and scheduling.
8. Clinical & Administrative Team Support
  • Work collaboratively with therapists, psychologists, psychiatric providers, and administrative staff.
  • Respond promptly to internal requests.
  • Keep relevant staff informed about outstanding administrative matters.
  • Communicate when additional information is needed.
  • Escalate clinical questions appropriately.
  • Support providers by reducing the administrative burden associated with patient care.
  • Follow through on assigned tasks until they are completed or appropriately transferred.
  • Maintain clear communication when delays or obstacles arise.
9. HIPAA, Privacy & Confidentiality
Because this role will involve access to Protected Health Information (PHI), strict compliance with privacy and security requirements is essential.
The successful candidate must:
  • Understand and comply with HIPAA privacy and security requirements.
  • Access patient information only when required for an authorized work purpose.
  • Maintain confidentiality regarding all patient, clinical, insurance, financial, and practice
information.
  • Never discuss patient information with unauthorized individuals.
  • Use only approved systems for storing, accessing, or communicating PHI.
  • Maintain a secure, private workspace where confidential conversations cannot be
overheard.
  • Follow required password, device, access-control, and cybersecurity procedures.
  • Immediately report suspected privacy, confidentiality, or security incidents.
  • Complete required HIPAA and data-security training.

Requirements

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in one of the following or a closely related field:
○ Health Information Management / Health Records & Information Management
○ Healthcare Administration / Health Services Management
○ Public Health
○ Health Services Administration
○ Business Administration with a healthcare or health-services focus
○ Health Informatics
○ Another relevant healthcare-administration or health-information field.
  • 3–5+ years of administrative experience in a healthcare setting.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting healthcare professionals, clinics, medical practices, hospitals, behavioral-health organizations, insurance organizations, or similar healthcare environments.
  • Previous experience using an Electronic Health Record (EHR) or Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare administration and patient-information workflows.
  • Understanding of HIPAA, patient privacy, confidentiality, and appropriate handling of protected health information.
  • Strong computer and data-entry skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple administrative responsibilities.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Clear, professional, and easily understandable telephone communication.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer-service skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with patients, pharmacies, insurance companies,healthcare institutions, clinicians, and administrative professionals.
  • Ability to recognize when an issue requires clinical judgment and escalate it appropriately.
  • Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs,Sheets, Meet, Chat, and Google Voice.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Ability to consistently meet deadlines and follow established workflows.
  • Reliable high-speed internet access.
  • A professional and private workspace suitable for handling confidential healthcare information.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous administrative experience in a behavioral health, mental health, psychiatry, psychology, therapy, or counseling practice.
  • Experience supporting psychiatric providers.
  • Experience submitting and tracking pharmacy prior authorizations.
  • Experience communicating directly with pharmacies.
  • Experience working with health insurance companies.
  • Experience verifying or managing insurance-related information.
  • Experience supporting prior authorization appeals or follow-up.
  • Experience processing healthcare payments.
  • Experience working remotely for a U.S.-based healthcare organization.
  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare terminology and administrative workflows.
  • Experience using Google Voice for professional telephone communication.
  • Experience working with sensitive behavioral-health information.
Software & Tools
The successful candidate should be experienced with or able to quickly learn:
  • Electronic Health Record / Electronic Medical Record systems
  • Google Workspace
○ Gmail
○ Google Calendar
○ Google Drive
○ Google Docs
○ Google Sheets
○ Google Meet
  • Google Chat
  • Google Voice
  • Pharmacy prior authorization portals and systems.
  • Insurance company portals.
  • Secure healthcare communication systems.
  • Online payment-processing systems.
The candidate does not need prior experience with every specific platform used by the practice but must demonstrate strong overall technical proficiency and the ability to learn new healthcare systems quickly.
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is:
  • Dependable
  • Highly organized
  • Detail-oriented
  • Accurate
  • Professional
  • Patient and compassionate
  • Responsive
  • Trustworthy
  • Discreet
  • Comfortable with technology
  • Strong in verbal communication
  • Clear and confident on the telephone
  • Able to work independently
  • Comfortable following established procedures
  • Able to recognize when an issue should be escalated
  • Adaptable and comfortable learning new systems
This individual should enjoy administrative work and understand that accuracy, confidentiality,timely follow-up, and professional communication directly affect the quality of the patient experience.
Because behavioral healthcare involves sensitive situations, the successful candidate must demonstrate maturity, empathy, discretion, and the ability to communicate respectfully with people from a variety of backgrounds and circumstances.
Working Hours & Schedule
  • Full-Time — 40 hours per week.
  • Monday through Friday.
  • 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time, including a one-hour break.
  • The successful candidate must be consistently available during these hours because the role involves live communication with U.S.-based staff, patients, pharmacies, insurance companies, and healthcare institutions.
  • Occasional scheduling adjustments may be made based on practice needs.
Success in This Role
When this role is functioning effectively:
  • Patient records remain accurate and organized.
  • Prior authorizations move forward without unnecessary delays.
  • Pharmacies and insurers receive timely responses.
  • Patients receive professional and compassionate administrative support.
  • Payments are handled accurately and securely.
  • Clinicians spend less time managing administrative follow-up.
  • Internal communication remains clear and responsive.
  • Sensitive healthcare information remains protected.
  • Administrative tasks are completed without staff having to repeatedly follow up.
Ultimately, the successful candidate will help the clinical team remain focused on providing excellent behavioral healthcare while knowing that critical administrative details are being handled accurately, professionally, and confidentially.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits
  • Competitive Salary commensurate with relevant experience, qualifications, demonstrated expertise, interview performance, and the scope of responsibilities.
  • Performance-based salary reviews and raises
  • Remote work flexibility

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is a GTM internship on a two-sided marketplace, which means you will work on both halves of it: the companies deciding where to hire, and the candidates deciding where to go. The work is research-led rather than script-led. You will identify who is worth reaching, understand why the timing is right for them, write the outreach, and then look honestly at what the numbers say about whether it worked.

You will work directly with the founders and the operating team, and you will see the full arc from a name on a list to a real conversation. This is a good fit for someone who wants to learn go-to-market at a company where the messaging is still being figured out, and where a better-written email is measurably a better email.

Responsibilities

  • Research target companies and candidates, and turn that research into prioritized, specific outreach.
  • Write and send outbound across email and other channels, and iterate on messaging based on what replies.
  • Support both sides of the marketplace: sourcing candidates and supporting companies that are hiring.
  • Track outreach performance, report what is working, and propose the next test.
  • Keep pipeline data and records accurate enough to make decisions from.

Requirements

  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Interest in startups, recruiting, sales, marketplaces, or B2B software.
  • Comfort doing research and turning findings into action.
  • Organized and detail-oriented.
  • Able to manage several small projects at once.

Continue to evolve enablement as the business changes

  • Keep revenue enablement current with where ActivTrak is headed with new offerings, but also the broader shift in category and competitive landscape.
  • Lead the shift in how the team sells: from product- and feature-led pitches to a solutions- and outcomes-led enterprise motion including reframing content, training, and coaching around the problems we solve, not the features we ship.
  • Enable the Enterprise Revenue team to successfully position larger opportunities that require longer, more complex deal cycles, multi-stakeholder selling, business-case and ROI framing, and navigating procurement and security review
  • Manage and maintain enablement systems keeping them current and easy to navigate, but also think creatively about where AI can take on more of that upkeep itself, so content stays fresh without it all falling to manual maintenance.

Own onboarding, coaching, and ramp

Partner cross-functionally

Measure what matters

  • Track ramp time, content usage, and completion and connect enablement investment to revenue outcomes: win rate, sales cycle velocity, quota attainment.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in revenue/sales enablement, sales training, or a hybrid enablement/product marketing role, with a track record of shaping enablement direction, not just executing a plan handed to you.

KPIs and Acceptance Criteria (Deliverables D1–D7)

Timely Submission: Measurement: Submission date compared with the contractual due date. Target: 100% on time. Acceptance Criteria: Deliverable submitted by the agreed deadline.

Required-Content Completeness: Measurement: Completed mandatory sections ÷ required sections × 100. Target: 100%. Acceptance Criteria: All required sections and annexes are present and populated.

Tool Status Coverage: Measurement: Reported tool components ÷ components in the agreed reporting baseline × 100. Target: 100%. Acceptance Criteria: Status is provided for every agreed component, interface, collector, and scheduled process.

Status Accuracy: Measurement: Correct status records ÷ sampled status records × 100. Target: ≥98%. Acceptance Criteria: Reported status reconciles with monitoring and operational records.

Tool Availability Reporting: Measurement: Available service time ÷ scheduled service time × 100. Target: Report actual; target established in SLA. Acceptance Criteria: Availability is calculated correctly, exclusions are identified, and evidence is provided.

Collection-Job Success Rate: Measurement: Successfully completed collection jobs ÷ scheduled collection jobs × 100. Target: ≥98%, unless otherwise agreed. Acceptance Criteria: Successful, failed, retried, and cancelled jobs reconcile to platform records.

Document Collection Success Rate: Measurement: Successfully collected documents ÷ documents attempted × 100. Target: ≥98%. Acceptance Criteria: Volumes reconcile with logs; failed and rejected documents are classified.

Processing Success Rate: Measurement: Documents successfully processed or ingested ÷ documents collected × 100. Target: ≥98%. Acceptance Criteria: Processing failures and exclusions are quantified and explained.

Collection Timeliness: Measurement: Documents collected within the agreed collection window ÷ documents due for collection × 100. Target: ≥95%. Acceptance Criteria: Delayed collections are identified, quantified, and linked to causes or issues.

Duplicate-Document Rate: Measurement: Duplicate documents detected ÷ documents collected × 100. Target: ≤2%, or agreed baseline. Acceptance Criteria: Duplicate calculation is reproducible and material trends are explained.

Error Rate: Measurement: Failed collection or processing transactions ÷ total attempted transactions × 100. Target: ≤2%. Acceptance Criteria: Errors are categorized by source, severity, cause, and corrective action.

Issue-Record Completeness: Measurement: Issues containing required fields ÷ issues recorded during the period × 100. Target: 100%. Acceptance Criteria: Each issue includes identifier, description, severity, dates, impact, owner, status, and target resolution date.

Issue Capture Completeness: Measurement: Issues in report ÷ issues in authoritative ticket register × 100. Target: 100%. Acceptance Criteria: All relevant issues opened, active, or closed during the period are included.

Critical/High Issue Notification: Measurement: Critical/high issues notified within contractual notification time ÷ total critical/high issues × 100. Target: 100%. Acceptance Criteria: Evidence demonstrates that all critical/high issues were notified on time.

Issue Resolution Performance: Measurement: Issues resolved within applicable SLA ÷ issues due for resolution × 100. Target: ≥95%. Acceptance Criteria: Resolution dates and SLA calculations reconcile with the ticketing system.

Root-Cause Coverage: Measurement: Major or recurring issues with documented root-cause analysis ÷ major or recurring issues requiring analysis × 100. Target: 100%. Acceptance Criteria: Root cause, corrective action, preventive action, and owner are documented.

Outstanding-Action Control: Measurement: Open actions with owner and due date ÷ total open actions × 100. Target: 100%. Acceptance Criteria: All open actions have an accountable owner, target date, and current status.

Metric Traceability: Measurement: Reported metrics traceable to an authoritative source ÷ total reported metrics × 100. Target: 100%. Acceptance Criteria: Each metric identifies its source, measurement period, calculation, and applicable exclusions.

Metric Reconciliation Accuracy: Measurement: Metrics matching source evidence ÷ metrics sampled × 100. Target: ≥98%. Acceptance Criteria: No material discrepancy between the report, logs, dashboards, and ticket records.

Trend Analysis Completeness: Measurement: Required metrics containing prior-period comparison ÷ required trend metrics × 100. Target: 100%. Acceptance Criteria: Trends, significant deviations, and likely causes are explained.

Risk Reporting Completeness: Measurement: Material risks reported with rating, owner, mitigation, and due date ÷ identified material risks × 100. Target: 100%. Acceptance Criteria: All material risks and dependencies are actionable and traceable.

Purchaser Review Findings: Measurement: Major findings identified during Purchaser review. Target: 0 major findings. Acceptance Criteria: No unresolved major error, omission, or unsupported conclusion remains.

Review Comment Closure: Measurement: Review comments satisfactorily resolved ÷ comments raised × 100. Target: 100%. Acceptance Criteria: All comments are resolved or formally accepted as deferred by the Purchaser.

jobs.excerpt: About the Program:Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online.
jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

The Director of Revenue Operations will build Roo's first true Revenue Ops function. Historically the the team has been Sales Team focused on HubSpot administration; the mandate is to keep that system administration running well while evolving the function into a strategic partner to our revenue-facing teams, helping Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support drive efficiency, conversion, and success through work like capacity planning, lead management, and conversion optimization.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The team is lean and the function is being stood up for the first time, so you'll move fluidly between strategy and execution: architecting the operating model, managing HubSpot and the systems that power our revenue engine, and bringing rigor to forecasting, pipeline, and governance. You'll start with Sales and expand scope over time into Marketing and Customer Support, hiring and developing a small, high-leverage team along the way. You'll partner closely with Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, and Data leadership to make Roo's revenue engine more efficient, predictable, and intelligent.

The Project Manager will lead the day-to-day management and control of assigned ESCS Phase 2 workstreams or capability areas, ensuring delivery remains aligned to the integrated programme plan, approved budget, resource profile and governance requirements. Working under the direction of the ESCS Programme Lead or Programme Manager, the role will provide clear ownership of planning, finances, resources, risks, dependencies, suppliers and stakeholder reporting for the assigned scope.

The role you will play:

  • Work alongside Scrum Masters and technical leads, with the Project Manager owning project control while Scrum Masters focus on agile team effectiveness and delivery flow.

Primary responsibilities:

  • Manage assigned scope, change, risks, issues, opportunities, actions and decisions, escalating material matters through programme governance.
  • Own the workstream financial position, including budget tracking, forecast updates, actuals review, variance analysis and corrective actions.
  • Maintain resource demand, capacity and allocation forecasts; identify gaps and support recruitment, onboarding and mobilisation.
  • Coordinate engineers, analysts, testers, suppliers and other contributors to ensure clear ownership and timely delivery of outputs.

jobs.title: Network Operations Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The Role: 11:11 is looking for a Network Operations Engineer whose primary responsibility will be to assist with providing 24/7 monitoring, technical support, implementation, and escalation for our global network infrastructure with a focus on 11:11 Systems Connectivity Solutions and Managed Network Solutions.
jobs.description:
The Role:
11:11 is looking for a Network Operations Engineer whose primary responsibility will be to assist with providing 24/7 monitoring, technical support, implementation, and escalation for our global network infrastructure with a focus on 11:11 Systems Connectivity Solutions and Managed Network Solutions. We are looking for someone who is a team player, detail oriented, and has excellent customer service skills with a solid hands-on technical background as a Network Engineer in previous roles. Both written and verbal communication skills are critical to this role.
This is a full-time remote role, based in the United States, reporting to the Manager, Network Operations.

Responsibilities:
• Assist with the configuration, installation, maintenance, and upgrade of Fortinet, Cisco and Palo Alto next generation firewall devices supporting 11:11 customers and internal network infrastructure.
• Support existing customer facing networks and assist senior engineers with network expansion, hardware refresh, and connectivity solution efforts.
• Implement system and network configurations in compliance with corporate security policies and security best practices.
• Support technology solutions, such as SDWAN, MPLS, Wired and Wireless Connectivity solutions (Layer 2 and Layer 3), Firewalls, Routers, Switches, and Load Balancers in accordance with best practices and company policies.
• Perform day-to-day lifecycle management of Cradlepoint wireless edge devices via Ericsson NetCloud Manager (formerly NetCloud ECM), including device onboarding and provisioning, configuration group management, NetCloud OS firmware upgrades, and licensing/subscription tracking.
• Provide break/fix support and change management for Cradlepoint deployments, including troubleshooting cellular (LTE/5G) WAN connectivity and carrier-related issues, coordinating hardware RMAs, and implementing configuration changes through NetCloud Manager in accordance with established change control processes.
• Provide multi-layered technical support to our customer base using services supported through our Network Operations Center.
• Review and resolve anomalies that are potentially service impacting. Escalate to senior engineering resources or management if necessary.
• Escalate complex customer issues to senior engineering resources while maintaining ownership through resolution.
• Serve as a liaison with customers, vendors, and other third-party providers to troubleshoot issues.
• Accurately track issues in the ticketing system while providing timely updates to customers on progress and resolutions.
• Obtain and maintain technical certifications to further knowledge of products and services offered by the company.
• Work supportively with colleagues, operating in a manner that is consistent with 11:11’s Code of Business Ethics and Company Values.
• Responsibly receive, transmit, and handle company data and information per Company data handling agreements, work procedures and policies.
• Review and follow company policies and guidelines, data privacy practices, including annual compliance training certification and policy acknowledgements.

• Additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's or University degree in a related field of study or an equivalent 5+ years of related work experience required.
• Solid understanding of the OSI model with hands-on network troubleshooting experience using debug commands, packet captures, and routing and path analysis.
• Hands-on experience with configuration and troubleshooting of Cisco ASA/Firepower and Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center, Fortinet FortiGate Firewalls and Fortinet Product Suite including Fortinet Access-Points and Fortinet Switches.
• Experience with Cisco Routers and Switches; exposure to Cisco Nexus Switches preferred.
• Familiarity with Juniper Switches (EX/QFX), Routers, and Firewalls (SRX).
• Familiarity with Palo Alto Firewalls and Panorama.
• Experience supporting and troubleshooting SD-WAN environments, with hands-on exposure to FortiGate SD-WAN implementations.
• Experience with configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting of Cradlepoint routers and wireless WAN solutions managed through Ericsson NetCloud Manager, including cellular (LTE/5G) connectivity troubleshooting.
• Working knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) with hands-on troubleshooting experience; exposure to IS-IS a plus.
• Familiarity with load balancers a plus; F5 (LTM/GTM) experience preferred.
• Exposure to VMware NSX-V and NSX-T a plus.
• Working knowledge of MPLS concepts and troubleshooting.
• Strong experience troubleshooting Layer 2 and Layer 3 issues.
• Exposure to AWS networking services (VPC, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect, Security Groups, NACLs) a plus.
• Exposure to Cloudflare services (DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS protection, Zero Trust/Access, Tunnel) a plus.
• Demonstrated customer focus with strong customer service skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take ownership of incidents and drive them through to resolution in a 24/7 operations environment.
• Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a team setting, including working across shifts and time zones and sharing knowledge with peers.
• Demonstrated learning agility and adaptability, with a willingness to acquire new skills and technologies as the network and customer needs evolve.
• Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE (e.g., NSE 4), Palo Alto PCNSE, or Cradlepoint certifications are preferred but not required.
• Must be legally eligible to work in assigned country without visa sponsorship.

Physical Requirements:
This is a primarily remote role that requires the ability to work for extended periods of time using a computer, keyboard, mouse, and standard office software and communication tools. The role requires the ability to participate in frequent virtual meetings (audio and video) and to communicate clearly in both written and verbal form. The position may require occasional work during evenings, nights, weekends, or holidays to support a 24/7 operations environment. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Compensation and Benefits at 11:11 Systems

The base salary for this role ranges from $ 74,00 to $ 83,000.

These ranges are informed by market data, internal equity, and qualifications required by job level. Actual pay is based on multiple factors, including skills, experience, certifications, and location.

Individuals may also be eligible for variable incentives such as bonuses or sales commissions, which are also based on level and position within the organization. Additional company-sponsored benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Comprehensive healthcare plan options
  • Retirement plan with company match
  • Life, other supplemental insurances
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • New Parent Leave
  • Wellness programs

jobs.title: Director of Membership (part-time)
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreAt Delve Deeper, we are a performance media agency specializing in the charity and nonprofit sector.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Delve Deeper, we are a performance media agency specializing in the charity and nonprofit sector. We partner with organizations that invest between $5 million and $20 million annually in media, helping mission-driven teams maximize their impact through advanced digital strategies that deliver measurable, scalable results.

Our capabilities span advanced reporting and analytics, intent-based audience segmentation, full-service digital media management, and personalized creative, providing our partners with a comprehensive, data-driven approach to growth.

Delve Deeper has been recognized as one of Built In Colorado’s “Best Places to Work” for five consecutive years, reflecting a culture that prioritizes both performance and people. We emphasize professional development and foster an environment where every team member can make a meaningful impact.

We are deeply committed to supporting our team members in their self-care, families, communities, and career growth. As a privately owned company, we move quickly, operate without unnecessary red tape, and create clear paths for advancement for those driven to succeed.

About The Giving Table

The Giving Table (TGT) brings together senior fundraising and marketing leaders from growth-minded nonprofits through thoughtfully curated peer groups. It offers C-suite leaders, Vice Presidents, and Directors a private space to bring their authentic selves to the table and openly discuss the personal and professional realities of nonprofit leadership.

Conversations may cover rising acquisition costs, board expectations, the impact of AI, donor lifetime value, attribution challenges, and the realities of leading through change. The topics vary, but the purpose remains the same: creating a trusted community where nonprofit leaders can learn from and support one another.

The Giving Table currently hosts gatherings in New York City, Washington, D.C., and Atlanta.

About the Role

We are looking for a relationship builder who fills the room and understands that the best business development often begins with trust, hospitality, and meaningful conversation.

As Director of Membership, you will own the full membership journey for The Giving Table. You will strengthen our prospect list, connect with the right leaders, extend thoughtful invitations, and determine who will be the best fit for each peer group.

Once members join, you will continue building those relationships, gradually moving each person from an initial introduction toward a broader commercial conversation with Delve Deeper when the timing is right.

You may be a Business Development Representative with a hospitality background or an events leader who has always understood that the real work is building relationships and generating revenue. Either way, you know how to make senior leaders feel welcome while maintaining a clear focus on growth and results.

You will report to the leader of The Giving Table and work closely with Delve Deeper’s marketing and client services teams.

What You Will Do

  • Build and maintain a highly targeted prospect list of Chief Development Officers, Chief Marketing Officers, Vice Presidents of Fundraising, Vice Presidents of Marketing, and other senior leaders at midsize and large nonprofits across the United States.
  • Grow membership in The Giving Table’s current markets, including New York City, Washington, D.C., and Atlanta.
  • Develop thoughtful, personalized outreach that reflects a genuine understanding of each prospect and their organization.
  • Leverage warm introductions, trusted industry relationships, and consistent follow-up to engage prospective members.
  • Curate peer groups of approximately seven to ten members, ensuring the right mix of organizations, cause areas, perspectives, and leadership experiences without placing direct competitors at the same table.
  • Own the member experience from initial invitation through attendance, including outreach, confirmations, restaurant selection, menu coordination, and other event logistics.
  • Attend select Giving Table dinners and events as a representative of Delve Deeper, strengthening relationships with members and ensuring a thoughtful, high-touch experience.
  • Work closely with our support team to manage invitations and RSVPs, keep prospect and member information current in HubSpot, and provide weekly pipeline reports.
  • Collaborate with internal hosts and facilitators to coordinate dinners, half-day sessions, off-sites, and salon-style conversations.
  • Work toward quarterly goals related to accepted members, event attendance, and membership growth.
  • Build referral networks by creating an experience members genuinely want to share with other leaders in their communities.
  • Develop relationships with the consultants, agencies, associations, and platform partners that serve the nonprofit fundraising community.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce engaged members to Delve Deeper’s client services team when the timing and need are right, without forcing the conversation.

Who You Are

  • You have at least three years of experience organizing high-touch development or relationship-building events for nonprofits, such as donor cultivation dinners, galas, advisory councils, major-gift roundtables, or capital campaign events. Comparable experience involving senior leaders in small, premium settings will also be considered.
  • You have existing relationships within the nonprofit sector, particularly with senior fundraising and marketing leaders, or you have successfully built a meaningful professional network from the ground up.
  • You understand the dual nature of this role. You care deeply about the quality of the experience, but you also recognize that the work must support measurable membership and commercial outcomes.
  • You bring strong business development instincts. You think in terms of pipelines, follow up consistently, and remain accountable to your goals.
  • You understand that the fortune is in the follow-up and know how to use HubSpot or a similar CRM to manage prospects, track activity, and maintain accurate reporting.
  • You are a thoughtful and persuasive written and verbal communicator who knows how to connect with a senior executive audience.
  • You are comfortable using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other prospecting tools to research and engage prospective members.
  • You stay informed about nonprofit fundraising and marketing trends and can confidently participate in conversations about topics such as iROI, donor lifetime value, CRM hygiene, acquisition costs, and attribution.
  • You exercise sound judgment and know how to build relationships without making interactions feel forced or transactional.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working within a nonprofit organization, ideally in development, fundraising, or marketing.
  • Experience hosting or supporting an executive peer group, mastermind, or invitation-only event series, such as YPO, Vistage, Chief, EO Forum, or a similar organization.
  • An established presence within professional fundraising communities such as AFP, NTEN, Bridge, Nonprofit Tech for Good, or Fundraising.AI.

Location

This is a fully remote, part-time position open to candidates located in the United States. Because The Giving Table currently operates in New York City, Washington, D.C., and Atlanta, preference will be given to candidates based in New York City or Washington, D.C.

Travel to select Giving Table dinners, events, and gatherings will be required.

Compensation

This part-time role offers an annual salary of $50,000–$70,000, plus a performance-based bonus tied to membership growth and downstream commercial outcomes. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and existing industry relationships.

Delve Deeper is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity enriches the workplace, and we are committed to growing our team with the most talented and passionate people from every community. Delve Deeper strives to create a culture of unity and respect. To that end, we have a zero-tolerance policy for behavior that promotes harassment, hate, or discrimination of any kind. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals. If you require assistance during the application process due to a disability.

Salary: $50,000 - $70,000

As a ML Researcher at Nex, you will develop new machine learning models and algorithms that push the boundaries of computational perception and interaction on Nex Playground. You will join a small, deeply technical team that combines research and engineering to solve complex problems in sensing, understanding, and multimodal interaction.

The ML Research role emphasizes rapid experimentation, exploring new ideas and methods to expand what our platform can sense, understand, and respond to. You will work within the ML Research group, collaborating closely with ML Engineers who build the infrastructure that accelerates your research.

This role is ideal for researchers who want to see their work directly impact product capabilities while maintaining a focus on cutting-edge innovation.

The Mindset

You are driven by curiosity and technical discovery. You see research as a systematic process of exploration and validation, not just theoretical work. You balance scientific rigor with practical impact, knowing that the best research solves real problems. You thrive in a team that values experimentation velocity and measurable technical improvement.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop novel ML models and algorithms for computational perception and interaction
  • Design and execute rapid experiments to validate new ideas and methods
  • Explore advancements in computer vision, audio processing, sensor fusion, or related domains
  • Collaborate with ML Engineers to integrate research outcomes into training pipelines and production systems
  • Measure and track experimentation velocity, the number and quality of validated experiments per quarter
  • Contribute to research planning and help define the technical roadmap alongside the Engineering Manager and Tech Lead
  • Document research findings and communicate technical progress to the broader team

Must Have

  • 2+ years of hands-on ML research experience in industry, academia, or research labs
  • Demonstrable track record of designing and conducting ML experiments from hypothesis to validation
  • Proficiency in Python for ML research and experimentation
  • Deep expertise with PyTorch or TensorFlow for model development
  • Experience training and evaluating ML models on real datasets
  • Understanding of model evaluation metrics, experimental design, and statistical validation
  • Familiarity with data preprocessing, augmentation, and management for ML workflows
  • Experience presenting research findings to technical audiences

Nice To Have

  • Expertise in real-time inference, model optimization, or efficient architectures
  • Experience with self-supervised learning, few-shot learning, or foundation models
  • Background in multimodal learning combining vision, audio, and sensor data
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or released research code
  • Experience collaborating with engineers to productionize research outcomes
  • Familiarity with ML Engineering practices: training pipelines, experiment tracking, MLOps
  • Background in edge computing, on-device ML, or resource-constrained environments
  • Experience with sensing technologies: cameras, microphones, IMUs, or haptic systems
  • Knowledge of privacy-preserving ML, federated learning, or on-device data processing

We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Flexible working hours and vacation policy.
  • Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth.
  • Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field
