jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (Early Career)

Location: Canada (Remote or Hybrid)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Build technology that solves real business problems.

At Hiveway, we believe software should make work simpler—not more complicated.

We build payment and revenue automation solutions that help organizations modernize how they collect payments, connect business systems, and eliminate manual processes.

We're looking for curious, ambitious engineers at the beginning of their careers who want more than a traditional software development role.

If you're excited by solving real customer problems, building production software, and learning directly from experienced engineers while working with enterprise customers, we'd love to meet you.

What is a Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer?

A Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (FDSE) combines software engineering, solution architecture, and customer problem-solving into one role.

Instead of working only from a product backlog, you'll work alongside customers to understand how their business operates, identify technical challenges, and help build solutions that create measurable business impact.

You'll learn how software, payments, APIs, data, finance, and business operations come together to solve real-world problems.

No two projects are exactly the same—which means you'll constantly learn, grow, and be challenged.

What You'll Do

Working alongside experienced engineers and mentors, you'll help:

  • Build production software and customer solutions
  • Design and develop API integrations
  • Connect payment, CRM, ERP, and accounting systems
  • Automate manual business processes
  • Design data workflows and reconciliation logic
  • Investigate and resolve production issues
  • Participate in customer discovery sessions
  • Translate business challenges into technical solutions
  • Improve existing platform capabilities
  • Document and share technical best practices

You'll work across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and directly with customers.

What You'll Learn

This role is designed to accelerate your career.

During your first year you'll gain experience in:

  • Software engineering best practices
  • Solution architecture
  • API design and integrations
  • Payment technologies
  • Cloud applications
  • Production operations
  • Customer discovery
  • Enterprise software implementation
  • Systems thinking
  • Technical communication

You'll receive mentorship while taking on meaningful responsibility from day one.

What We're Looking For

You don't need to know everything.

We're looking for people with strong fundamentals and an eagerness to learn.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Love solving difficult problems
  • Enjoy learning new technologies
  • Ask thoughtful questions
  • Communicate clearly
  • Take ownership of your work
  • Like understanding how businesses operate
  • Enjoy collaborating with both technical and non-technical people
  • Are curious about APIs, integrations, automation, or cloud software
  • Want to see your work used by real customers

Minimum Qualifications

We're interested in candidates who are completing or have recently completed a degree or diploma in areas such as:

  • Computer Science
  • Software Engineering
  • Computer Engineering
  • Systems Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mathematics
  • Data Science
  • Information Systems
  • Physics
  • Mechatronics

Equivalent technical experience is also welcome.

You should also have:

  • Experience programming in at least one modern language
  • Understanding of software engineering fundamentals
  • Familiarity with Git
  • Basic understanding of APIs, databases, or web applications
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills

Programming languages may include:

  • TypeScript / JavaScript
  • Python
  • Java
  • C#
  • Go
  • C++
  • Or another modern language

Bonus Points

We're especially interested if you've:

  • Completed internships or co-op placements
  • Built applications people actually use
  • Created personal or open-source projects
  • Participated in hackathons
  • Worked with APIs
  • Built full-stack applications
  • Worked at a startup
  • Automated repetitive work
  • Built something outside the classroom

We care much more about what you've built than where you've built it.

How We Work

At Hiveway we believe:

Start with the problem.

Understand the customer before designing the solution.

Build for production.

Reliable software beats clever software.

Stay curious.

The best engineers are always learning.

Own outcomes.

We take responsibility for solving problems—not just completing tasks.

Keep improving.

Every customer teaches us something that makes our platform better.

Your First 90 Days

You'll receive structured onboarding, mentorship, and regular feedback.

During your first three months you'll:

  • Learn Hiveway's platform and development environment
  • Shadow customer meetings
  • Contribute production code
  • Build your first integration or workflow
  • Participate in architecture discussions
  • Learn our engineering standards
  • Work with experienced engineers on customer implementations

As your confidence grows, so will your ownership.

What Success Looks Like

Successful engineers at Hiveway:

  • Ask great questions
  • Learn quickly
  • Build reliable software
  • Communicate effectively
  • Solve customer problems
  • Take ownership
  • Continuously improve
  • Help others succeed

Why Join Hiveway?

Large companies often give new graduates a very small piece of a very large system.

At Hiveway, you'll see the entire picture.

You'll learn directly from experienced engineers, work with enterprise customers, contribute to production systems, and influence how our platform evolves.

You'll gain experience across engineering, product, customer solutions, and business operations while helping solve meaningful problems for growing organizations.

If you want a role where your work matters from the beginning, Hiveway is the place to build your career.

Compensation & Benefits

Expected base salary:

CAD $85,000 – $105,000

Actual compensation will depend on your experience, internships, technical skills, and demonstrated capabilities.

Our total rewards package may include:

  • Performance-based incentives
  • Equity participation
  • Health and dental benefits
  • Paid vacation
  • Professional development budget
  • Home office and technology support
  • Mentorship and career development
  • Flexible remote/hybrid work

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your resume (PDF preferred)
  • GitHub, portfolio, or personal website (if available)

We don't expect you to know everything.

We're interested in what you've built, what you've learned, and how you approach solving difficult problems.

Equal Opportunity

Hiveway is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people are evaluated based on their skills, potential, curiosity, and ability to contribute.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

If you're excited about building great software, solving real customer problems, and growing alongside an experienced team, we'd love to hear from you.

Salary: 80-110k

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position, open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue.
  • Spanish speaker required (verbal and written)
  • Must be located in Mexico

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity
  • Experience selling into Mexico or Latin America
  • Ability to think strategically and creatively in a new market
  • Excellent understanding of business acumen for emerging markets
  • Ability to manage logistics of selling into Mexico from North America

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Data Governance and Data Analytics Presales Solution Architect

About Centrilogic

Centrilogic is a global provider of Cloud, Data, AI, and Managed Services. We help organizations modernize systems, build secure and scalable analytics architectures, and operationalize data platforms that deliver measurable business outcomes across the Microsoft ecosystem, including Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Purview, and AI-powered analytics.

Role Overview

The Data Presales Solution Architect is a senior client-facing role at the intersection of data strategy, analytics architecture, and consultative sales. This person serves as CentriLogic’s lead technical voice for data engagements, translating client challenges into practical, commercially viable solutions built on Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Purview, Power BI, Copilot capabilities, and the broader Azure data platform.

You will lead presales engagements from discovery through proposal delivery in partnership with Account Executives, SMEs, and delivery teams. Work includes governance assessments, analytics modernization, platform consolidation, real-time intelligence, managed services positioning, and AI-readiness programs built on a governed and trusted data foundation.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on Microsoft data platform experience with strong consultative presales skills and executive presence. They can engage credibly with business and technical stakeholders, bring clarity to complex decisions, and apply AI acceleration responsibly with sound governance, validation, security, and engineering judgment.

Primary Responsibilities

Solution Architecture Development

  • Design end-to-end data platforms on Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Lakeflow Connect, Spark, semantic models, and Real-Time Intelligence where needed.
  • Architect governance solutions with Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog, including cataloging, lineage, quality, classification, protection, and governed access across multi-source data estates.

Sales Support

  • Contribute reusable assets, intellectual property, and internal enablement to strengthen the Data practice.

Experience

  • 3+ years in presales, solution architecture, or a customer-facing advisory role.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise data platforms with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, or comparable modern analytics platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog or equivalent governance tools for cataloging, metadata, lineage, and control frameworks.
  • Practical experience enabling semantic models, metadata, and governance for Copilot, natural-language query, and agentic access patterns.
  • Strong track record leading discovery, writing proposals, sizing engagements, delivering executive presentations, and advancing deals.

Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)

Preferred:

  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Core Skills

Microsoft Fabric Platform

  • Strong Microsoft Fabric expertise across OneLake, workspaces, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Spark, Data Science, semantic models, capacity planning, and tenant governance.

  • Practical use of Copilot in Fabric, developer productivity patterns, and conversational analytics through data agents and natural-language query experiences.

Azure Databricks Platform

Presales and Client Engagement

Additional Qualifications (Nice to Have)

Microsoft Ecosystem Depth

  • Familiarity with DataOps, infrastructure as code, and agile delivery practices.

  • Awareness of managed infrastructure, managed security, and managed productivity service models.

CACI is seeking a Senior Consultant (Legacy System Export Developer for PeopleSoft and Oracle E‑Business Suite HCM) to support a large federal HCM modernization initiative. You will help migrate federal civilian employee records from legacy HR systems into Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM across multiple agencies. This is a remote role with limited travel and high impact on mission outcomes. You will own extraction, validation, and transformation of HR data; map legacy schemas to Oracle Fusion HCM Data Loader formats; and ensure all extracts meet EHRI standards and data quality thresholds needed for successful migration.

Responsibilities

  • Develop SQL and PL/SQL extraction programs to export employee data from PeopleSoft HRMS and Oracle EBS HCM databases, covering personal data, job history, compensation, benefits, positions, and organizational structures.

  • Analyze agency‑specific configurations and custom fields; produce comprehensive mapping from legacy schemas to Oracle Fusion HCM HDL file formats.

  • Build PeopleSoft Application Designer and Application Engine processes that deliver automated, repeatable extraction routines supporting iterative mock migrations and final cutover.

  • Develop Oracle EBS concurrent programs and extraction packages to ensure complete export of HR, payroll, and benefits data.

  • Create SQR reports and validation queries to verify extraction completeness, integrity, and EHRI compliance prior to ETL handoff.

  • Design and execute data profiling to identify data quality issues, orphaned records, incomplete fields, and customizations that require special treatment.

  • Maintain PeopleSoft and EBS legacy environments used for extraction development and testing, including schema refreshes, access management, and performance tuning for large‑volume exports.

  • Collaborate with agency legacy system administrators to understand custom configurations, interfaces, and dependencies that influence extraction scope and sequencing.

  • Develop reconciliation procedures comparing legacy record counts and key elements to extraction outputs to ensure zero data loss.

  • Document extraction procedures, mapping specifications, and known data quality issues per SAFe Agile artifact standards.

  • Support cutover activities during go‑live events, executing final extraction runs, validating outputs, and resolving extraction issues within tight windows.

  • Apply established methods and standards to independently resolve functional and technical issues of moderate scope; consult senior staff on complex or unfamiliar problems.

  • Communicate clearly with project team members and stakeholders to report progress, explain technical approaches, and support collaborative problem solving across Agile Release Train ceremonies.

Qualifications — Required

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of relevant experience (additional experience may substitute for degree).

  • 5 or more years of experience in database development, data extraction, or database administration for enterprise HR systems.

  • 3 or more years of hands‑on experience with PeopleSoft HRMS (Application Designer, Application Engine, PeopleCode, SQR) and/or Oracle E‑Business Suite HCM (concurrent programs, PL/SQL packages, HR module tables).

  • Strong SQL and PL/SQL development skills; experience writing complex extraction queries against large HR databases with more than 100,000 records.

  • Experience mapping legacy HR schemas to target system formats for migration projects.

  • Knowledge of HR data domains including demographics, job history, position management, compensation, and benefits.

  • Experience with data validation, profiling, and data quality assessment.

  • Familiarity with Agile and SAFe methodologies and iterative migration approaches, including mock conversion cycles.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (U.S. Citizenship required).

Qualifications — Desired

  • 7 or more years of experience in legacy HR system data extraction and migration, with specific experience on federal HR system modernization projects.

  • PeopleSoft tools and technology expertise (PeopleTools 8.5x, Application Engine, Component Interface, Integration Broker).

  • Oracle DBA certification (Oracle Certified Professional).

  • Direct experience with EHRI data standards and federal personnel data reporting requirements.

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion HCM Data Loader and HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader file specifications.

  • Knowledge of federal HR data elements including Nature of Action codes, Standard Form 50 data, and position classification structures.

  • Experience delivering large‑scale migrations of 500,000 or more employee records across varied source systems.

  • Experience with Oracle Cloud technologies such as Oracle Integration Cloud and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in enterprise HCM or ERP environments.

Work Location and Travel

Primarily remote; up to 10 percent travel for agency‑by‑agency migration support during the contract period.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. $75,200-$158,100

jobs.description:
About Ratehub & the Role

WHO IS RATEHUB?

We’re a company on a mission. We are a unique Canadian Fintech that is the one-stop shop for all financial needs of the consumer: Save, Spend, Borrow, Invest, and Protect. Every single team member — from Product & Engineering to Sales & Marketing, Finance, Operations, and everything in between — is obsessed with one thing: helping Canadians make better financial choices. And we’re pretty great at it, too. Via our digital application technology and our award-winning in-house brokerages, we help over 2M Canadians per month make a positive impact on their finances. We have many unique businesses: a mortgage brokerage, a life insurance brokerage, a home and auto insurance brokerage, a mortgage originations and servicing business, a Financial Services Marketplace, and a content business across Ratehub and MoneySense. 365 days a year, we deliver our users the best online mortgage experience, personalized credit card and loan options, and cheaper auto and home insurance policies than they typically get from their existing financial adviser.

Changing how people make financial choices isn’t easy, though. We know that achieving our mission is full of challenges — challenges that can be complex and often unexpected but that are always interesting, rewarding, and fun to solve as a team. This is where you come in. We are on the hunt for the right candidate to join us and help lead us forward to continued growth.

We’re looking for an experienced, strategic, and commercially minded Director of Marketing to lead our marketing function for a 12-month contract.

This is a senior leadership role with end-to-end accountability for Ratehub’s marketing function, spanning paid marketing, brand, content, PR, social, email, and cross-sell. You’ll set the strategy, priorities, and investment approach across these areas, while leading a multidisciplinary team and partnering closely with senior leadership and business unit leaders across Mortgages, Insurance, and Everyday Banking, as well as Product, Partnerships, Analytics, and Development.

The Director of Marketing will be accountable for building and executing an integrated marketing strategy that strengthens the Ratehub brand, drives qualified leads, supports profitable customer acquisition, increases customer lifetime value, and contributes directly to business growth.

This is a leadership role, but not a hands-off one. You’ll set the vision and strategic direction, establish priorities, allocate resources, develop the team, and hold the marketing organization accountable for results. At the same time, you’ll stay close to the work, directly manage and coach your team, and step in when needed to solve problems, make decisions, unblock progress, or drive high-priority initiatives forward. You’ll lead through your team and cross-functional partners, while being willing to roll up your sleeves when the business requires it.

Your Overall Accountabilities

  • Marketing Strategy & Growth: Own Ratehub’s integrated marketing strategy and translate company and business unit targets and priorities into measurable growth.
  • Lead Generation & Revenue: Own marketing’s contribution to qualified lead generation across Mortgages, Insurance, and Everyday Banking, with clear targets for volume, quality, conversion, and commercial impact.
  • Paid Marketing & Profitability: Own the strategic direction and commercial performance of Paid Marketing, with accountability for delivering qualified leads at a target ROAS that supports profitable growth.
  • Content, Social & GEO: Lead an innovative content and social strategy that strengthens Ratehub’s authority and keeps the brand ahead of the rapidly evolving search and discovery landscape, including Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI-powered search.
  • Brand & PR: Build Ratehub’s brand, reputation, and authority as a trusted source of financial information, leading PR, communications, thought leadership, and brand initiatives.
  • Customer Engagement & Cross-sell: Lead the strategy for Email/CRM, customer engagement, and cross-sell, including initiatives that support Ratehub’s membership mandate and connect customers with relevant products throughout their journeys.
  • Partnerships & Distribution: Support business unit leaders in developing BU-specific affiliate and strategic partnerships, while directly owning firmwide partnerships and mortgage affiliate partnerships.
  • Budget & Resource Allocation: Own the overall marketing budget and allocate investment across paid media, content, agencies, freelancers, partnerships, and other marketing initiatives based on business impact and strategic priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Performance: Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing marketing team; set clear expectations, foster accountability, and ensure the organization is focused on its highest-impact opportunities.

What That Looks Like

Lead Marketing Strategy & Growth

  • Own and execute Ratehub’s overall marketing strategy across brand, acquisition, engagement, retention, and cross-sell.
  • Translate company and business unit objectives into clear marketing priorities, strategies, and measurable goals.
  • Develop an integrated roadmap across owned, earned, and paid channels.
  • Partner with business unit leaders to understand growth priorities, target audiences, and lead requirements, and translate these into effective marketing strategies.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs for lead volume, quality, conversion, customer acquisition, and revenue.
  • Identify opportunities to grow qualified traffic, leads, customers, and revenue across Ratehub’s core verticals.
  • Foster a culture of testing, experimentation, and continuous optimization.
  • Balance short-term performance with longer-term brand building and customer growth.
  • Stay ahead of consumer, market, competitive, and industry trends, and translate them into actionable opportunities.
  • Communicate marketing performance, opportunities, and challenges to senior leadership.

Brand & Communications

  • Own Ratehub’s brand strategy, positioning, voice, and marketing narrative across channels and sub-brands.
  • Set the PR and communications strategy, including proactive media relations, reactive commentary, thought leadership, and corporate storytelling.
  • Build Ratehub’s profile and credibility as a trusted authority in Canadian personal finance and a one-stop shop for financial needs.
  • Oversee major brand campaigns, launches, and integrated marketing initiatives.
  • Ensure brand-building activity supports broader business and lead-generation objectives.
  • Leverage Ratehub’s data, insights, and expertise to generate compelling stories and media coverage.

Lead Content Marketing, Innovation & GEO

  • Provide strategic leadership and direction to the Content Marketing team, ensuring content supports both brand authority and business growth.
  • Establish a forward-looking content strategy that positions Ratehub at the forefront of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and emerging AI-powered search and discovery.
  • Ensure Ratehub’s content is optimized not only to rank in traditional search, but to be discovered, surfaced, and cited by generative AI platforms and answer engines.
  • Encourage experimentation with new content formats, data, tools, expert-led content, and other approaches that strengthen Ratehub’s authority and visibility.
  • Ensure the team leverages Ratehub’s proprietary expertise, data, and subject-matter experts to create original, authoritative, and genuinely useful content.
  • Establish clear measurement frameworks for content performance, including organic visibility, AI visibility, qualified traffic, lead generation, and contribution to business growth.
  • Build strong collaboration between Content and the broader marketing organization so content supports PR, brand, social, email, partnerships, and paid acquisition.

Email, CRM & Cross-sell

  • Own the strategy for Email/CRM as a key channel for customer engagement, conversion, retention, lead generation, and revenue.
  • Develop lifecycle marketing strategies that move prospects and customers through the funnel and increase engagement over time.
  • Lead cross-sell strategies that connect customers with relevant products across Mortgages, Insurance, Everyday Banking, and other Ratehub offerings.
  • Develop segmentation and personalization strategies to improve customer experience, conversion, and customer lifetime value.
  • Identify opportunities to generate incremental leads and revenue by connecting audiences across Ratehub’s business units.
  • Partner with Product and business unit leaders to embed cross-sell opportunities throughout key customer journeys, both online and offline.
  • Establish clear KPIs and reporting for CRM, cross-sell, lead generation, and retention initiatives.

Paid & Performance Marketing

  • Set the strategy for paid acquisition across search, social, display, retargeting, and other performance channels.
  • Own performance marketing against lead-generation targets across Ratehub’s three main business units, ensuring media investment delivers qualified leads at sustainable acquisition costs.
  • Hold the function accountable to a target ROAS and optimize investment based on lead quality, conversion, revenue, and channel economics.
  • Evaluate attribution, customer acquisition costs, and lead quality to inform investment decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to diversify acquisition and test new channels, platforms, and approaches.
  • Ensure paid marketing works cohesively with content, partnerships, and brand initiatives.
  • Work closely with internal teams and external agency partners to ensure strong execution and performance.

Affiliate & Strategic Partnerships

  • Own the strategy for affiliate marketing and strategic distribution partnerships.
  • Support business unit leaders in identifying and developing BU-specific affiliate and strategic partnerships.
  • Directly identify and develop firmwide partnerships and mortgage affiliate partnerships that expand Ratehub’s reach and generate qualified leads and revenue.
  • Develop mutually beneficial campaigns, integrations, and distribution opportunities across Ratehub’s business units.
  • Evaluate partnership performance based on lead volume, lead quality, conversion, and revenue.
  • Allocate resources toward the highest-impact partnership opportunities.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Directly manage, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary marketing team.
  • Set clear goals, priorities, and accountability across marketing functions.
  • Build a high-performance culture where teams are empowered to execute and accountable for business outcomes.
  • Ensure the team is focused on the highest-impact initiatives and has the capabilities and resources needed to succeed.
  • Step into complex, high-priority initiatives when needed to solve problems, unblock teams, and drive execution.
  • Foster a culture of creativity, collaboration, experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization and effectively influence cross-functional teams.
  • Manage external agencies, contractors, and partners to ensure high-quality execution and delivery.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of marketing experience, with significant experience leading multiple marketing functions.
  • Previous experience in a senior marketing leadership role, ideally in a high-growth, digital-first, technology, financial services, or consumer business.
  • A proven track record of developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive measurable customer acquisition and revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated experience owning lead-generation targets and delivering qualified leads across multiple products, audiences, or business lines.
  • Strong understanding of the full customer journey, from awareness and acquisition through conversion, retention, and cross-sell.
  • Experience directly managing and developing high-performing marketing teams.
  • Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with the ability to connect marketing activity to business outcomes.
  • Experience managing significant marketing budgets and making data-driven investment decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with executives, media, partners, and internal teams.
  • Strong prioritization skills, with the ability to make decisions and focus resources on the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly.
  • Highly collaborative and able to influence cross-functional teams without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing, emerging platforms, and changing consumer behaviour.
  • Experience in financial services, fintech, marketplaces, comparison businesses, or other highly regulated industries is an asset.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

  • A clear, integrated marketing strategy tied directly to Ratehub’s company and business-unit growth objectives.
  • A consistent, measurable pipeline of qualified leads across Mortgages, Insurance, and Everyday Banking.
  • Marketing investment becomes increasingly efficient and data-driven, with clear visibility into ROI, channel performance, and commercial impact.
  • CRM, cross-sell, and customer engagement initiatives drive stronger customer lifetime value, lead generation, and revenue.
  • Ratehub continues to strengthen its brand, authority, and visibility, with Content, PR, Social, and GEO working together to expand reach and influence discovery.
  • Marketing operates as one cohesive, high-performing organization, with clear priorities, strong accountability, and effective collaboration across business units and functions.
  • New ideas, channels, and opportunities are tested quickly and scaled based on performance, keeping Ratehub ahead of changes in consumer behaviour, technology, and the competitive landscape.

CULTURE FIT:

Members first - we prioritise the interests and needs of our members above all else.We solve member pain points and focus on member satisfaction. We start with members, and end with the P&L.

Growth mindset - we set ambitious goals and challenge the status quo. We take responsible risks and are accountable for our actions.

Better together - we are One team with One common goal. We make our footprint bigger than our foot, leave our egos at the door, support each other to achieve great results as One company.

Run after problems - we tackle problems head on and focus on finding solutions. Obstacles are seen as opportunities for growth and innovation. We have the hard conversations and choose the harder right over the easier wrong. And we do it with a smile.

Measure Learn Iterate Innovate - we focus on getting things done. We measure what matters, iterate, learn, iterate many times in a data-driven way, which is how we will innovate.

JOB PERKS:

Competitive Compensation: A salary that reflects your experience and the Canadian market.

Remote-First Environment: The flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada, with occasional in-person team gatherings for collaboration.

Flexible Hours: Autonomy to manage your schedule to support work-life balance.

Professional Development: An individual training allowance to help you grow your skills and career.

Team Socials: Regular events, both remote and in-person, to build connections across the organization.

The estimated salary range for this position is $165,000 – $185,000.

Guidewire Technical Consultant – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Guidewire Technical Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Guidewire Technical Consultant to deliver configuration, integration, and customization across the Guidewire Insurance Suite — PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter — and Guidewire Cloud. The role focuses on hands-on Gosu development, integration design, product model configuration, and Guidewire Cloud upgrades, working closely with business analysts and SMEs to ship reliable insurance-platform features. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Guidewire work in production for insurance carriers and understands the trade-offs that come with deep platform customization. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Five or more years of Guidewire development experience.
  • Deep expertise in Gosu programming and Guidewire data model.
  • Hands-on experience with PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, or ClaimCenter customization.
  • Strong understanding of product model and rule design.
  • Experience building Guidewire integrations (messaging, batch, plugin).
  • Familiarity with Guidewire Cloud Platform.
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of Guidewire database schema.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Guidewire ACE certifications.
  • Experience with Guidewire Cloud upgrades.
  • Familiarity with Guidewire Digital portals or DataHub/InfoCenter.
  • Insurance domain expertise across P&C lines.
  • Experience with reinsurance, policy administration, or claims modernization programs.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

jobs.description:
Ruby on Rails Developer – Rails, PostgreSQL, APIs & Sidekiq

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Ruby on Rails Developer to build, maintain, and optimize scalable production web applications and APIs.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, background jobs, performance, and clean, well-tested code.

You’ll work with product and engineering teams to ship reliable features, improve application performance, and maintain systems built for scale.

What You’ll Own

Ruby on Rails Development

  • Build and maintain production Ruby on Rails applications
  • Develop backend services, business logic, and internal tools
  • Work with Ruby, Rails, ActiveRecord, and MVC architecture
  • Build reusable, maintainable services following Rails best practices
  • Integrate with front-end technologies such as Stimulus, React, or Vue.js

APIs & Integrations

  • Design and maintain RESTful APIs
  • Integrate third-party APIs, SaaS platforms, and payment systems
  • Build and maintain webhooks and background synchronization jobs
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and rate limiting

PostgreSQL & Background Jobs

  • Design and maintain PostgreSQL/MySQL schemas
  • Optimize SQL queries, indexes, and database performance
  • Build asynchronous workflows using Sidekiq/Resque
  • Work with Redis and caching strategies to improve performance

Testing & Code Quality

  • Write unit, integration, and system tests using RSpec, Minitest, or Capybara
  • Maintain clean, readable, and well-tested code
  • Participate in code reviews and CI/CD workflows
  • Help reduce technical debt and improve long-term maintainability

Performance, Security & Reliability

  • Troubleshoot production issues and performance bottlenecks
  • Improve API response times and background job performance
  • Follow secure development and OWASP best practices
  • Monitor application health using tools such as New Relic, Datadog, Honeybadger, or Rollbar

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Ruby on Rails development experience
  • Strong proficiency in Ruby, Rails, ActiveRecord, and MVC
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL
  • Experience building and integrating REST APIs
  • Experience with Sidekiq or Resque
  • Familiarity with Redis, caching, and background processing
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong understanding of scalable backend application development
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable working remotely during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • React, Vue.js, or Stimulus experience
  • AWS, GCP, or Heroku deployment experience
  • SaaS, fintech, healthcare, or e-commerce background
  • Experience with Devise or OmniAuth
  • Experience optimizing high-traffic Rails applications

What Success Looks Like

  • Reliable, production-ready features shipped on time
  • Clean and maintainable Rails code
  • Strong automated test coverage
  • Improved API and database performance
  • Fewer production errors and reduced technical debt
  • Stable and scalable application performance

Why Join

  • Work on real-world production Rails applications
  • Hands-on ownership of backend systems and APIs
  • Exposure to Rails, PostgreSQL, Sidekiq, Redis, cloud infrastructure, and performance optimization
  • Opportunity to influence technical architecture
  • Fully remote environment
  • Growth path into Senior Rails Engineer, Backend Engineer, Tech Lead, or Platform Engineering

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Technical Assessment – Rails API + Tests
  5. Client Engineering Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Ruby on Rails Developer who enjoys building scalable APIs, optimizing PostgreSQL applications, and writing clean production-grade code, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Data Products & Strategy
jobs.excerpt: Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own.
jobs.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

The Sr Manager Data Products & Strategy will lead the execution and ongoing management of data products within assigned data domains or areas of the organization. This role manages teams responsible for delivering governed, reusable, and high-value data products that enable critical business decisions within a highly regulated financial services environment. The Sr Manager partners closely with Technology, Analytics, Data Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Business stakeholders to translate data priorities into actionable product plans, coordinate delivery across teams, and ensure data products meet established business, quality, and regulatory requirements. This role also provides input into broader data product strategy while maintaining accountability for the performance, priorities, and results of assigned teams.

What you will do:

  • Provide input into data product strategy, standards, and objectives for assigned data domains or product areas, and translate broader data strategy and priorities into actionable product plans, roadmaps, and team deliverables.
  • Manage assigned data product portfolios, which may include advisor, customer, accounts, risk, operations, or other data domains.
  • Prioritize product initiatives based on business value, stakeholder needs, dependencies, risk, and available resources.
  • Adapt departmental plans and resources to address changing business priorities and delivery challenges.
  • Ensure product plans have clearly defined objectives, requirements, measures of success, and expected business outcomes.
  • Lead and manage a team of Data Product Managers and/or other professional-level employees.
  • Establish team priorities and ensure alignment with department and broader data product objectives.
  • Provide coaching, performance management, development, and ongoing guidance to direct reports.
  • Promote consistent practices for product discovery, requirements definition, documentation, prioritization, and delivery.
  • Build team capabilities and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement.
  • Make or recommend staffing and other personnel decisions in accordance with organizational policies.
  • Manage delivery of complex data products and initiatives within assigned domains or areas of responsibility.
  • Coordinate across data product, data engineering, analytics, technology, and business teams to achieve department objectives.
  • Identify and resolve delivery issues, resource constraints, dependencies, and competing priorities within assigned areas.
  • Escalate significant cross-functional risks or issues to department or sub-functional leadership when appropriate.
  • Monitor team execution against product roadmaps, milestones, service expectations, and established measures.
  • Ensure teams apply established product management practices and operating standards consistently.
  • Partner with Data Governance, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Security, Privacy, and Technology teams to implement required controls within assigned data products.
  • Ensure assigned data products comply with established requirements for privacy, data quality, lineage, auditability, retention, access, and other applicable controls.
  • Implement established data ownership, stewardship, and accountability practices within assigned domains.
  • Identify and escalate material data risks and support timely remediation.
  • Ensure product requirements appropriately incorporate regulatory, governance, and risk considerations throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Develop productive relationships with business, technology, analytics, risk, compliance, and data stakeholders.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, establish priorities, and translate requirements into data product outcomes.
  • Communicate product roadmaps, delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and value realization to department and sub-functional leadership.
  • Facilitate decisions across stakeholders when priorities or requirements compete.
  • Prepare materials and analyses related to assigned data product areas for leadership discussions and governance forums.
  • Establish and monitor success measures for assigned data products, including adoption, data quality, reliability, delivery performance, and business impact.
  • Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve existing data products, processes, and services.
  • Support business case development and track expected benefits and value realization for assigned initiatives.
  • Use product performance, stakeholder feedback, and business priorities to recommend changes to product plans and roadmaps.
  • Ensure assigned teams remain focused on measurable business outcomes and department objectives.

What you will bring:

  • 4 year degree or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in product management, data, analytics, technology, or related disciplines, including significant experience with data, analytics, or platform products.
  • 2 to 5+ years of management or people leadership experience, preferably leading professional-level employees and/or managers.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data platforms and modern data architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, and/or streaming technologies.
  • Understanding of analytics, business intelligence, metrics, and related data consumption patterns.
  • Experience with data governance practices, including metadata management, data lineage, data quality, privacy, and data controls.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional data or technology initiatives.
  • Ability to translate broader strategic priorities into actionable product plans and team deliverables.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.

What will set you apart:

  • Experience working in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience with cloud-native data ecosystems such as AWS, Snowflake, or Redshift.
  • Familiarity with data mesh, domain-oriented data product models, or similar modern data management practices.
  • Background in product management, analytics, engineering, data, or quantitative disciplines.
  • Experience preparing and presenting product information to senior leadership and governance forums.

This job operates in a professional office environment.

You will be evaluated in part based on your performance of the responsibilities and/or tasks listed in this job description. You may be required to perform other duties that are not included on this job description. The job description is not a contract for employment, and either you or the employer may terminate employment at any time, for any reason, as per terms and conditions of your employment contract.

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup

jobs.excerpt: Joining AbbVie means you will be part of a team of outstanding professionals dedicated to making a remarkable impact on patients' lives.
jobs.description:
Joining AbbVie means you will be part of a team of outstanding professionals dedicated to making a remarkable impact on patients' lives. At AbbVie, we conduct ground-breaking science on a global scale every day. AbbVie Canada is one of the Best Workplaces in Canada.

When choosing your career path, choose to be remarkable.

AbbVie’s mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people’s lives across several key therapeutic areas: immunology, oncology, neuroscience, vision care, virology, women’s health , and gastroenterology, in addition to products and services across its Allergan Aesthetics portfolio.

This is your opportunity to join our Linguistic Services team as a Senior Translator-Revisor. The incumbent will work remotely.  Your responsibilities as a Senior Translator-Revisor include translation from English to French of various types of medical, pharmaceutical, administrative, commercial and advertising texts, as well as documents intended for the media. You will also revise different texts, mainly in French, increasingly over time. You will be responsible for responding to consultation requests from all sectors of the company and for sharing your knowledge with the other members of the team. You will also assist the other members of the Linguistic Services team in managing departmental planning tasks.

Key responsibilities:

  • Translate documents from English into French, making sure to preserve the content, meaning and intent of the source text. The Senior Translator-Revisor must be able to work on various documents, some of which are highly scientific, as well as high-visibility documents about AbbVie’s products and activities.
  • Revise translations done internally, as well as by external providers, to ensure that wording and terminology are consistent and that the proper terminology is used.
  • Help plan, prioritize and manage all translation and revision requests.
  • Provide expert advice to internal clients and colleagues in order to optimize translated material, and consult with clients and colleagues when translating in specialized fields.
  • Collaboratively create and update glossaries, lexicons, style guides, etc.
  • Participate in the management of computer-assisted translation tools and keep abreast of all innovations.
  • Act as a liaison with translation service providers and strategic internal clients.
  • Suggest and develop initiatives that promote the use of French throughout the company, in connection with the Francofête in particular.
  • Participate in various tasks related to the company’s francization obligations.
  • Collaborate in the drafting and management of various documents related to the management and operation of Linguistic Services (standard operating procedures, coordination management guide, etc.), as needed.
  • Help represent the interests of AbbVie Canada with the various levels of AbbVie worldwide by ensuring that solutions implemented within Linguistic Services are in line with the requirements of the Canadian business.
  • Contribute to the optimization of resource use. Help resolve business problems by recommending practical solutions.
  • Support change and innovation in collaboration with the various strategic functions of the company.

Education/Experience required:

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA) in English-to-French translation or the equivalent. Relevant experience combined with good knowledge of the health or life sciences field (biotechnology/pharmaceutical industry, an asset).
  • Experience in English-to-French translation (minimum of ten years).
  • Experience in comparative English-to-French revision (minimum of five years).
  • Experience translating, updating and revising product monographs (drugs and medical devices).
  • Professional certification (OTTIAQ, ATIO or equivalent), an asset.
  • Strong attention to detail and respect for the value and quality of language.
  • Ability to think and plan strategically (work plans, activities, timetables, targeting) and execute with excellence.
  • Ability to build strong partnerships with key stakeholders.

Essential skills and abilities:

  • Ability to work under pressure and manage various projects simultaneously when necessary.
  • Ability to work independently to deliver quality documents and respect deadlines.
  • Excellent knowledge of industry-specific phraseology and terminology.
  • Strong sense of responsibility, high level of adaptability and strong curiosity.
  • Ease with technology in general (use of various tools/systems to perform day-to-day tasks).
  • Knowledge of LogiTerm, an asset.
  • Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, etc.).
  • Advanced proficiency in French, very good understanding of English, strong writing skills and impeccable style.

Key leadership competencies:

  • Self-confidence, independence, resourcefulness and a desire to learn.
  • Interpersonal skills, ability to interact well with individuals at all levels, both internal and external.
  • Ability to work at a multinational company.
  • Risk-based thinking paired with an innovative, analytical mindset.
  • Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with other members/managers. Clear understanding of ways of working and ability to ensure optimal and compliant interactions.
  • Strategic understanding and focus in verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to use strong analytical skills to solve business problems and think independently.
  • Ability to actively listen to internal stakeholders to understand their needs, issues and opinions.

AbbVie strives to provide a French working environment for its employees in Quebec. Although as part of its francization program has taken all reasonable steps to avoid imposing the following requirement, advanced amount of knowledge of English / Fluency in English is an essential requirement for the position of Translator - Revisor including, but not limited to, for the following reasons:

  • English speaking employees outside the province of Quebec.
  • English speaking clients outside the province of Quebec.
  • Anglophone region outside the province of Quebec.

jobs.description:
At NVIDIA, our employees are passionate about Artificial Intelligence, accelerated computing, and the transformation of industries through software and AI. We are seeking a highly technical and strategic Senior Developer Relations Manager – Manufacturing (EMEA) to engage and grow the developer ecosystem across industrial and manufacturing domains. In this role, you will work closely with developers, software vendors, startups, system integrators, and industrial enterprises to accelerate adoption of NVIDIA’s AI and accelerated computing platforms for manufacturing use cases. You will act as a trusted technical advisor and advocate—bridging the needs of the manufacturing developer community with NVIDIA’s engineering, product, and platform teams.

The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of industrial software ecosystems with strong technical credibility, developer advocacy skills, and a passion for enabling real‑world AI adoption in manufacturing environments.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor and advocate for the manufacturing and industrial developer ecosystem across EMEA, working closely with software developers, ISVs, startups, OEMs, and system integrators.

  • Accelerate adoption of NVIDIA technologies by demonstrating end‑to‑end solutions for manufacturing workloads such as robotics, digital twins, simulation, computer vision, quality inspection, predictive maintenance, and industrial AI.

  • Design and deliver technical enablement assets including sample code, reference architectures, demonstrations, workshops, and best‑practice guides tailored to manufacturing and industrial use cases.

  • Guide partners and developers through onboarding, integration, and optimization of NVIDIA platforms and programs, fostering co‑innovation and early technical success.

  • Engage deeply with partner engineering teams and technical leaders to understand requirements, solve complex technical challenges, and promote scalable, production‑ready implementations.

  • Map, track, and analyze the manufacturing developer ecosystem to identify gaps, opportunities, and emerging trends that inform NVIDIA’s adoption and engagement strategies.

  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with engineering, product management, solution architects, marketing, and sales to align developer feedback with product roadmaps and go‑to‑market initiatives.

  • Represent the voice of manufacturing developers internally, providing structured feedback from field engagements to influence platform capabilities, tooling, and documentation.

  • Support marketing and ecosystem programs by highlighting customer and partner success stories, contributing to technical content, events, launches, and industry forums.

What We Need to See:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years focused on industrial or manufacturing ecosystems.

  • Strong technical understanding of AI/ML applications in manufacturing, including robotics, simulation, digital twins, industrial vision, or data‑driven automation.

  • Familiarity with industrial software ecosystems, including ISVs, platforms, and solution stacks used in manufacturing environments.

  • Proven ability to lead complex technical engagements and collaborate across engineering, product, marketing, and partner organizations.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for audiences ranging from hands‑on developers to technical executives.

  • Passion for developer advocacy, ecosystem development, and working in fast‑paced, highly collaborative environments.

  • Coachability, intellectual curiosity, and a continuous learning mindset.

  • Strong written and spoken English; additional European languages are a plus.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Hands‑on experience building or deploying AI‑driven solutions for manufacturing or industrial use cases.

  • Familiarity with NVIDIA’s accelerated computing and AI stack (e.g., CUDA, Isaac, Omniverse, AI frameworks, simulation and robotics platforms).

  • Background in data science, robotics, industrial engineering, or related technical disciplines.

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling developer communities, technical programs, or ecosystem initiatives.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with experience working with startups or emerging technology partners in the manufacturing space.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Open Call - Soil Carbon Field Tech (Contract - Central US based)
jobs.excerpt: Overview Yard Stick is looking for a number of Soil Carbon Field Technicians to help us fight climate change with soil.
jobs.description:
Overview
Yard Stick is looking for a number of Soil Carbon Field Technicians to help us fight climate change with soil. This role is an essential part of Yard Stick’s primary on-the-ground operations, deploying our novel soil carbon measurement technology as well as traditional soil testing methodology on fields across the US. This is a contracted seasonal/part-time 1099 position. We are a small company with big ambitions, and therefore we need people who are highly entrepreneurial, reliable, comfortable with travel, and committed to working towards solving climate change.
Location flexible, and significant cross-country travel is required. Hourly pay (including pay for time spent travel), and travel expenses will be paid for.
About Yard Stick PBC
Yard Stick is a remote-first, seed-stage company, with founders based in Boston and Oakland. We are on a mission to reverse climate change with agriculture. Scientists and farmers alike know that climate-friendly agricultural practices have the potential to remove atmospheric CO2 at gigaton/year scale. When these practices are adopted, more carbon is stored in soils, improving soil health and fighting climate change. But significant measurement challenges have held soil carbon efforts back - until now.
By reducing the cost of soil carbon measurement by 90%+, Yard Stick will dramatically expand the opportunities for evidence-based regenerative practices to simultaneously improve ecosystem health, increase farmer income, and combat climate change.
Current soil carbon measurement technologies are slow, expensive, and cumbersome, relying on conventional soil cores and labs to quantify carbon stocks. In contrast, Yard Stick is fast and cheap - without sacrificing accuracy. As a testament to our technology’s potential, alongside our scientific collaborators, we were awarded a $3.6M grant from the DOE ARPA-E Smartfarm as well as other highly competitive grant programs which reward technical merit like NSF SBIR. For more background, check out some coverage in TechCrunch or Treehugger.
We've also raised money from top climate VCs, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures (Bill Gates' climate fund), Lowercarbon Capital (Chris and Crystal Sacca's climate fund), MCJ Collective, and others. Details of the financing aren’t announced in a press release or article, because that can feel a bit cart before the horse, but we're happy to share more detail about our funding when we chat.
About The Role
This Soil Carbon Tech role is critical to the success and rollout of Yard Stick’s offerings and works in-field across the country and a variety of project types to meet our R+D and client goals. The Yard Stick team and our client base is spread across the country, but our current focus is primarily in the Midwest. We’re growing quickly, and this position will be an essential role with significant responsibility.
You will be primarily responsible for testing our hardware and software in fields across the US to help us evaluate and improve our technology’s accuracy, durability, and usability. You will be leading projects geared towards calibrating our technology, as well as collecting measurements to quantify stocks on client lands using a variety of different methodologies.
You’ll provide feedback on hardware and software tools alike, as Yard Stick has innovative offerings in both domains. Obviously, when stuff breaks, you’ll document why and help us brainstorm ways to improve.
Yard Stick’s offerings combine a large number of disparate disciplines, including highly technical hardware, a web app which manages carbon measurement and GIS data, and ML pipelines which connect the two. This person ultimately will work cross-disciplinarily along with our hardware, software, soil science, and business teams alike to maximize the pace of Yard Stick’s R&D and therefore climate impact, so the ability to communicate clearly to a wide range of people is a must.
We need someone who can handle rigorous field work with efficiency and exceptional precision. The ideal candidate for this role is comfortable traveling, working outdoors, handling a wide array of equipment, and working in a team off 2-6 people through projects that can include rapid schedule changes, long days, and inclement weather.
Currently, Yard Stick is focused on proof of concept of our in situ spectral probe. Generating high-quality, publishable data requires excellent field operations. In parallel, we’re also creating our commercial offerings. This role will be crucial in carrying out both streams of work.

Qualifications - Must Have

  • Some combination of education and/or experience in natural sciences, agriculture, conservation, soil science, natural resource management or another related field of study. We don’t require formal education, but one way or another, you have the experience that’ll make you comfortable on farms and around producers, and are no stranger to having your hands in the dirt.
  • Extensive experience and comfort with physical field work. Experience working with your hands out in the field is key to this role. You don’t flinch at the idea of 8 hours in the sun moving from customer farm to farm, sometimes for two weeks straight.
  • Comfort with field tools, technologies and strategies. Our offerings use technologies like GPS, ATVs, and mobile app-based sample inventory tracking systems. You can drive an ATV, or you’re not afraid to learn. You use mechanical tools comfortably. Note: Yard Stick will provide a vehicle if you don’t have one for this role, or will generously reimburse if you do.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to craft. When you take a 30 cm soil core, it’s 30 cm. You care deeply about the details. You take written instructions well, triple-check your work by nature, and will follow an SOP to the letter. You are proud to do your work very well.
  • Strong personal independence and entrepreneurial autonomy. If you can’t get your boss on the phone, you figure it out. You assess the situation, consider solutions, make a plan, and execute, even if your closest coworker is 100 miles away.
  • Comfort with extended travel. Projects can often be in remote areas of the country -- spending a week or two at a time away from home is essential to this role.
  • Personal enthusiasm and comfort in agricultural contexts. You care about farming or ranching. The idea of helping activate agriculture to fight against climate change excites you. It matters to you that you’re working on a problem of existential significance.
  • Ability to share product feedback to improve systems. When you’re asked for feedback, you pay attention and communicate observations clearly, especially in writing. You document things carefully and are curious when using new products or technologies.
  • Existing permanent authorization to work in the United States.

Qualifications - Nice To Have

  • Personal, durable enthusiasm for the challenge of climate change.
  • Awareness of current issues in carbon markets - particularly carbon removal. You’ve heard of offsets/credits and some of the attendant criticism of low-quality projects of the past and present. You’ve got some basic knowledge about how carbon markets work, and you’ve heard about how carbon removal is a new, exciting, and controversial approach to climate challenges.
  • There will be a significant portion of the year that we’re not sampling, and we’re interested in other skills you can bring to the team! Specifically if you have any of the following, we’d love to hear about it: GIS or other mapping software; vehicle and equipment maintenance; equipment + logistics management; agricultural sales or similar; agronomy; data science, etc.

Compensation and Other Details

  • $30-40/hr to start, with travel expenses (including time) paid. Performance raise after a set number of projects have been completed.
  • Remote first, Midwest/Plains preferred (NE/KS/CO/IA)
Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
Yard Stick’s impact goals go well beyond climate science (although our #1 core value is Climate Impact). Why? Our company operates primarily in the US agricultural sector, which is predicated on centuries of mass land theft and disenfranchisement of Native and Black people. This harm continues today. If we’re going to work in this sector, we need to actively work to make it better.
Consistent with our core value of “Pursue Justice,” we speak up about these issues, and we support emerging solutions and relevant policy efforts such as and . We also publicly highlight the risk of further racial discrimination in emerging agricultural legislation like the Growing Climate Solutions Act.
Regarding hiring and culture, we work to create a work environment where everyone feels confident sharing their ideas, problem-solving happens openly and collaboratively, and mistake-making is welcomed. We also standardize our interview process and questions to reduce “likeability” bias, benchmark salaries against industry databases to reduce negotiation, and utilize tools like the Gender Decoder (this one is feminine-coded, fwiw). Climate change is arguably the most complex challenge ever faced by humanity - we need all of humanity activated to fight back, and that motivates us to build a diverse team.
