jobs.title: Customer Success for Digital Nomad Community (Fully Remote)
jobs.excerpt: “Be the person who guides our members through their greatest adventure with WiFi Tribe—help us build a global community for those who live life boldly.
jobs.description:
“Be the person who guides our members through their greatest adventure with WiFi Tribe—help us build a global community for those who live life boldly.”

As our Tribe Support Lead (our term for "customer service"), you’ll be the person our members trust — the one who helps them step into the community, join life-changing trips, navigate challenges, and feel truly at home with WiFi Tribe. You’ll balance customer success, sales, community care, and operational excellence, all while working with a team that cares deeply about the humans behind the emails.

If you love helping people, think clearly under pressure, communicate like a pro, and thrive in a fast-moving environment where you own your outcomes — this role may be your perfect fit.

Our team is made up of A-players. We’re looking for our next A-PLAYER to join the squad – is that you?

Note from Diego, WiFi Tribe CEO:

I invited 7 internet strangers to spend a month living and working in my childhood home in Bolivia.

It was never meant to be a “business”. Just a group of friends traveling the world together.

It’s been 10 wild years…

Since that first trip, we’ve brought 3,000 nomads together in 100 cities to colive and cowork around the world, one month at a time.

Our work has sparked thousands of lifelong friendships, countless perspective-shifting conversations, hundreds of startup projects and career shifts, so many new romances, lots of weddings, a few babies, and an unimaginable amount of core memories.

What we do changes lives.

Not a little, but a lot and in every way you can think of.

If this excites you, keep reading to see if this might be the most perfect job ever created for you.

COMPANY SNAPSHOT & MISSION

We believe that life wasn’t meant to be lived in just one place. That your best work can be done from anywhere. And, that everything is better when you have great people by your side.

We bring together great people from around the world to help them overcome the loneliness of solo travel, find true community wherever they go, and make their biggest travel dreams a reality, together.

WiFi Tribe is the curated global community for remote professionals who seek growth and long-lasting connections.

Our Mission:We empower remote professionals and entrepreneurs to live boldly—to travel the world with like-minded friends without losing momentum on their goals or careers.

OUR CULTURE

This is who we are and how we do things at WiFi Tribe:

  • MISSION-DRIVEN: The mission is our only agenda. There's no politics here.
  • HUSTLERS: We do the work that gets the results. And we do a lot with a little.
  • DOERS: We shorten time from idea to implementation.
  • AI-SAVVY: We're all AI-savvy and use AI to boost our abilities.
  • BOLD: We take risks and stand for what we believe in.
  • HONEST: We do the right thing and tell the truth when no one's watching.
  • FINISHERS: We finish what we started.

THE ROLE (YOUR MISSION)

You ensure that every member of WiFi Tribe feels supported, informed, understood, and excited about their journey with us, while also ensuring spots on our trips always fill up.

You’ll make joining the community feel seamless, guide members toward the right Chapters for them, help them navigate tough moments with empathy and clarity, and build the foundations for experiences they’ll remember for the rest of their lives.

At the same time, you’ll bring structure, speed, and thoughtful improvements to our Tribe Support systems — becoming the operational backbone that keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes.

You are the person who makes the lead up to their first (or next) trip feel exciting, human, and personal.

You are the bridge between members and the team.

You are the protector of the community’s vibe and the champion of our values.

If you do your job well, members will feel seen, held, and cared for — and the entire WiFi Tribe experience will be better because of you.

WHO YOU ARE

You’re the kind of person people naturally turn to — not just because you’re reliable, but because you genuinely care. You think in solutions, not problems. You communicate clearly, write beautifully, and stay calm and grounded when things get chaotic.

You’re equal parts strategic thinker and hands-on doer. You love systems, but also love humans. You’re the person who follows through, meets commitments, and makes everything you touch a little better than you found it.

You thrive in autonomy, learn fast, and get energy from helping others succeed. You’re resourceful, emotionally intelligent, and unafraid to own the hard conversations with kindness and honesty.

Most of all, you believe in the power of community — and you want to play a meaningful part in creating life-changing experiences for people all over the world.

RESPONSIBILITIES (WHAT YOU’LL DO)

  • Own Tribe Support. This means managing and responding to all email communication with the WiFi Tribe community, owning the full bookings process, and being the champion/voice for our members to the rest of the team.
  • Sales support & new member orientation. Help applicants who were accepted by our Admissions team in making their decision to join the community, and make their journey into the community smooth and successful.
  • Trip consulting & sales. Advise members on what Chapters might be best suited for their journey, discuss and alleviate concerns. Own the full booking process start to finish.
  • Community engagement. Get involved with community initiatives and get creative about ways to engage and strengthen our community.
  • Paying attention to details. In your application, there will be a question about your favourite country. Respond to it with the word "detail", so we know you read everything.
  • Keep members informed. Write member-facing documentation, PDFs, and communications to inform the community about big updates. Ensure members always feel fully informed at the right time.
  • 1% improvement every day. Set aside time to make impactful, long-term improvements and carefully document all processes within your department.
  • AI-powered efficiency. Leverage AI tools to streamline workflows, gather insights, and generate data-driven recommendations.
  • Process improvement & documentation. Identify operational or administrative bottlenecks and propose creative, tech-forward solutions. Document everything diligently to create the ultimate Tribe Support playbook.
  • Culture advocate. Model WiFi Tribe’s values in everything you do.

GROWTH & DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES

  • Startup Exposure: Work closely with the executive team, gaining direct insights into scaling a global community and running a startup company.
  • Increasing Responsibility: Possible opportunities to step into additional roles or tackle special projects aligned with your skill set.
  • Ownership of Projects: Come up with ways to make big improvements and lead initiatives that showcase your abilities.

Requirements

MUST HAVES

  • 2+ years working in customer success or similar field
  • Experience in a sales role
  • Native-level English with impeccable grammar and very strong writing skills
  • Strong organisational skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Tech-savvy and a quick learner and early adopter of new tools and technologies
  • Very comfortable with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude)
  • Proactive problem-solver who identifies needs before they arise
  • Strategic doer applying critical thinking to all tasks
  • Autonomous (you'll be super successful with zero management)
  • High integrity
  • Ability to work in a European/African or North/South American timezone (between 12-8pm ± 2 hours Central European Time (CET) so you have enough overlap with Asia and the Americas)

HOW TO APPLY / NEXT STEPS

  1. Application Submission: Submit your application through this platform (make sure you also submit the Typeform that you will see once you've started your application). Note: we never consider email submissions.
  2. Initial Screening: A few assessments and a personality test to understand how you work.
  3. Video Questions: A few short video questions to learn more about your background, motivations, and personal interests.
  4. Main Interviews: A deeper discussion about your technical skills, personal-task management approach, and fit with our culture.
  5. Real-World Task Exercise: A short exercise simulating tasks you’d handle in this role.

We aim to wrap up the process within 3-4 weeks.

Benefits

COMPENSATION

  • $25,000 – $50,000 USD per year (based on experience, track record, and whether you'll take on additional responsibilities)
  • A bonus if you hit targets/KPIs and help the company achieve its goals (company wins = you win)

PERKS

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world—home office or a beachside café.
  • Global Community: Engage with 700+ remote-working entrepreneurs and professionals and build your personal global network.
  • Free Travel Opportunities: Join some of our WiFi Tribe Chapters for free (when last-minute spots are available) and experience travel adventures in some of the world’s most iconic destinations.
  • Professional Development: We invest in our team through sponsored learning resources and conferences.
  • Flexible Work: Balance personal and business tasks in a schedule that suits your style, as long as you're able to get everything done and respond on time.

We can't wait to meet you!

If you’ve read this far and something in your chest is saying, “This is me” — trust that feeling.

WiFi Tribe is built by people who care deeply, take bold action, and leave things better than they found them. If you’re a badass A-player ready to bring your talent, your heart, and your drive to a role that actually changes people’s lives, we’d love to meet you.

Apply now — your next great adventure starts here.

3. Gathers facts by conducting interviews with all involved parties and considers all the elements of the claim prior to issuing a decision.
4. Take recorded statements when necessary.
5. Determines eligibility of indemnity and medical benefits once salary information and medical treatment plans have been secured and processed within the designated authority levels.
6. Utilize proactive reserving behaviors to ensure adequate case reserves which reflect the probable ultimate outcome based on the current known circumstances throughout the life of the claim.
7. Actively identifies and develops the investigation of and pursuit of subrogation recoveries when possible.

11. Manages claims litigation, including expenses, by collaborating and providing direction to panel counsel throughout the life of the claim.
12. Analyzes reports from external resources such as physicians, attorneys, and/or vocational rehabilitation experts to evaluate and adjust claim strategies as needed.

We are looking for a Site Observability Engineer to design and operate the metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting platforms that give engineering teams confidence in the systems they run. The role spans the full observability stack — from collection agents and pipelines to long-term storage, dashboards, and alerting workflows — with a strong focus on usability, signal quality, and operational ROI.   • Strong understanding of OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, and structured logging.
  • Proficiency in at least one general-purpose language such as Go, Python, or Java.
  • Experience operating high-cardinality, high-throughput metrics and log pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of SLOs, error budgets, and SRE principles.
  • Experience integrating observability with CI/CD and incident management tooling.
  • Solid grasp of Linux internals, networking, and container platforms.

  • Experience with Thanos, Mimir, Cortex, Loki, or Tempo at scale.
  • Contributions to OpenTelemetry or observability open-source projects.
  • Familiarity with eBPF-based observability tooling.
  • Experience driving observability cost optimization initiatives.
  • Exposure to regulated environments with audit-grade logging requirements.

Senior Operations Data Analyst

About the Company

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. Since founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 80 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and natural resources companies Equinor, BHP, and Mitsubishi.

About the Role

Senior individual contributor reporting to the Head of Operations Data, coordinating day to day with the broader team and functional stakeholders. Owns systems end to end — data model, ETL, application, and stakeholder relationships — with minimal oversight from day one, and mentors junior analysts. Approximate initial allocation:

Responsibilities

  • 45% Build & integration — new data models, ETL/API integrations, and app support (Foundry et al.)
  • 25% Platform maintenance & data quality — OPSDB stewardship, sync reliability, alerting, production support
  • 15% Governance & technical debt — RBAC, scoped roles, dbt semantic layer, documentation
  • 15% Mingomba support & cross-functional mentorship — commitments register, peer mentorship and skill growth, coordination with Mingomba functional growth like Procurement, Inventory

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data operations owning production systems independently
  • Strong SQL and data modeling (PostgreSQL)
  • Proven ETL and API integration
  • Experience and comfort with AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.)
  • Dbt, cloud tooling (AWS/S3), finance-systems (NetSuite/Tipalti), or geospatial data a plus.

  • Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.

Job Title: Hadoop Solutions Developer

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Hadoop Developer to design, build, and operate large-scale data processing pipelines and analytics platforms on Hadoop and related big-data ecosystems. In this role you will be responsible for ingesting, transforming, and analyzing massive volumes of structured and unstructured data to support enterprise analytics, machine learning, and reporting workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across the Hadoop ecosystem with strong software engineering fundamentals and a clear understanding of how to deliver reliable, performant, and cost-effective data platforms in production environments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and operate end-to-end big-data pipelines on Hadoop, ingesting data from a diverse mix of relational, file-based, streaming, and API-driven sources.
  • Build robust ETL/ELT workflows using Apache Spark, Hive, Pig, and Sqoop, with strong attention to data quality, idempotency, error handling, and recoverability.
  • Develop high-throughput streaming data pipelines using Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink, and integrate them with downstream analytical and operational systems.
  • Optimize Spark and MapReduce jobs through careful tuning of partitioning, memory, serialization, and skew handling to meet demanding SLAs at minimal cost.
  • Design and maintain data models and storage layouts on HDFS, Hive, HBase, and modern lakehouse formats (Parquet, ORC, Delta, Iceberg, Hudi) to balance flexibility and performance.
  • Implement data governance, lineage, and quality controls in collaboration with data governance and security teams.
  • Build robust monitoring, alerting, and logging strategies for big-data pipelines, including job-level SLAs and proactive failure detection.
  • Partner with data scientists and analysts to deliver curated, reliable, and well-documented datasets that accelerate their work.
  • Automate pipeline orchestration using Airflow, Oozie, or similar workflow engines, with clean dependency management and clear ownership boundaries.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt new technologies in the big-data and cloud ecosystem (EMR, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery) where they offer meaningful improvements.
  • Lead performance reviews and architecture audits of existing pipelines, proposing concrete refactoring and optimization initiatives.
  • Document data architectures, schemas, pipeline behaviors, and operational runbooks in a way that makes the platform supportable as the team scales.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the team’s engineering standards and best practices.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional experience designing and operating big-data pipelines on Hadoop.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Apache Spark (Scala, Python, or Java) in production environments.
  • Solid experience with Hive, HDFS, Sqoop, HBase, and the broader Hadoop ecosystem.
  • Hands-on experience with streaming data platforms such as Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with both relational and NoSQL data stores.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or Oozie.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts, including partitioning, replication, and fault tolerance.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python or Shell.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience operating Hadoop on cloud platforms such as AWS EMR, Azure HDInsight, or Databricks.
  • Familiarity with modern lakehouse formats (Delta, Iceberg, Hudi).
  • Exposure to data governance tooling such as Apache Atlas or Collibra.
  • Experience with Kubernetes-based data platforms (Spark-on-K8s, Trino).
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code in data engineering workflows.

  • Offer!

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

jobs.description:
About ComPsych

ComPsychⓇ is the worldwide leader in organizational mental health, well-being, and absence management, dedicated to igniting human potential in workplaces across the globe. For over 40 years, we have combined the best in technology with unmatched human expertise to help individuals and their organizations thrive. Our GuidanceResourcesⓇ and AbsenceResourcesⓇ solutions deliver end-to-end mental health, well-being, work-life, health navigation, and absence support to more than 75,000 customers worldwide, touching more than 160 million lives across 200 countries. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health and absence management needs.

About the Role

This is a fully remote role. ComPsych is modernizing how it secures the business as it migrates to the cloud and builds AI into its products, and the Senior Cloud Security Engineer is accountable for raising the bar across every security domain, network, application, cloud, data, and AI. The role covers the full security lifecycle, from designing controls, policy as code, and guardrails to directing AI assisted build and validation work, through owning detection, response, and vulnerability management, while keeping human judgment on what ships and how the team responds. Because ComPsych’s platform carries behavioral health data for millions of members, this engineer helps ensure that security and privacy scale with the business rather than slowing it down. Candidates with different levels of experience and strong equivalent experience are encouraged to apply.

What You'll Do

  • Secure the cloud, by design and in code. Own cloud security posture management across configuration, workloads, and entitlements (CSPM, CWPP, and CIEM); identity and access management and least privilege, including federation and single sign on, secrets management, privileged access, and workload and non human identities; network segmentation; container security; encryption and key management; and guardrails delivered as policy as code across our cloud environments (AWS primary, Azure), so the secure path is the default for every team.
  • Build application security into the pipeline. Shift security left in CI/CD with static, dynamic, and dependency and software supply chain scanning, threat modeling, secrets management, and secure by design reviews, so product teams ship safely by default.
  • Engineer network security for a cloud first estate. Design segmentation and zero trust access, firewalls and web application firewalls, and traffic inspection across cloud and hybrid networks, automated and observable rather than manually maintained.
  • Protect the data and engineer privacy in. Lead data classification, encryption and tokenization, key management, and data loss prevention, with privacy by design for PHI and ePHI and awareness of data residency and cross border handling across our domestic and international footprint.
  • Secure the AI systems we build. Design guardrails, data protection, and abuse and misuse controls for AI, machine learning, and generative AI, addressing risks like prompt injection, model and data poisoning, and sensitive data leakage, and build the monitoring to catch them.
  • Own detection, response, and vulnerability management. Tune SIEM and cloud native detections, drive event correlation and incident response, run vulnerability scanning and coordinate penetration testing, and turn findings into fixes with real remediation timelines.
  • Advance information security and make secure the easy default. Maintain security baselines and configuration compliance, and the controls, logging, and audit evidence that keep us compliant, coaching engineers across teams rather than gatekeeping.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

What We're Looking For

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field; security certifications such as CISSP or a cloud security specialty are a plus.
  • 6 to 9 years of security engineering experience with hands on cloud experience, as a guideline rather than a hard requirement.
  • Agentic AI tools are your primary surface for security engineering, analysis, detection, and automation, and you apply hard judgment to what they produce, not an occasional assist.
  • Senior level breadth across network security, application security, cloud security, information security, and the emerging discipline of AI security, with real depth in several of them.
  • You build controls as code, including policy as code, infrastructure as code, automation, and detections, and you have operated them in production, including carrying on call and incident load.
  • Cloud security depth in AWS (primary) and Azure: identity and access management and least privilege, identity federation and single sign on, secrets management, privileged access, and workload and non human identities; network security; container security including image scanning and runtime protection; key management and encryption; and cloud security posture management across configuration, workloads, and entitlements (CSPM, CWPP, and CIEM).
  • Data protection and privacy engineering: data classification, encryption, tokenization, and key management, data loss prevention, and privacy by design for regulated health data, with data residency awareness across domestic and international operations.
  • Application and product security depth: secure software development lifecycle, threat modeling, static, dynamic, and software composition analysis, secrets and software supply chain security, and API security.
  • Detection, response, and vulnerability management depth: SIEM and cloud native detection, log and event correlation, vulnerability scanning and management, and coordinating penetration testing and remediation to closure.
  • AI security awareness and a point of view: securing AI and generative AI systems against risks like prompt injection, data and model poisoning, and data leakage, with familiarity with references like the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS a plus.
  • You build to the frameworks we operate under, domestic and international: HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, NIST, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and GDPR.
  • Self-starter with ability to multi-task and work autonomously
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills

Effective interpersonal and communication skills

Compensation and Benefits

  • Full benefits package, including Paid Time Off (PTO), medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, robust EAP, wellness program, and much more
  • The salary range for this position is $150,000 - $200,000 (USD). The base salary range represents the anticipated low end and high end of the range for this position. The actual compensation will be influenced by a wide range of factors including, but not limited to previous experience, education, pay market/geography, and scheduled hours.

SENIOR ESOP ADMINISTRATOR

JOB TITLE: Senior ESOP Administrator

DEPARTMENT: ESOP Services

SUPERVISOR: Director of ESOP Services

About ESOP Partners, Inc.

ESOP Partners, Inc. is a third-party administration and consulting firm dedicated to providing a liquid business transition solution for owners of closely held businesses through the establishment, maintenance, and sustainability of Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs). Our mission is to maximize the financial and cultural benefits of employee ownership by helping ESOP companies build strong, informed, and engaged employee ownership cultures.

We aspire to be nationally recognized as the leading ESOP firm in the country. We pursue this vision through our Core Values:

  • Seek to Understand – We identify the underlying reasons behind questions and actions and take ownership of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Manage Expectations – We proactively communicate clear, specific, and achievable objectives to create alignment and accountability.
  • Collaborate – We work together through constructive discussion and teamwork to achieve win-win outcomes.
  • Get Things Done – We prioritize, organize, and execute efficiently to deliver accurate and timely results.
  • Practice Professional Skepticism – We apply a questioning mindset to objectively analyze information for quality and accuracy.
  • Exhibit Mental Strength – We manage challenges with professionalism, resilience, and a solutions-oriented attitude.

Position Summary

The Senior ESOP Administrator is responsible for the overall administration, compliance, and client service delivery for Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs). This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring accurate plan recordkeeping, regulatory compliance, and timely completion of annual administration requirements. The Senior ESOP Administrator provides technical expertise related to ERISA, IRS, and DOL regulations, oversees plan allocations and distribution processing, reviews valuation reports, and prepares required filings and participant communications. This position also plays a key role in mentoring junior team members, improving internal processes, and supporting cross-functional collaboration with valuation, consulting, and compliance teams. Success in this role requires strong technical knowledge of ESOP plan design and administration, exceptional attention to detail, client-focused communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Position Details

  • Location: Remote Eligible (WI, MI, GA, NC, IA)
    • Must be able to provide and maintain a distraction-free and professional work environment and meet our minimum high-speed internet connection standards.
  • Position Type: Full-time | Exempt
  • Work Schedule: This role has a seasonal workload and requires the ability to work more than 45 hours per week during the peak period of January through May annually.
  • Experience Level: Minimum of 7 years’ recent hands-on ESOP administration and record-keeping experience, including direct client management.
  • Travel:
    • Required travel to Appleton, WI for 2-3 weeks of orientation and training.
    • Ongoing travel to Appleton, WI for one full week each quarter.

Key Accountabilities

ESOP Plan Administration & Compliance

  • Contribute to overall ESOP Administration team production goals while maintaining high standards of accuracy, efficiency, and client service.
  • Oversee and execute critical ESOP administrative functions, ensuring junior staff complete assigned responsibilities in accordance with established quality control procedures.
  • Monitor completion of required reports and regulatory filings using internal ESOP timeline tools to ensure deadlines and client expectations are consistently met.
  • Determine participant eligibility in accordance with plan provisions and ensure accurate allocation of employer contributions.
  • Maintain and validate historical participant data to ensure accurate processing of forfeitures, vesting, diversification eligibility, and related plan events.
  • Track and report ESOP trust activity, including stock transactions, dividends, and share account activity, ensuring accurate attribution to participant accounts.
  • Prepare and distribute participant statements, required notices, and disclosures in compliance with ERISA and applicable regulations.
  • Administer participant distributions, including preparation of customized diversification elections and benefit election documentation.
  • Perform compliance testing to ensure plans adhere to ESOP-specific requirements as well as applicable IRS and DOL regulations.
  • Ensure timely and accurate completion of ERISA-related regulatory reporting and annual filing requirements.

Quality Control & Process Improvement

  • Apply established quality control standards to all client deliverables and mentor junior administrators to strengthen technical accuracy and consistency.
  • Partner in the ongoing enhancement and testing of proprietary administration software (ESOP Revolution) to improve system functionality, reduce manual workarounds, and increase operational efficiency.

Client Consulting & Advisory Services

Provide ESOP administration and consulting services to new and existing clients, including but not limited to:

  • Repurchase Liability Studies
  • Distribution Policy consulting
  • ESOP Plan Design support

Senior Accountant – NetSuite, GAAP & Financial Reporting

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible schedule aligned with U.S. business hours

About the Role

We’re hiring a highly detail-oriented Senior Accountant to own key accounting operations, financial reporting, reconciliations, and month-end close activities for a growing U.S.-based business.

This is more than a transactional accounting role. You’ll take ownership of financial accuracy, maintain clean and audit-ready books, improve accounting processes, and provide leadership with reliable financial reporting and insights.

You’ll work closely with finance leadership, operations, and accounting team members across general ledger accounting, month-end close, financial statements, reconciliations, audit support, and process improvement.

If you have strong accounting fundamentals, hands-on ERP experience, and enjoy bringing structure and accuracy to financial operations, this role could be a great fit.

What You’ll Own

General Ledger & Accounting Operations

  • Prepare and post journal entries for accruals, prepaids, payroll allocations, depreciation, and intercompany transactions
  • Maintain accurate general ledger accounts
  • Reconcile:
    • Cash and bank accounts
    • Accounts receivable and accounts payable
    • Credit cards
    • Deferred revenue
    • Inventory and other balance sheet accounts
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and audit-ready accounting records

Month-End & Quarter-End Close

  • Lead monthly and quarterly close activities
  • Maintain close checklists, schedules, and supporting documentation
  • Prepare accruals and adjusting journal entries
  • Complete balance sheet reconciliations
  • Coordinate with internal teams to collect required reporting inputs
  • Help deliver an accurate and timely close within 5–7 business days

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and review:
    • Profit & Loss statements
    • Balance Sheets
    • Cash Flow Statements
  • Perform budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actual variance analysis
  • Investigate material variances and provide clear commentary
  • Prepare financial schedules and reporting packages for leadership, audits, and executive reviews
  • Help translate accounting data into useful financial insights

NetSuite, ERP & Accounting Systems

  • Maintain accurate financial data within NetSuite or similar ERP/accounting systems
  • Support improvements to accounting workflows and system controls
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual accounting processes
  • Help improve reporting, reconciliations, and financial data integrity
  • Support ERP optimization and automation initiatives

Audit, Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Support external audits and prepare PBC schedules
  • Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions and reconciliations
  • Assist with applicable tax and compliance reporting
  • Maintain accounting SOPs and internal controls
  • Ensure accounting practices align with GAAP and applicable company policies
  • Keep financial records organized and audit-ready

Team & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Review work completed by staff accountants, bookkeepers, or junior accounting team members
  • Provide guidance on reconciliations, journal entries, and accounting treatment
  • Collaborate with FP&A, operations, sales, and leadership
  • Help improve accounting processes, documentation, and reporting standards

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of financial accuracy
  • You’re highly organized and naturally detail-oriented
  • You understand the reasoning behind accounting entries, not just how to process them
  • You can identify discrepancies and investigate them independently
  • You work effectively under month-end and reporting deadlines
  • You communicate financial information clearly
  • You proactively look for ways to improve accounting processes and controls

Required Experience & Skills

  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • U.S. GAAP
    • General ledger accounting
    • Accrual accounting
    • Financial reporting
    • Account reconciliations
    • Month-end close
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, SAP, or similar accounting/ERP systems

    • Pivot Tables

Overview

BerryDunn is seeking a Senior Consultant with experience in human services programs to join our State Government Practice Group, focused on serving as the Human Services Business Operations Lead on the Guam engagement and serving as a subject matter expert (SME) to support other state Health and Human Services (HHS) agency clients. As a Senior Consultant, you will have the right mix of demonstrated human services program experience, exceptional organizational, project management, and self-management qualities, strong leadership and client-facing capabilities, and effective written and verbal communication skills.

You will have 8+ years of experience working with and/or for state government agencies responsible for human services programs (e.g., Supplemental Food Assistance Program [SNAP], Temporary Assistance for Needy Families [TANF], Child Support, and Child Care), and you will be comfortable working in many different environments within state government.

You will provide human services program subject matter expertise on BerryDunn projects with teams consisting of project managers, business analysts, and technical analysts. You will be responsible for leading implementation of new federal regulations and waivers, leading development of project artifacts, monitoring corrective action plans, continuous quality improvement, identifying the need for staff aids and training, and informing the development of business processes and standard operating procedures. You will also be responsible for supporting the implementation of new technology. Experience with public health programs and policies, business development (e.g., writing proposals), project management, and staff development is a plus.

Human services program experience is required, and the right candidate will be comfortable working with clients on human services projects and have the flexibility to work Guam hours supporting the client from 8 am to 12 pm Tuesday through Friday Chamorro Standard Time (ChST). You will be based in one of our physical office locations or remotely, and you will report to the HHS Practice Area Lead Principal.

Travel Expectations: Travel can range up to 50% depending on client and project needs and could be over long distances and multiple time zones.

You Will

  • Serve as a subject matter expert related to human services programs on BerryDunn projects providing services for state HHS agency clients
  • Understand human services and public health federal regulations
  • Lead the human services business operations team assigned to the Guam Department of Health and Human Services engagement
  • Lead and support delivery of services to clients on time and within budget, including assigning and managing staff and overseeing development of deliverables
  • Report on project status (written and verbal)—including risks and issues—to different audiences, including client executive leadership
  • Inspire and motivate the project teams you lead, and serve as a trusted advisor to clients
  • Facilitate meetings and interviews with client stakeholders with confidence and professionalism
  • Maintain a strong focus on providing high quality services and deliverables, in adherence with BerryDunn's Consulting Quality Management Program
  • Play a role in developing staff; contribute to maintaining and building a positive, fun, and innovative HHS team culture; and participate in and/or lead training and other learning and development activities

You Have

  • A bachelor’s degree in a human services, public health, or social services related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 8+ years of experience working with and/or for state government agencies
  • Knowledge of state government human services programs, services, and policies
  • A strong customer focus
  • Demonstrated experience leading project teams
  • Experience in and a desire to coach and mentor junior team members
  • An ability to balance strong attention to detail with a focus on the bigger picture
  • Effective project management and organizational skills, and the ability to remain calm and focused during busy or challenging times
  • Excellent written communication skills, including documenting complex issues succinctly and logically
  • Excellent verbal and presentation skills, including articulating complex issues to a variety of audiences
  • The ability to balance multiple assignments and achieve quality results in a timely manner
  • The ability to create and sustain positive working relationships with staff and diverse constituencies and to work independently as well as collaboratively
  • Microsoft (MS) Office suite skills and experience, including MS PowerPoint, Project, Visio, and Excel

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $120,000 - $140,000. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus based on factors such as company and personal performance. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

BerryDunn Benefits & Culture

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being. Visit our website for a complete list of benefits and a look into our culture: Experience BerryDunn.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process or perform essential job functions. Please contact to request an accommodation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

About BerryDunn

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Since 1974, BerryDunn has helped businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies throughout the US and its territories solve their greatest challenges. The firm’s tax, advisory, and consulting services are provided by Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC, and its attest services are provided by BDMP Assurance, LLP, a licensed CPA firm.

BerryDunn is a client-centered, people-first professional services firm with a mission to empower the meaningful growth of our people, clients, and communities. The firm has been recognized for its efforts in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace culture, and for its focus on learning, development, and well-being. Learn more at berrydunn.com.

jobs.description:
Start conversations that can change how cities work.

Archistar is looking for a motivated and commercially minded Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our growing North American team.

We're looking for someone who already has experience in GovTech, public-sector technology or selling into government and is ready to take the next step in their career.

You'll help introduce municipalities across North America to Archistar's world-leading AI PreCheck technology - technology designed to help cities modernise planning and building approvals, improve permitting and ultimately help get housing and development moving faster.

If you understand the government technology landscape, enjoy opening doors and building relationships, and want to work with technology that can make a genuine impact on communities, we'd like to meet you.

The opportunity

As an SDR, you'll be at the front of Archistar's growth across North America.

Working closely with our Regional Sales Directors and broader Government Solutions team, you'll research markets, identify opportunities and decision-makers, and start meaningful conversations with municipalities across Canada and the United States.

You'll already understand that government sales are different.

Relationships matter. Timing matters. Procurement can be complex. And the best conversations start by understanding the customer's challenges rather than simply pitching a product.

This isn't about making hundreds of generic calls from a script. We want someone who can research a municipality, understand what's happening in its market and create a relevant reason to start a conversation.

What you'll do

Research municipalities and government organisations across Canada and the United States to identify new opportunities.

  • Identify and engage the people shaping planning, building, permitting, technology and digital transformation within cities.
  • Develop new relationships through phone, email, LinkedIn, industry events and targeted outbound campaigns.
  • Start informed conversations about the challenges municipalities are facing and how technology can help.
  • Qualify opportunities and work closely with our Regional Sales Directors to progress them.
  • Build and nurture relationships with prospective customers across longer government buying cycles.
  • Work with Sales and Marketing on targeted campaigns, events and market initiatives.
  • Research new regions, government priorities and emerging opportunities across the GovTech market.
  • Maintain disciplined CRM, pipeline and activity management.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Archistar's technology and become great at explaining what makes it different.
  • Bring ideas. We want someone who continually thinks about smarter ways to reach and engage customers.

Requirements

What we're looking for

You'll ideally bring:

  • 2+ years' experience in sales development, business development or a similar commercial role, ideally within GovTech or public-sector technology.
  • Experience engaging government or municipal customers and an understanding of how the public sector operates.
  • Exposure to SaaS, enterprise technology, civic technology or digital government solutions.
  • An understanding of government sales cycles, stakeholders and procurement environments.
  • Experience prospecting and generating new business opportunities.
  • Confidence communicating with senior and operational government stakeholders by phone, email and LinkedIn.
  • Strong research skills and the ability to turn information about a prospective customer into a relevant conversation.
  • Experience working with CRM and sales engagement tools.
  • A track record of working towards and achieving activity, pipeline or opportunity targets.

Experience within permitting, planning, land management, building approvals, GIS, regulatory technology or municipal software would be particularly valuable.

You'll thrive at Archistar if you...

  • Enjoy opening doors and building markets.
  • Understand that good business development is about creating the right conversations, not simply generating activity.
  • Genuinely care about customers and take the time to understand what they're trying to achieve.
  • Are persistent and comfortable developing relationships over longer government sales cycles.
  • Are curious about cities, technology, AI and how government services can be improved.
  • Are ambitious and want to continue developing your career in enterprise and government technology sales.
  • Enjoy being part of a motivated, collaborative team where people work together to get things done.

Benefits

Why Archistar?

  • World-leading AI PreCheck technology
    Build your career around technology at the forefront of using AI to transform planning, permitting and building approvals.
  • Make your work mean something
    The conversations you create can ultimately help municipalities modernise permitting, support housing delivery and deliver better services to their communities.
  • Local People. Global Expertise.
    Join our growing Canadian team while working alongside experienced specialists across government, planning, AI, product and technology in Canada and internationally - all working together to help our North American customers succeed.
  • Take your GovTech career further
    Build on the experience you already have. You'll work closely with experienced Regional Sales Directors and Government Solutions leaders and gain exposure to complex enterprise government sales from initial engagement through to successful customer partnership.
  • Customers come first
    Our municipal customers are there to serve their communities, and we're here to help them do that as successfully as possible. We want someone who cares about building trusted relationships and creating genuine value for customers.
  • Join us at the right time
    Our team and customer footprint are growing across Canada and North America. Join now and you'll have the opportunity to grow alongside the business and make a visible contribution to our next stage.
  • A team you'll enjoy being part of
    We're ambitious, motivated and collaborative. We share ideas, celebrate wins and bring people across the business together to get things done.
  • Be rewarded for your impact
    Competitive base salary + performance-based commission, with equity opportunities available for the right candidate.
  • Comprehensive benefits
    Health, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage, life and AD&D insurance, long-term disability coverage and paid time off.

Ready for your next move in GovTech? Apply Now!

If you've already started building your career in GovTech or public-sector technology and you're ready for an opportunity with greater exposure, world-leading AI technology and a growing North American market, we'd like to hear from you.

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and interest in the role.

Bring your GovTech experience, energy and ambition. We'll bring the technology, expertise and team behind you.

Together, we'll start conversations that can help cities modernise permitting, support the delivery of more housing and create better outcomes for communities across North America.

Location: Canada, Ontario or British Columbia
Work arrangement: Remote
Employment: Full-time
Package: Competitive salary + commission + equity opportunities

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.

jobs.title: Senior Subcontracts Manager
jobs.excerpt: At Aleut Federal, we believe our company and its mission are just as important as the job for which you are applying.
jobs.description:
At Aleut Federal, we believe our company and its mission are just as important as the job for which you are applying. Aleut Federal, LLC is the largest subsidiary of The Aleut Corporation, an Alaska Native Corporation owned by the Unangax̂ people of the Aleutian and Pribilof Islands of Alaska.

People are at the core of everything we do. We support our shareholders by delivering excellent service and quality results to our customers across the federal government. We also engage in the communities where we live and work, making community service an integral part of our mission.

Our culture strengthens our workforce through mentorship, coaching, professional development, and competitive benefits. We encourage diversity, inclusion, innovation, accountability, and growth at every level of the organization.

The Aleut Federal motto is “We Are One” because we believe that with one heart, one mind, and one purpose, we can accomplish our mission and build an organization that employees are proud to be part of.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Subcontracts Manager is a hands-on leadership position responsible for managing a portfolio of complex subcontracts while providing day-to-day direction, oversight, and professional development to assigned subcontract personnel.

This position performs the full range of cradle-to-grave subcontract management activities, including acquisition planning, solicitation, source selection, cost and price analysis, negotiation, award, administration, modification, compliance, performance management, and closeout. The Senior Subcontracts Manager also reviews teamwork products, balances workload assignments, monitors departmental priorities, and helps ensure consistent execution across the subcontract function.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted business advisor to program management, operations, finance, legal, business development, and executive leadership. This individual must be comfortable independently executing complex subcontract actions while simultaneously coaching staff, resolving escalated matters, supporting audits, and contributing to subcontract policies, procedures, and strategic initiatives.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Portfolio and Subcontract Management

  • Personally manage an assigned portfolio of complex, high-value, high-risk, or strategically important subcontracts in support of federal prime contracts and commercial business activities.
  • Perform the complete lifecycle of subcontract administration from acquisition planning and proposal support through subcontract closeout.
  • Develop solicitation strategies and prepare requests for quotes, requests for proposals, invitations for bids, and other competitive or sole-source subcontract documentation.
  • Lead subcontractor source-selection activities, including evaluation of technical, schedule, past-performance, compliance, and cost or price considerations.
  • Conduct and document price analysis, cost analysis, market research, and negotiations to establish fair and reasonable pricing.
  • Negotiate subcontract terms and conditions, statements of work, pricing, delivery requirements, intellectual property provisions, data rights, warranties, indemnification, limitation of liability, and other contractual matters.
  • Prepare, issue, and administer subcontracts, purchase orders, task orders, modifications, nondisclosure agreements, teaming-related subcontract documents, and other subcontract instruments within delegated authority.
  • Monitor subcontractor performance, funding, deliverables, invoicing, schedules, compliance requirements, and contractual milestones.
  • Identify subcontract risks and develop practical mitigation strategies in coordination with program and functional stakeholders.
  • Manage subcontract changes, requests for equitable adjustment, disputes, performance concerns, corrective actions, and closeout activities.
  • Obtain and administer required subcontractor bid bonds, performance and payment bonds, certificates of insurance, representations, certifications, and other compliance documentation.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, current, and audit-ready subcontract files in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

Leadership and Staff Oversight

  • Provide day-to-day leadership, direction, and support to assigned subcontract administrators, buyers, or other subcontracts personnel.
  • Assign and balance workloads based on business priorities, employee experience, subcontract complexity, risk, and schedule requirements.
  • Review staff work products for accuracy, completeness, consistency, business judgment, and compliance before approval or execution.
  • Establish clear expectations, monitor progress, provide timely feedback, and hold team members accountable for quality and performance.
  • Coach and mentor staff in subcontract formation, negotiation, administration, documentation, compliance, customer service, and professional judgment.
  • Support employee goal setting, performance evaluations, development planning, training, and succession-readiness activities.
  • Serve as an escalation point for difficult negotiations, subcontractor performance matters, internal customer concerns, and complex compliance questions.
  • Promote collaboration, accountability, responsiveness, and consistent application of subcontracts policies and procedures.
  • Provide coverage and continuity across the department during periods of increased workload or staff absence.
  • Help identify resource constraints, skills gaps, training needs, and opportunities to improve team effectiveness.

Compliance and Business Partnership

  • Interpret prime contract requirements, subcontract terms, the Federal Acquisition Regulation, applicable agency supplements, and other regulatory or legal requirements.
  • Ensure subcontract actions comply with applicable FAR, DFARS, agency-specific requirements, company policies, contractual obligations, and customer requirements.
  • Determine and document appropriate subcontract flow-down requirements in coordination with Contracts, Legal, Compliance, Security, and other subject-matter experts.
  • Support compliance with small-business subcontracting requirements and assist with subcontracting plans, reporting, and socioeconomic utilization initiatives, as applicable.
  • Partner with program managers and technical stakeholders to develop clear requirements, acquisition schedules, evaluation criteria, and subcontract strategies.
  • Support proposal activities by obtaining subcontractor quotations, developing compliant subcontract packages, completing cost or price evaluations, and coordinating required representations and certifications.
  • Advise internal stakeholders regarding subcontract risk, lead times, competition requirements, negotiation strategy, and subcontractor performance.
  • Proactively engage across business lines and functional departments to move subcontract actions and strategic initiatives through successful completion.
  • Support internal reviews, customer reviews, incurred-cost audits, compliance assessments, and other government or third-party audits.
  • Assist with Contractor Purchasing System Review readiness and corrective-action activities, when applicable.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and industry practices that may affect subcontracting policies, procedures, or business operations.
  • Develop, implement, and improve subcontract templates, tools, procedures, workflows, metrics, and internal controls.
  • Prepare and communicate subcontract status, workload, performance, risk, and compliance information to departmental and company leadership.
  • Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION AND TRAINING

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, supply chain management, contracts management, finance, law, or a related field is preferred.
  • Relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Professional certification such as Certified Federal Contracts Manager, Certified Professional Contracts Manager, Certified Professional in Supply Management, or an equivalent credential is preferred.

EXPERIENCE

  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible experience in subcontract management, contracts, subcontracts, supply chain, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing complex subcontracts in support of U.S. federal government prime contracts.
  • Prior experience leading, supervising, mentoring, or providing functional oversight to subcontract or procurement professionals.
  • Strong working knowledge of the FAR and DFARS and experience applying regulatory requirements to subcontract formation and administration.
  • Experience with multiple subcontract and prime contract types, including firm-fixed-price, time-and-materials, labor-hour, cost-reimbursement, incentive-fee, award-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, and task-order arrangements.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting cost and price analysis and leading complex subcontract negotiations.
  • Experience supporting federal technology services, professional services, construction, environmental, facilities, logistics, or mission-support programs is preferred.
  • Experience supporting audits, purchasing-system reviews, or other government compliance assessments is preferred.
  • Experience with Deltek Costpoint or a comparable enterprise resource planning or procurement system is preferred.
  • Experience working in a multi-company, shared services, or Alaska Native Corporation environment is beneficial.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Leadership: Able to lead through influence and accountability while remaining actively engaged in day-to-day subcontract execution.
  • Federal Subcontracting Knowledge: Advanced understanding of federal subcontracting principles, acquisition regulations, contract types, subcontract practices, and compliance requirements.
  • Negotiation: Able to develop negotiation strategies, lead complex negotiations, resolve disagreements, and achieve balanced business outcomes.
  • Business Judgment: Able to evaluate contractual, financial, schedule, performance, and compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
  • Critical Thinking: Able to analyze complex facts, requirements, and data to develop sound conclusions and defensible business positions.
  • Communication: Able to communicate complex contractual and regulatory matters clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, to employees, subcontractors, customers, and senior leadership.
  • People Development: Able to coach employees, provide constructive feedback, establish expectations, and develop individual and team capabilities.
  • Collaboration: Able to establish productive relationships with programs, operations, finance, contracts, legal, business development, security, and other functional teams.
  • Attention to Detail: Able to produce and review accurate, complete, well-supported, and audit-ready subcontract documentation.
  • Organization: Able to manage a personal subcontract portfolio while overseeing staff assignments, competing priorities, deadlines, and departmental initiatives.
  • Initiative: Able to independently identify issues, take ownership, recommend solutions, and move actions to completion.
  • Adaptability: Able to reprioritize work and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment with changing requirements.
  • Technology Proficiency: Proficient with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams, as well as electronic procurement and contract-management systems.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for prolonged periods.
  • Must be able to perform repetitive tasks or motions for prolonged periods.
  • Must be able to communicate and exchange information effectively in person and through electronic means.

SALARY Range

170K to 180K depending upon experience.

  • Health insurance
  • Dental/Vision insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability
  • Life insurance
  • 401k and match

Location: Remote, Latin America
Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, Ontario/Eastern Time
Languages: Professional English and Spanish
Commitment: Dedicated, long-term position

About the Role

Sellax Roofing is looking for a self-directed Construction Project & Service Operations Coordinator to manage the daily coordination of our commercial roofing projects, emergency service calls, repairs, maintenance and warranty work.

This is not a basic administrative or data-entry position. You will be trusted to organize people, investigate problems, find answers and keep work moving without constant supervision.

You will coordinate customers, field employees, subcontractors, suppliers and management while protecting schedules, budgets and customer commitments.

What You Will Own

  • Maintain the production and service schedule.

  • Coordinate crews, technicians, subcontractors and suppliers.

  • Confirm that access, materials, equipment, labour and approvals are ready before work begins.

  • Manage emergency leak calls, repairs, maintenance visits and warranty callbacks.

  • Communicate appointments, progress, delays and next steps to customers.

  • Track daily production and organize recovery plans when work falls behind.

  • Investigate operational problems and implement practical solutions within your authority.

  • Bring management recommendations—not only problems—when approval is required.

  • Maintain accurate tasks, notes, labour hours, photographs, documents and communications in JobTread.

  • Track additional work, change requests and supporting documentation.

  • Review project budgets and compare estimated costs against actual labour, materials, equipment and subcontractor costs.

  • Identify cost overruns, idle labour, wasted trips, missing costs and unbilled work.

  • Prepare complete project and service records for operational review and billing.

  • Turn recurring problems into better procedures, checklists and systems.

What We Are Looking For

  • Professional spoken and written English and Spanish.

  • Experience in construction coordination, field-service operations, property maintenance or a similar environment.

  • Strong leadership and the confidence to hold employees, subcontractors and suppliers accountable.

  • Ability to coordinate multiple projects and urgent service requests under pressure.

  • Strong independent problem-solving and research skills.

  • A proactive approach: identify risks and communicate before they become emergencies.

  • Knowledge of construction budgeting, job costing and basic financial analysis.

  • Ability to review budget-versus-actual costs, labour productivity and projected cost to complete.

  • Strong Excel, organizational and digital-system skills.

  • Professional customer communication and complaint-management skills.

  • Good judgment about when to act independently and when approval is required.

  • Persistence when the first solution does not work.

  • Reliable internet, computer and professional remote workspace.

  • A genuine desire to build a stable, long-term career with Sellax Roofing.

Commercial roofing and JobTread experience are preferred but are not mandatory for someone with strong construction or field-service experience who can learn quickly.

The Right Person for This Position

You will succeed in this role if you naturally take ownership, follow through without reminders and continue working until an issue is resolved.

You are comfortable finding missing information, making decisions, having difficult conversations and coordinating people remotely. You do not simply report problems—you investigate them, develop options and recommend the best next action.

We value honesty, reliability, long-term commitment and people who want to help build better systems as the company grows.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Projects and service calls remain organized and moving.

  • Crews arrive prepared with the required access, materials and equipment.

  • Customers receive timely and professional communication.

  • Commitments are completed without repeated management follow-up.

  • Preventable delays, wasted trips and idle labour are reduced.

  • JobTread information remains accurate and current.

  • Budget and profitability risks are identified early.

  • Change-order and billing documentation is complete.

  • Recurring operational problems are converted into lasting improvements.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a live interview in both English and Spanish and work through practical construction, customer-service and problem-solving scenarios.
