jobs.excerpt: Health Resources in Action, Inc.  (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health.
jobs.description:
Health Resources in Action, Inc. (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health. We connect, consult, and collaborate to solve complex challenges of access and equity in our health and social systems. Together with our partners, clients, and collaborators, we create actionable solutions so that all people can thrive.

In 1957, The Medical Foundation (TMF) was created to primarily fund biomedical research in Massachusetts. Since then, we’ve been on a journey of evolution. We changed our name to Health Resources in Action (HRiA) to reflect our impact in the field of public health. Today, HRiA works with individuals, organizations, and communities to drive a policy and systems change approach to advance health and racial equity.

HRiA seeks sustainable solutions for complex problems using an anti-racist approach. We aim to be adaptable and flexible in meeting clients and partners where they are, offering our decades of knowledge and resources to collectively realize our dream of equitable, sustainable health for all. The foundation of this work is centered on our values:

  • Health and racial equity by identifying and addressing the root causes of health inequities, intentionally working to shift narratives and power imbalances and disrupt all systems of oppression.
  • Leading with heart by demonstrating our passionate commitment to our work, continuously challenging ourselves with humility and vulnerability while pursuing and holding ourselves accountable to our mission.
  • Collaboration by intentionally and respectfully leading, partnering, and following to strengthen relationships, uplift different voices and build trust.
  • Innovation by driving toward new strategies, questioning norms, and continuously learning and evolving to support the needs of our clients and communities.

HRiA offers exciting, engaging, and challenging employment opportunities for facilitators, trainers, researchers, analysts, policy specialists, grant managers, and more. People come to HRiA because of our commitment to advancing health equity and inspiring work; they stay for our wonderful clients, partners, and dedicated and dynamic staff. With our growing portfolio of high-impact work, person-centered policies, and generous benefits, our team continually invests in making HRiA a great place to work. Our diverse staff of over 270 people hail from 30+ states, with a homebase in Boston’s Chinatown neighborhood.

As part of our Public Health Services, HRiA manages an extensive portfolio of behavioral health initiatives, including statewide substance use helplines in Vermont and Oregon and substance use and problem gambling helplines in Massachusetts and Illinois. The Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) was launched in 2017, building upon our experience operating the MA Substance Use Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Bureau of Substance Addiction Services) for over 23 years. HRiA launched the Vermont Helplink (Vermont Department of Health, Division of Substance Use Programs) in 2019. HRiA began operating the MA Problem Gambling Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Office of Problem Gambling Services) in 2020 and the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) in 2022. In December 2023, HRiA launched the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline, now the Oregon Hopeline (Oregon Health Authority).

The Helpline contact center is the hub for the Helplines. Screening & Information Specialists (SIS) comprise most of the contact center team and respond to incoming Helpline inquiries. Four Contact Center Supervisors provide Helpline services and provide direct supervision to a portion of the SIS team. Three Masters-level Clinicians supervise a portion of the SIS, implement follow-up services, and provide additional coverage and support. Additional Helpline team members deliver and support program operations, marketing and communication, web management, and data analysis and management, supervision, and leadership. The larger team is overseen by the Managing Director, Behavioral Health.

To learn more about HRiA and our helplines, visit the following:

  • HRiA:
  • IL Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • MA Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • IL Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances:
  • VT Helplink: www.VTHelplink.org
  • MA Substance Use Helpline:
  • Oregon Hopeline:

Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team on the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline (Oregon Hopeline), Massachusetts Substance Use & Problem Gambling Helplines (MA Helpline), the Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (IL Helpline), the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline, and the Vermont Helplink (VT Helplink). This is an exciting opportunity to take on a newly developed position to support substance use treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

Position Description

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team for the MA Helpines, the IL Helplines, and VT Helplink. We refer to these projects collectively as “the Helplines.” This is an exciting opportunity to support substance use treatment and problem gambling treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

The Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for handling incoming Helpline inquiries and providing supervisory support to the contact center team. A portion of their time is providing scheduled and as-needed Helpline coverage, in addition to our dedicated team of 22 Screening & Information Specialists (SIS). This includes responding to incoming calls, online chats, and SMS text messages from people seeking information about and help with accessing substance use and/or problem gambling services for themselves, a family member or friend, and/or a client. In this capacity, they assess Helpline users’ needs, determine the most appropriate substance use prevention, treatment, and/or recovery support service options, identify available options (through the Helplines’ databases), and refer callers to those services. They provide accurate information, education, support, and referrals in a non-judgmental, respectful, and culturally competent manner.

About half of their time, Contact Center Supervisors provide supervisory support to the SIS team. Each Supervisor acts as a shift supervisor for SIS while they are working. This includes monitoring SIS consumer interactions, consulting with SIS and intervening during difficult interactions, and addressing any urgent issues as well as supporting the social-emotional wellbeing of staff and fostering their skill-building and professional growth. The Contact Center Supervisor will provide on-going training to SIS through periodic in-service trainings on relevant topics and will assist in the onboarding of new SIS.

Each Supervisor also directly supervises up to six SIS team members. This includes providing bi-weekly supervision, processing timesheets, and assisting with schedule coordination. (SIS also receive regular, group-level supervision from one of our Clinicians.) Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for supporting contact center operations, including helping to coordinate a 24/7 coverage schedule, staffing, and technology needs. They are the liaisons between the contact center team and information technology (IT) support. The Contact Center Supervisor will also be called upon to contribute expertise to the development of policies, procedures, protocols, and curricula to support the Helplines, and may be engaged in providing this expertise to other HRiA teams and projects focused on substance use, problem gambling, and/or behavioral health equity.

This is a full-time, remote position with a salary range of $57,000 to $64,000 based on skills and experience. Supervisors will receive training to assess the needs of Helpline users, provide appropriate information and referrals to services, and engage with and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals. They will also receive training on Contact Center operations, supervision essentials, and addiction, screening, treatment services, and resources.

Benefits

HRiA offers strong benefits to its employees, including:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Health insurance
  • Retirement plan
  • Flexible summer hours
  • Vacation starting at four weeks
  • 13 paid holidays, and office closure at the end of December

Duties and Responsibilities

Management

  • Coordinate and implement projects related to contact center operations, including technology, equipment, onboarding & training, among others, as assigned.
  • Work with Helpline Management to coordinate Helpline staffing schedules to ensure continuous 24-hour staffing coverage.
  • Serve as liaison between SIS and other project and organizational teams, to ensure appropriate representation and facilitate team integration.
  • Supervise up to six SIS.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.

Project Work

  • Troubleshoot technical contact center issues, and serve as liaison to IT support.
  • Assist with coordination and implementation of onboarding and professional development activities.
  • Assess the needs of Helpline users by telephone, online chat, and SMS texting.
  • Provide appropriate information and referrals to substance use, problem gambling, and/or related services.
  • Engage and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals by using active listening and motivational interviewing techniques.
  • Obtain feedback on interactions with Helpline users.
  • Gather and record data from Helpline users in Helpline database.
  • Verify Helpline users’ insurance status, as applicable.
  • Escalate Helpline user interactions to Helpline Managers as needed.
  • Represent the Helpline at outreach events, meetings, and/or presentations as needed.

Thought Leadership

  • Continue to build and develop expertise in substance use disorders, problem gambling, and behavioral health equity.
  • Suggest ideas/improvements through participation in teams and committees.
  • Attend and actively participate in Helpline meetings and other activities to develop skills and make suggestions for project enhancements.

New Business Development

  • Maintain updated resume and bio for use in new business proposals.
  • Assist with technical components of new business proposals as needed.

Candidate Qualifications

  • Five years of related experience (lived or professional) in the fields of substance use, recovery, problem gambling, and/or harm reductions Services, and manage mentor bachelor’s degree in psychology, social work, human services, or related field in lieu of experience.
  • Certified Resource Specialist (through Inform USA) preferred or willingness to obtain certification (at HRiA expense) within one year of hire.
  • Demonstrated experience and ability to supervise staff, and provide appropriate guidance, feedback, mentorship, and support.
  • Experience in information and referral services, customer service, counseling, substance use, problem gambling, or human services required.
  • Ability to adapt to changes in work environment and expectations.
  • Customer/consumer focused with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Good computer skills and experience and/or ability to use online systems and databases.
  • Openness to information that may be different from personal views.
  • Willingness to work with consumers who may be ambivalent, resistant, impaired or have psychological disorders.
  • Must be open to providing information about a variety of treatment options and paths to recovery based on a caller’s needs.
  • Must be respectful of cultural differences and value diversity of thought, backgrounds, and perspectives.
  • Must have high ethical standards and a willingness to comply with professional expectations.
  • Demonstrated history of dependability needed.
  • Two years of sobriety requested for people in recovery.
  • Fluency in a language other than English (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin) is a plus.

Hours for this position will be non-traditional, requiring either early morning or late evening and weekend availability. The position includes weekend or overnight on-call duties. The Helplines are open 24 hours/day, 7 days/week, 365 days a year.

This description is intended to indicate the kinds of work duties that will be required in this position. It is not intended to limit, or in any way modify, the rights of any supervisor to assign, direct, and contract work of staff under his/her supervision. The use of a particular illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties, not mentioned, that are of a similar level or difficulty.

Procedure for Candidacy

HRiA is actively seeking to build a diverse and experienced staff. The organization encourages multiple perspectives and experiences, supports a multicultural environment, and strives to hire and retain a diverse work force that reflects the populations we work with and the communities where we work. Diversity is a core value of HRiA resulting in culturally competent services, materials, resources, and programs. Our hiring and business practices appreciate the strengths offered through different backgrounds.

HRiA is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

  • Experience with Microsoft 365 Purview Center administration and configuration.
  • Knowledge of data governance principles within the Microsoft ecosystem.
  • Hands-on experience implementing sensitivity labels, retention policies, and DLP rules.
  • Experience with compliance query languages and/or scripting (e.g., PowerShell).
  • Excellent communication skills for client engagement and teamwork.
  • Current Microsoft certifications related to compliance and security (or willingness to obtain within 90 days).

  • Experience across all Microsoft Purview workloads.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for compliance automation.
  • Experience with risk assessment methodologies and compliance reporting.
  • Understanding of Zero Trust principles as applied to data security.

  • Lead the design and deployment of Microsoft Purview data security and compliance solutions for organizations ranging from mid-market to global enterprises.

BlueVoyant is an AI-driven cybersecurity company dedicated to standing between our customers and cyber threats. By combining human, artificial, and proprietary intelligence, we deliver a unified solution that protects every organization’s network, identities, vendors, and digital footprints as a single attack surface. The company’s award-winning Microsoft Security expertise helps organizations maximize their security investments while reducing risk and ensuring compliance.

Led by CEO, John Hernandez, BlueVoyant’s highly skilled team includes former government cyber officials with extensive frontline experience in responding to advanced cyber threats on behalf of the National Security Agency, Federal Bureau of Investigation, Unit 8200, and GCHQ, together with private sector experts. About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

About the Role

As a Founding Engineer, you will become the first and only in-house engineering headcount for an AI-native Professional Services Automation platform serving growing agencies and consultancies. The live platform brings projects, people, time and financials into one operating view, with ambient AI monitoring delivery and recommending action.

You will have end-to-end ownership across frontend, backend and infrastructure. You will harden, scale and evolve the existing platform while continuing to deliver customer-facing improvements. The role is a senior/staff-level individual contributor position rather than a CTO role today, although its scope may grow with the company.

Responsibilities

    • Own the product end-to-end as a solo generalist, building, shipping and deploying across frontend, backend and infrastructure without a supporting team.
    • Keep the live platform healthy, including handling incidents and defects and managing safe releases and rollback.
    • Use AI/agentic coding tools to increase personal output while independently verifying correctness, security and robustness rather than trusting AI-generated output blindly.
    • Lead the platform towards ISO 27001 and SOC 2 readiness by April 2027, translating external compliance requirements into concrete engineering controls; prior certification experience is not required.
    • Make the AI assistant and orchestration features reliable, measurable and safe.
    • Decide what to preserve, isolate, improve or replace in the current platform based on customer risk and commercial value, without undertaking an unnecessary rebuild.
    • Move fluidly across frontend and backend as a true full-stack generalist, with no fixed frontend/backend split.
    • Harden, scale and evolve the existing product, including delivery intelligence, AI assistant, SOW ingestion, project/resource/commercial management and a beta orchestration layer, while continuing to ship customer-facing improvements.
    • Work solo end-to-end as the company's hands-on technical owner, with the potential to help decide on and shape the first supporting engineering hire once funding closes.
    • Work effectively with high ambiguity, evolving scope and close, direct collaboration with both technical and non-technical founders.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally including early-stage startup or high-ownership experience.
  • 5+ years of senior-level full-stack engineering experience across a React/TypeScript frontend and Node/Postgres-style backend, or a strong modern JavaScript/TypeScript full-stack equivalent such as Next.js or Vue/Nuxt, with proven end-to-end ownership.
  • 4+ years of senior-level experience with solo ownership of cloud deployment, releases and CI/CD, or a proven record of shipping and operating production infrastructure without a dedicated DevOps/platform team.
  • 3+ years of senior-level experience with Postgres/Supabase or equivalent, including row-level security and edge functions. Deep relational database experience with another Postgres-based backend, Firebase or PlanetScale is also acceptable.
  • 1–2+ years of senior-level experience using AI-assisted/agentic coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or Copilot to ship production software, or demonstrable heavy and disciplined use of LLMs within a professional development workflow.
  • Have a clear method for checking AI-generated output rather than trusting it blindly.
  • Be comfortable operating as a senior/staff-level individual contributor generalist and owning a product or platform end-to-end solo or near-solo; formal project-leadership titles are not required.

Nice to Have

    • 1–2+ years of LLM application engineering experience covering prompt design, evaluation, grounding and orchestration/agent safety, or evidence of fast, rigorous learning in a new technical domain.
    • 2+ years of security fundamentals covering multi-tenant access control, secrets management and authentication/OAuth, or a security-conscious engineering track record without a formal security title.
    • Experience translating ISO 27001/SOC 2 requirements into engineering practice. No prior certification experience is required, but you must be able to research and implement compliance requirements independently ahead of the April 2027 target.
    • 2+ years of startup/founding engineer or small-team, high-ownership experience, or a track record of shipping solo or near-solo end-to-end without a supporting team.
    • 1+ year of rapid-prototype/AI-generated codebase remediation experience, such as with Lovable, v0 or Bolt-originated codebases, or experience stabilising and hardening fast-built code of any origin.
    • 1+ year of Stripe billing/payments API integration experience, or experience with another payments or metering API integration.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Core IT team builds the systems, processes, and experiences that let every team at Samsara do its best work. As a Principal Business Systems Analyst, you'll own the programs with the broadest scope and highest impact on the team. These are the ambiguous, cross-functional problems that touch multiple systems and multiple stakeholders, and that shape how Core IT operates going forward. You'll work directly with senior IT leadership and stakeholders across the business, and your frameworks and judgment will set the standard other analysts learn from.

This role is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. Your work will have real-world impact: helping keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and keep workers safe on the job.
  • You want to own problems, not just execute against ones someone else already scoped. At this level, you'll define the problem space for some of Core IT's most significant and ambiguous issues, and the frameworks and standards you build will be what other analysts learn from.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to keep growing. If you put in the work, this won't be your last role at Samsara. We've built a culture that rewards fast development and gives people real room to master their craft as the company keeps growing.
  • You want colleagues who make you better. You'll work alongside people who support each other's work, push each other to think more rigorously, and share the credit when something goes well.

In this role, you will:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of Core IT's highest-impact projects and programs, from problem definition through implementation, across multiple systems and business domains.
  • Define the problem space on the organization's most significant and ambiguous issues, rather than solving problems that are already scoped, and advise IT leadership on how to think about entire classes of problems, not just the issue in front of them.
  • Build the requirements practices, frameworks, and standards that other analysts and the broader team adopt, raising the bar for how Core IT approaches requirements, process design, and systems thinking.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to IT leadership and senior stakeholders across the business on organizational design, systems architecture, and process strategy.
  • Manage IT's engagement with the rest of the business on the programs you own: gathering requirements, coordinating resources, planning timelines, and communicating with stakeholders.
  • Drive operational excellence: develop a deep understanding of IT engineering, support, and operations (financials, services, performance metrics, SLAs, and so on) and work with IT management to provide the context that drives decision-making.
  • Develop, evaluate, and refine business processes, and propose improvement strategies that scale across the organization.
  • Mentor other analysts and engineers, and help them grow into the next level of scope and independence.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of business systems analysis, strategy, or architecture experience at a large-scale organization.
  • Deep expertise in requirements strategy, organizational design, systems thinking, and process optimization, with mastery of the analytical disciplines behind them: data analysis, process optimization, and requirements architecture.
  • A demonstrated track record advising senior leadership on complex, strategic decisions, including experience with large-scale organizational transformation or system architecture decisions.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Excellent influence skills: the ability to build trust and move decisions forward with stakeholders and teams that don't report to you, from individual contributors to executive leadership.
  • Strong analytical rigor and the communication skills to bring senior stakeholders along, in writing and in the room.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex, concurrent programs end-to-end, with full independent judgment on how to structure and staff them.
  • Strong data management and analysis skills (Google Sheets/Excel, Splunk, and similar tools).
  • Experience with corporate security and compliance programs: operating internal controls, preparing evidence for audits, and ensuring proper data handling in response to requests under SOX, FedRAMP, GDPR, CCPA, or similar privacy regulations.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$111,265—$149,600 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Commercial & Contractual Ownership

Cross-Functional Collaboration

jobs.title: Full-Time Telehealth Dietitian – Women’s Health (Salary + Benefits) Pacific Time
jobs.excerpt: Simplex Health is seeking a Women’s Health Dietitian (Registered Dietitian, RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient medical nutrition therapy using an integrative and functional nutrition approach.
jobs.description:
Simplex Health is seeking a Women’s Health Dietitian (Registered Dietitian, RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient medical nutrition therapy using an integrative and functional nutrition approach. This fully remote role focuses primarily on pregnancy and prenatal nutrition, including gestational diabetes (GDM), while also supporting women with hormonal imbalance, PCOS, fertility, perimenopause, gut health, and metabolic health.

Unlike many outpatient roles, this position offers a full-time, salaried structure with benefits, providing stability and consistency in your schedule and income—while giving you the flexibility to choose a schedule that fits your lifestyle.

The ideal candidate has experience in clinical or outpatient nutrition counseling, is licensed (or eligible for licensure) in Pennsylvania, and is passionate about delivering personalized, root-cause care to support long-term health outcomes.

Our Mission: Radically improve the health of Humankind—one person, one appointment, one connection at a time.

At Simplex Health, we do things differently. Our insurance-funded medical nutrition therapy goes beyond symptom management to improve — and in many cases reverse — chronic conditions, with a strong focus on women’s health, pregnancy, and metabolic care. We partner with hospitals, healthcare practices, and individuals to provide personalized nutrition support, especially for women navigating pregnancy, gestational diabetes (GDM), hormonal imbalances, and related conditions.

Our approach centers on prevention, root-cause resolution, and sustainable lifestyle change, helping patients feel supported during critical life stages like pregnancy and beyond. Services are delivered virtually through telehealth, allowing us to meet patients where they are with accessible, high-quality care.

Our evidence-based, progressive nutrition interventions consider each patient’s unique biochemistry. Through nutrition counseling, education, health coaching, and ongoing support, we empower patients — particularly women — to achieve healthy pregnancies, improve metabolic health, and create lasting, sustainable outcomes.

Role details:

  • Location: Telehealth
  • Schedule Options: Choose between a 4-day (32-hour) or 5-day (40-hour) work week, with flexibility to design a schedule that fits both your preferences and your patients’ needs.
  • Reports to: Senior Clinical Director
  • Compensation:
    • 32 hours/week (4-day work week): $44,000–$59,000 annually
    • 40 hours/week (5-day work week): $55,000–$70,000 annually
    • Final schedule and compensation are aligned based on candidate preference, experience, and availability

You love helping women feel confident and supported during pregnancy, especially when navigating challenges like gestational diabetes. You just don’t love doing it all alone.

If you’ve ever run or dreamed of running your own private practice, you know what it takes. The marketing, the scheduling, the billing, the insurance headaches, the empty calendar days, the tech issues, and the isolation.

At Simplex Health, you get the best parts of private practice, including autonomy, flexibility, and deep one-on-one relationships with patients, without the burnout or business stress.

Here, you get to focus on what you do best: helping women through pregnancy, gestational diabetes (GDM), and hormone-related conditions using an integrative and functional nutrition approach.

What we are looking for:
We are seeking mission-driven dietitians (RD/RDN) who:

  • Are passionate about women’s health, pregnancy, and gestational diabetes (GDM)
  • Take an integrative and functional nutrition approach to care
  • Thrive in a collaborative, growth-minded environment
  • Have at least 2 years of experience in outpatient or clinical care
  • Have experience or strong interest in prenatal nutrition, GDM, or hormone-related conditions
  • Hold current registration with CDR
  • Are credentialed or open to being credentialed with insurance companies
  • Want to spend more time with patients and less time running a business

Preferred:

  • Availability for evening appointments strongly preferred to meet patient demand, with flexibility based on individual scheduling needs.
  • CDCES (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist) strongly preferred
  • IFNA Certified (IFNCP credential a plus); candidates actively enrolled in IFNA training welcome
  • Prior experience supporting pregnant patients or managing gestational diabetes

PA license and completion of major insurance credentialing required before start; this process may take 3–6 months.

Role Responsibilities (including but not limited to):

  • Provide telehealth medical nutrition therapy using a functional and integrative approach, with a primary focus on pregnancy and gestational diabetes (GDM)
  • Assess nutritional health of patients/clients with attention to prenatal needs, blood sugar regulation, and hormone-related conditions
  • Monitor and review daily blood glucose logs for GDM patients, providing timely feedback, adjustments, and ongoing support
  • Educate and train patients on proper use of glucose meters and blood sugar monitoring techniques
  • Develop and modify individualized nutrition care plans, with a focus on glycemic control during pregnancy
  • Coordinate care and communicate effectively with referring physicians and healthcare providers to ensure continuity of care
  • Implement Simplex Health protocols and materials in patient care
  • Document all new and follow-up appointments in the Healthie platform with strong attention to detail
  • Respond to all patient communications in a timely and supportive manner
  • Communicate openly and effectively to resolve work-related issues or conflicts
  • Proactively contribute to team collaboration and support team decisions and outcomes
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures
  • Stay current and forward-thinking with emerging research in women’s health, prenatal nutrition, and diabetes care
  • Manage a full and consistent patient caseload, ensuring timely follow-ups, continuity of care, and optimal patient outcomes

What to expect:

At Simplex Health, you’ll have access to:

  • Structured onboarding and training
  • Regular case reviews and clinical collaboration
  • Real-time support via team chat and peer connection
  • Team meetings and shared learning opportunities
  • Opportunities to contribute to committees, resources, and clinical initiatives
  • Credentialing: If you’re not yet in-network, our team fully manages the insurance credentialing process on your behalf, including covering all associated fees and handling the paperwork.
  • Ramp-Up To Full-Time: This role begins in a ramp-up phase with variable hours as your patient caseload grows, transitioning into a full-time, salaried schedule once full-time metrics are met. Our team provides consistent referrals and support to help you build a full and sustainable schedule as quickly as possible.

Benefits

  • Flexible Scheduling: Choose between 32 or 40 hours per week, with the ability to structure your schedule in a way that works best for you and your patients
  • 4-Day Work Week (32 hours): A condensed schedule option designed to support balance, energy, and sustainability
  • Performance-Based Bonus Opportunities: Earn additional income based on patient retention and face-to-face care time.
  • Supplement Commissions: Earn 12.5% of MSRP on supplements purchased through Fullscript, providing additional earning potential
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k) (after 90 days)
  • Discretionary Holiday Break: Office closed between Christmas and New Year’s
  • Fitness Allowance: Partial reimbursement for gym memberships, fitness classes, or wellness activities
  • Simplex Wellness on Demand: Free access to virtual fitness programs

Time Zone & Schedule:

Our operations and patient base are primarily in Eastern Standard Time (EST). Candidates in Pacific or Mountain time zones have the unique advantage of working standard daytime hours in their local time zone while providing essential evening coverage for our East Coast patients. Please note that administrative support is available from 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM EST, and while live attendance at team meetings is encouraged, recordings will be provided for those unable to join due to time zone differences.

Key Intangible Characteristics of the Ideal Candidate:

Called: A passion for our mission and a sense that this role and company are a strong fit for the blessings of your gifts, talents, passions, and experiences.. Must be mission-motivated with a resolve to overcome obstacles, anchored in a sense of purpose in this work.

Servant Leadership: Nobody is above any task, and we are all here to serve others. Every customer—internal or external—needs help, and the most powerful way to lead will be to serve.

Learning and Adaptive: As a startup with a big mission, new systems, technology, and situational adaptability are expected. This person must have an appetite for learning and skill improvement.

Grit, Resourcefulness & Entrepreneurial Spirit: Not everything will have a pre-planned solution. This person will have to be resourceful in figuring things out, resist feeling overwhelmed, and be willing to roll up their sleeves to make things happen. This person will have to have an open mind and good resolve, whether it’s looping in other people, finding answers online, or seeking best practices.

Organizational Skills: Being or becoming a constant organizational force. It will require a capacity for being open to change, discerning better processes, and prioritizing for improved outcomes.

Chemistry Fit: We have a unique and fun culture—we laugh, press in, work hard, and jump in to figure things out. Fitting into the team chemistry is essential.

High Character: We operate with a high trust culture. Personal values must fuel our work. Integrity, honesty, compassion, reconciliation, and diligence are all things this person must possess to flourish.

Energy & Enthusiasm: This person must bring joy and passion for work to the job. Encouraging and spurring on others on the mission while being self-motivated and positive is essential.

Multitasking: This is not a steady-state or static environment. Workflow will cycle, and interruptions are normal, so this person must be able to juggle and adjust on the fly.

Project Management: While multitasking, this person must be able to keep an eye on deadlines and critical dependencies, working to preserve them or source support proactively.

🌟 Why Dietitians Choose Simplex Health

Because great clinicians deserve great support.

🧾 We Handle Credentialing & Licensing
We cover insurance credentialing costs and reimburse for out-of-state license fees.

🎓 CEU Reimbursement
We invest in your professional growth and continued learning.

💻 Technology Reimbursement
Support for the tools you need to work efficiently and effectively.

💲 Recruitment Thank You Bonus
Bonus for any referrals hired by Simplex Health who stay at least 90 days

📋 Consistent Referrals & Quality Resources
A steady patient flow and high-quality patient-facing materials to support your care.

👥 Helpful Support Team & Quick Response Times
From scheduling to tech help, our support staff makes your day run smoother.

🌿 Approachable Leadership & Collaborative Culture
Leaders who listen, and a clinical community that truly supports one another.

🤝 Opportunities Beyond Patient Care
Get involved with social media, engagement projects, or hosting lunch & learns.

🌎 Broad Range of Clients, Deep Skill Development
Grow your counseling skills and confidence across a variety of cases.

💞 Strong Sense of Community
Even in a virtual environment, you’ll feel connected, encouraged, and supported.

If you’ve ever wished you could combine the freedom of private practice with the camaraderie and stability of a larger organization, this is where you belong.

Apply today and rediscover the joy of patient care without the grind of running a business.

Simplex Health Core Values:

Simplex Health strives to embody the following values and to apply them to every aspect of how we run our business, including how we interact with each other as teammates and leaders. These values also apply to how we interact with and continue to inspire our clients and strategic partners:

We Inspire Each Other
You are an important part of our team and together we make a collective intention to uplift and commit to one another. Through cultivating genuine, transparent, relationships, we create an environment that encourages individuals to dream big, take risks, and be bold. We aim to inspire and commit to everyone we touch. This sense of commitment and care sets the stage for a culture of accountability, where we hold ourselves and each other to the same high standards, taking the ownership necessary for achieving our goals.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
1 Thessalonians 5:11

We Always Learn and Grow
We at Simplex Health strive to be continual learners and to expand our abilities as people and as an organization. We educate ourselves, remain curious, and use evidence-based research to challenge our current understanding. We see mistakes and failure as great teachers and learning opportunities. When we stay engaged in the world with a growth mindset, it creates the right environment for us to thrive and make a meaningful impact on each other and on the world.
Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance.
Proverbs 1:5

We Think Big Picture What we do day in, day out, how we do it, and the decisions we make- shape who we are as a people and as a company. The details are super important, AND should always be guided by our wide perspective and an understanding of how we are impacting each other, our clients, and our business. Before making any major decision, ask yourself:

• Does it help us grow? How?

• Does it answer “how are we different and why should you care?”
• Is what I’m working on duplicatable and transferable (ie can I duplicate it and apply to other situations)? How?
• Does it challenge the status quo?
• Does it inspire?
• Does it tightly align with and advance our mission? How?
• Can it be more humanized and relatable?
• Does it unite us? How?
• Does it solve a problem? How?
Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.
I Corinthians 13:12

We Challenge the Status Quo:
We are inquisitive by nature. We are courageous! We are not afraid to go against the grain in our search for truth. We always question conventional wisdom- it’s how Simplex Health started- it’s what we do.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. Romans 12:2

We Cultivate Health and Vitality:
Being alive in a body is an incredible, temporary experience. Even though at times we feel pain and face challenges, our next breath is not guaranteed and is a HUGE gift. We experience EVERYTHING through our bodies, including thoughts, emotions, spirit, and our inspiration. We see health and vitality as the foundation for living a life that is happy, fulfilled, present, and productive.
Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.
3 John 1:2

We Embody Integrity:
We communicate with transparency and face conflict head-on. We do this with the understanding that we respect each other and recognize that we are on the same team working toward a unified noble mission with shared goals. We don’t compromise our morals or integrity no matter the context. When challenging scenarios arise, we approach them with honesty and trust that we are all holding the highest intentions, are committed to our values, and are making best efforts.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
Luke 6:31

We Simplify the Complicated:
We believe that complex problems don’t always require complex solutions. By simplifying the complicated and offering digestible, scalable solutions, we can pay more attention to the things that matter most. Simplicity- it’s the word that inspired our name - we make cultivating health and vitality simple.
Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.
Philippians 4:6

We believe Wonderly has the potential to be a $100B - $1T outcome. The market is massive: home service businesses across North America (a $2T market). We’ve raised over $50M from top-tier investors, have $20M a year in free cashflow from another product line (Motion) - all that $ gets pumped into Wonderly.


About the Hiring Manager

Hey, I'm Victoria. I lead Sales Operations here at Wonderly.

I've built phone teams at four different companies now, and the thing I've learned is that the resume tells you almost nothing. I've hired people with perfect backgrounds who fell apart on their first hard call, and people with no relevant experience who turned out to be the best on the floor. What actually predicts it: if you're quick, if you take feedback without getting weird about it, and if you care whether the customer gets handled right.

If you're a CSR or dispatcher at a home services company right now, you already have the hard part. You know what a real lead sounds like versus someone pricing around. You've handled the callback from the guy whose tech never showed. That instinct takes years and I can't teach it.

The pitch for doing it here instead: you'd do it for dozens of contractors instead of one, and when you spot something broken you can actually fix it. At most places you'd spend two years proving yourself before anyone let you near how things work. Here, if you've got a better idea about the callback cadence, you say it Monday and we're testing it Wednesday.

Fast, intense, not for everyone. But if you've ever been the person who could see exactly what was broken and had no way to change it, this is the job where you get to.


The Role

You'll call the leads we generate for our customers, qualify them fast, and book onsite appointments on the contractor's behalf — so all the business owner has to do is show up and close.

If you've run a board at a home services company, this will feel familiar. Same work, different seat:

  • Inbound and outbound calls on new leads, usually within seconds or minutes of the lead coming in

  • Qualify — job type, scope, urgency, budget, whether they're actually ready to move

  • Book the appointment into the contractor's calendar and confirm it sticks

  • Follow up on anyone who doesn't pick up, on a real cadence, until they're worked or they're dead

  • Keep the CRM spotless — every call, outcome, and next step logged, because our ad spend is targeted off that data

Speed is everything. The whole model works because we work leads faster and better than anyone, and you're the person who makes that real, call after call.


Why This Beats the Shop You're At Now

If you're a CSR or dispatcher today, you're probably:

  • The only person who really knows how the board works

  • Fielding angry calls that aren't your fault

  • Watching the owner leave money on the table because nobody's working the old leads

Here:

  • You do one thing and you do it well. Call leads, qualify, book. You're not also doing payroll, ordering parts, or chasing invoices.

  • The leads are already warm. We generate them. You're not cold calling.

  • Better tools. Everything in one place. No jumping between four systems.

  • A real path. This is the entry point to our sales org. Crush it and the road to BDR, senior sales, or ops is short.

  • You'd see it work across dozens of contractors, not one. You learn more in six months here than five years at one shop.


Backgrounds That Tend to Work

Strongest fit:

  • CSR, dispatcher, or scheduler at an HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, or restoration company

  • Anyone who's run a board on ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, or similar

  • Inside sales or appointment setting in the trades

Also works:

  • Call center, high-volume customer service, or any phone-first role

  • New grads who ran something serious — a club, a team, a side hustle, a sport

  • Retail, serving, anything high-volume and people-facing

Backgrounds we care less about:

  • Roles where the bar was showing up, not outcomes

  • Anything slow-paced or heavily scripted

What matters more than the resume:

  • You're comfortable on the phone all day and don't get rattled

  • You're fast, coachable, and competitive — you want to win

  • You're organized enough to keep clean records without being told twice

  • When something's off, you flag it and fix it

  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a real plus


Expectations

  • High call volume. This is a phone-first role.

  • Real ownership of your leads and booking targets within your first 2 weeks

  • Weekend coverage on a rotation. Leads come in on weekends and the whole point is that we work them faster than anyone. If you're not open to some weekend work, this isn't the role.

  • The scope evolves constantly. If you want a stable job description, this isn't it.


Full-Time or Part-Time

We're hiring both.

Full-time: 40+ hours, weekend rotation

Part-time: 20–30 hours with set shifts — good if you're currently at a shop and want to test this before jumping, or if you need a schedule that works around something else. Part-timers who perform get first look at full-time roles.

Tell us which you're after when you apply. Either way you get real leads, real targets, and real coaching.

Symmetrio is recruiting a Cloud Support Engineer for its customer, a rapidly growing international healthcare SaaS company aggressively expanding in the United states. The Cloud Support Engineer will be a trusted technical face to our customer’s stakeholders: oncology centers, clinics, and health systems. Collaborating with healthcare IT and clinical application teams across the United States, the Cloud Support Engineer will ensure reliability and provide professional IT support to users of the application. In this role, you'll provide Tier 1/Tier 2 technical support while serving as a collaborative member of our customer’s engineering team consisting of Site Reliability Engineers and Cloud Network Engineers. The Cloud Support Engineer will diagnose incidents and cases (SaaS application, AWS cloud infrastructure, customer network connectivity, etc.) and coordinate seamlessly with customer and internal engineering teams to resolve them. Additionally, the Cloud Support Engineer will develop support playbooks and documentation as the company scales, and help establish best practices for healthcare SaaS support—ideal for someone who combines technical problem-solving, healthcare IT domain expertise, and the professional presence and communication skills required by end users.

This is a full-time, remote position $90,000-$105,000 and a comprehensive benefits package, including health benefits, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and additional company-sponsored benefits.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical contact for assigned customers; represent the company professionally and build trust with customer IT directors, network engineers, and clinical leadership
  • Provide Tier 1/Tier 2 technical support via phone, email, and ticketing system; triage issues, diagnose root causes, and coordinate resolution with the Principal SRE and Cloud Network Engineers
  • Troubleshoot application performance issues within the SaaS platform; work with the SRE to identify degradation and escalate appropriately
  • Diagnose customer connectivity and network issues affecting SaaS platform access, including VPN tunnel health, AWS routing validation, and firewall rule problems; possess working knowledge of Cisco ASA, Fortinet, and Palo Alto firewall environments
  • Coordinate with customer firewall/network teams during troubleshooting; ask informed questions about firewall rules, NAT settings, and VPN tunnel parameters
  • Serve as the liaison between customer health system IT departments and internal engineering; gather detailed diagnostic information, validate customer network topology, and communicate complex cloud networking problems clearly
  • Develop and maintain support playbooks and runbooks focused on cloud networking scenarios specific to healthcare environments: VPN tunnel validation, connectivity health checks, firewall coordination during maintenance windows, and application troubleshooting
  • Support new customer onboarding; validate initial connectivity, work with customer IT/firewall teams to ensure proper VPN configuration, and coordinate go-live health checks
  • Proactively monitor customer health indicators (connectivity status, VPN tunnel status, application performance) and alert the SRE/Network Engineer to emerging issues before customers report.
  • Partner with the Cloud Network Engineer during customer firewall coordination calls; understand oncology center/health system network architectures and validate that connectivity requirements align with customer firewall policies
  • Build and maintain the support knowledge base with healthcare-specific scenarios; document common oncology center network configurations and troubleshooting patterns
  • Participate in on-call rotation for critical customer incidents, with escalation support from the SRE and Network Engineer

Requirements

  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty OR AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate
  • 2+ years of Tier 1/Tier 2 technical support experience in healthcare IT environments (hospitals, clinics, health systems)
  • Strong familiarity with healthcare network infrastructure and security; comfortable troubleshooting in regulated healthcare environments
  • Working knowledge of Cisco ASA firewalls; familiarity with Fortinet and Palo Alto environments a plus
  • Understanding of firewall rule configuration, VPN tunnel setup (Site-to-Site VPN basics), and how healthcare networks connect to external cloud applications
  • Experience supporting oncology centers, radiation therapy departments, or similar clinical IT environments strongly preferred
  • Experience supporting Epic EHR, OIS (Oncology Information Systems), or other healthcare applications
  • Understanding of cloud networking concepts: VPN connectivity, AWS VPCs, firewalls, routing (cloud-based, not traditional BGP/OSPF)
  • Experience troubleshooting connectivity issues between hospital networks and cloud environments preferred
  • Strong troubleshooting methodology; ability to think systematically through multi-layer problems (application, cloud infrastructure, customer network)
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical clinical staff and speak authoritatively with experienced hospital IT directors and network engineers
  • Professional demeanor and strong customer service orientation
  • Experience with ticketing systems, knowledge base tools, and technical documentation practices
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment with self-management and time-zone flexibility for U.S. customer base
  • Collaborative mindset; comfortable escalating appropriately and partnering with senior engineers
  • Willingness to develop and own support processes and playbooks in a rapidly growing organization

Given the customer-facing nature of this role, interviews with qualified candidates will be conducted via Microsoft Teams or another video conferencing platform.

jobs.description:

Banner Solutions is built on a culture of ownership, collaboration, and accountability. Our team members are empowered to make an impact while delivering the expertise, service, and reliability our customers depend on.

C O R E R E S P O N S I B I L I T I E S

The Senior Software Engineer — .NET / Integration / Automation will serve as a hands-on technical contributor within Banner Solutions' Chief Digital Officer organization, working directly with the Systems Architect to build and maintain the integrations, automation workflows, and AI-powered systems that run Banner's operations.

Reporting directly to the Systems Architect, this role is part of the CDO organization and operates across multiple platforms and business functions. The Senior Software Engineer will take architectural direction and independently carry substantial features or integrations through to completion.

This is not a ticket-driven role. The ideal candidate takes a well-framed problem, asks the right questions, makes the technical decisions that are theirs to make, and delivers working software — pulling the Systems Architect back in at the decision points that actually matter.

Integration & Systems Development

  • Build and maintain integration workflows connecting core platforms including P21 (ERP), Salesforce, Akeneo (PIM), Algolia, and Canals.ai — "make these three systems work together reliably" is a common problem here
  • Design and implement APIs, background jobs, and automation pipelines that handle real transactional volume reliably
  • Debug across system boundaries — trace problems through multiple systems rather than stopping at the code immediately in front of you
  • Ensure integrations perform well, fail gracefully, and are maintainable by the team over time
  • Write code with good testing instincts: how do we prove this works, what happens when it fails, and what edge cases are we missing?

AI-Augmented Development

  • Build integrations against LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar — to power Banner's automation initiatives in areas including order processing, customer communications, and purchasing operations
  • Apply AI development tools fluently as part of daily work: to move faster, explore approaches, and think more thoroughly — while applying independent engineering judgment to what the tools produce
  • Contribute to automation workflows that reduce manual labor and improve operational consistency across Banner's distribution business

Technical Ownership & Judgment

  • Receive architectural direction from the Systems Architect and independently drive significant features or integrations through to completion
  • When something unexpected surfaces: investigate it, determine root cause, make the call if it's yours to make, and bring a clear recommendation back if it's architectural or business-related
  • Make normal technical decisions without asking permission — and recognize when a decision has crossed into territory that needs a conversation
  • Take business problems that aren't perfectly specified and turn them into working software, asking the questions that matter rather than waiting for a complete ticket

Q U A L I F I C A T I O N S

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of professional software development in a production environment
  • Experience within distribution, supply chain, e-commerce, or similarly complex operational environments preferred
  • Strong C#/.NET — this is the core of what Banner builds
  • Solid SQL — read stored procedures, write good queries, and recognize performance problems at scale
  • Comfortable with Azure and cloud environments — Banner is actively moving workloads to the cloud
  • API design, background services, and multi-system integration development
  • Able to debug across system boundaries, not just the code immediately in front of you
  • Good testing instincts for real-world edge cases and failure modes
  • Already using AI development tools effectively as a genuine part of daily work

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience integrating against LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) — rate limits, error handling, cost management, and applying them to real business problems rather than just experimentation
  • Experience with Epicor Prophet21 (P21) or a similarly complex distribution/wholesale ERP
  • Familiarity with Akeneo, Algolia, Salesforce, Canals.ai, or similar platforms
  • Experience building AI or automation workflows — document processing, workflow orchestration, or intelligent routing
  • EDI or supply chain integration experience

We'd rather hire a strong engineer who can learn our systems than narrow the pool for someone who happens to already know our exact stack.

Cultural Fit & Attributes

  • When something breaks: investigate it, prove what's happening, propose a fix that preserves intended behavior, and escalate only if it's architectural or business-related — not every problem needs to come back up
  • Takes well-framed problems, asks useful questions, and delivers working software rather than waiting for a complete specification
  • Comfortable making technical decisions independently, and calibrated about when a decision has crossed into territory that needs a conversation
  • Embody Banner Solutions' values ofCourtesy, Respect, Quality, Professionalism, and Discipline
  • Genuinely collaborative — works well with the Systems Architect, cross-functional teams, and business stakeholders
  • Balance speed and quality — moves fast without creating problems that slow the team down later
  • Comfortable across both backend and web code — not helpless when something crosses a layer

S U C C E S S M E T R I C S — F I R S T 1 2 M O N T H S

Success will be measured by the ability to take ownership of substantial work and deliver it independently, with technical judgment, engineering quality, and escalation calibration that earns the confidence of the Systems Architect.

The Senior Software Engineer will help ensure:

  • At least one significant integration or automation feature is delivered with minimal implementation-level direction
  • Problems are investigated and diagnosed rather than surfaced — escalations come with root cause analysis and a proposed solution
  • AI development tools are a measurable part of how this engineer works, accelerating delivery without compromising quality
  • The Systems Architect is confident handing a meaningful piece of the system to this engineer and trusting it will come back done
  • Technical decisions are made at the right level — autonomously when appropriate, escalated clearly when architectural or business-related
  • The team's codebase is left more maintainable, better tested, and more reliable as a result of this engineer's contributions

jobs.excerpt: Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web.
jobs.description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
As a Security Engineering Lead on our team, you'll be leading the security and auditing efforts for Espresso's codebase leading up to, and beyond, launch. We are looking for an experienced security engineering and software auditing professional who can lead review processes of our design and codebase. Experience in the domains of EVM smart contracts and/or Rust distributed systems is preferred for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Lead security audits of (a subset of) the Espresso codebase
  • As a project leader, you will have mobility in how you choose to organize security and audit efforts
  • Dive into the code of a fairly complex distributed system, learning and developing an understanding of the system on the fly (with help from the engineering team that built it, of course)
  • Coordinate with several engineering teams to aid in your audit, raise concerns and communicate results, and guide the effort to harden the system based on your findings
  • Coordinate with, manage, and review the work of external security auditing teams, in certain cases
  • Suggest improvements to testing and engineering practices to promote more secure and maintainable code

Requirements

  • Solid grasp of software engineering principles, both low-level (e.g. language-specific best practices) and high-level (e.g. reliable software architecture, particularly in distributed systems)
  • If focused on Rust: ≥ 1 year experience writing Rust, particularly with async Rust.
  • If focused on Solidity: Multiple years experience writing smart contracts; experience with smart contract security audits or formal verification of smart contracts
  • Experience as an engineer or software architect in a security-critical industry
  • Be capable of describing the stakes, the challenges you've faced in building secure software, and the steps/processes you've taken to mitigate risk
  • Experience as an auditor, pentester, QA tester, etc.
  • Have a well thought-out approach to testing software and designing it to be testable/auditable
  • Ability to think adversarially, and identify potential reliability or security vulnerabilities even in software that is correct in common or “happy path” scenarios
  • Experience on the design and/or testing of distributed systems
  • Comfort diving into unknowns and asking questions

Preferred

  • Knowledge of relevant testing and static analysis tools (e.g. Foundry, Slither) is a plus
  • Blockchain knowledge/experience is preferred, but could also be include IoT, automotive, finance, etc.
  • Ideally, the candidate should have a general philosophy of software design that has been molded by experience working on security-critical systems

Benefits

  • Fully remote with flexible hours
  • Work alongside the brightest minds in the crypto space
  • Competitive salary + equity package
  • Regular team off-sites to international locations
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • Top-tier health, dental, and vision coverage for US employees

About Nimbus

Nimbus is a leading independent mediation platform powering monetization for some of the most sophisticated mobile publishers globally.

Our platform enables publishers to access brand and performance demand across SDK and server-side partnership integrations, delivering transparency, control, and measurable revenue outcomes in an increasingly complex ecosystem.

As the industry shifts toward auction-based monetization and supply path optimization (SPO), Nimbus is positioned as a neutral, high-performance alternative to legacy and vertically integrated platforms.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for an all-star Senior Publisher Partnerships Manager, in Gaming to help expand Nimbus’ relationships across leading mobile gaming publishers. This role will focus on identifying strategic partnership opportunities, growing publisher revenue, managing commercial discussions, and helping gaming publishers maximize monetization performance through Nimbus’ mediation and exchange platform.

How will you help us achieve it?

As a strategic member of the Publisher Partnerships team, you will own and grow relationships across a portfolio of mobile gaming publishers. Your primary objectives are to generate new business opportunities, expand existing publisher relationships, and help publishers maximize monetization outcomes across the Nimbus platform.

You value building trusted relationships and understand how to position Nimbus as a sophisticated, publisher-first monetization platform. You communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders and are comfortable navigating conversations around gaming monetization strategy, mediation, user acquisition dynamics, and mobile app growth.

You understand the complexities of the gaming monetization ecosystem and know how to identify opportunities across a wide range of gaming genres and publisher profiles. You are highly knowledgeable in the mobile gaming advertising landscape and understand the importance of balancing monetization performance, user experience, retention, and LTV optimization.

Internally, you are highly collaborative and work cross-functionally with Account Management, Demand Partnerships, Solutions Engineering, Product, Auction Science, and Executive Leadership to help deliver outstanding outcomes for publishers. Your teammates would describe you as relationship-oriented, proactive, analytical, entrepreneurial, and commercially driven.

The responsibilities of the role

Identify, develop, and close strategic partnerships with mobile gaming publishers across a variety of gaming verticals and app categories.

Manage and grow relationships with publisher accounts by understanding business objectives, identifying monetization opportunities, and positioning Nimbus as a long-term strategic partner.

Maintain strong understanding of and Lead publisher-facing conversations across:

  • Gaming monetization strategy
  • Mediation strategy
  • Programmatic monetization
  • SDK onboarding
  • Auction performance
  • Demand partner strategy
  • Yield optimization opportunities
  • Product adoption
  • Strategic growth initiatives

Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of gaming publisher opportunities through outbound prospecting, referrals, conferences, networking, and strategic relationship development.

Collaborate closely with Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Demand teams to ensure successful onboarding, operational alignment, and long-term publisher success.

Monitor publisher performance trends and work cross-functionally to identify opportunities that improve monetization outcomes and overall publisher satisfaction.

Represent Nimbus externally across industry conferences, client meetings, networking events, and strategic ecosystem conversations.

Assist with strategic GTM initiatives including:

  • Publisher presentations
  • Monetization recommendations
  • Case studies
  • Conference initiatives
  • Market intelligence
  • Ecosystem positioning

Support internal operational initiatives including pipeline management, forecasting, CRM updates, publisher onboarding coordination, and strategic account planning.

What you bring to the role

5+ years of ad tech experience with a strong understanding of the mobile gaming programmatic ecosystem, including gaming publishers, SSPs, DSPs, mediation platforms, and in-app monetization infrastructure.

Deep familiarity with gaming monetization, SDK-based advertising, user acquisition economics, and programmatic advertising across iOS and Android ecosystems.

Proven track record of developing and growing strategic gaming publisher relationships while driving measurable revenue growth and long-term account expansion.

Familiarity with major gaming monetization platforms and ecosystems including:

  • AppLovin MAX
  • LevelPlay
  • AdMob
  • Unity
  • Rewarded and interstitial monetization strategies

A passion for identifying growth opportunities and solving complex monetization challenges through strategic thinking, relationship building, and data-driven recommendations.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance trends, identify monetization opportunities, and communicate actionable recommendations to publishers.

Experience working cross-functionally with:

  • publishers,
  • account management,
  • product teams,
  • engineering,
  • solutions engineering,
  • and demand teams

while effectively communicating complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills with experience managing executive-level publisher conversations and long-term strategic partnerships.

Highly self-motivated and comfortable operating independently in a lean, fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

Effective time management skills with the ability to prioritize opportunities, manage multiple strategic relationships, and maintain strong attention to detail.

Professional demeanor and excellent verbal/written communication skills across in-person meetings, conferences, video calls, email, and Slack.

Existing relationships across the mobile gaming publisher ecosystem are strongly preferred.

BS or BA is desirable.

Nimbus offers a rare combination of sophisticated technology, a high-caliber team, and a premium, publisher-aligned platform operating independently in the market. With a strong demand footprint across both brand and performance, competitive compensation, and a balanced work-life dynamic, the company is positioned for sustained high growth with real momentum.
