jobs.description:
Join an organization at the forefront of improving health by transforming care through Centering® groups

Chief Executive Officer, Fractional

General Description

Centering Healthcare Institute (CHI) is a 25-year-old 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization whose mission is to champion and advance the evidence-based Centering group model of care to transform how healthcare is practiced and experienced, empowering healthcare providers and patients to improve health outcomes. CHI partners with approximately 400+ provider organizations across the U.S. to implement and sustain its three Centering group models of care -CenteringPregnancy®, CenteringParenting ®, and CenteringHealthcare ®.

The Opportunity

Centering Healthcare Institute (CHI) stands at a defining moment in its evolution and in the national movement for maternal and reproductive health equity. With expanding partnerships, rising public and policy attention to group prenatal care, and growing opportunities to shape systems of care, CHI is poised to amplify its national impact and redefine how communities experience health and belonging.

The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) will be a mission-driven and visionary leader who brings both strategic foresight and a deep commitment to CHI’s purpose. More than a steward of operations, the CEO will be a systems thinker and catalyst—someone who thrives in complexity, leads with courage and curiosity, and builds enduring partnerships rooted in trust and shared accountability.

CHI seeks a transformative governance leader who can inspire alignment across a distributed and diverse organization; cultivate relationships with funders, health systems, and policymakers; and guide CHI’s evolution into a more visible, connected, and resilient national platform for change. This leader will be ambitious yet grounded, collaborative yet decisive—balancing strategy with humanity and vision with execution.

The CEO will shape and advance CHI’s overall strategy and organizational structure, partnering closely with a high-performing executive leadership team. The CEO reports directly to the Board of Directors and serves as its key partner in governance, strategy, and sustainability.

This role offers a rare opportunity to define the future of CHI, architecting a thriving, future-ready organization that drives systemic impact in maternal and reproductive health. The CEO will work in close partnership with the Board, staff, and external allies to ensure that CHI’s mission, culture, and strategy are powerfully aligned for the years ahead.

Candidate Profile

The next CEO of CHI will be a strategic and values-rooted systems leader who brings both heart and vision to the role. Rather than solely executing plans, this leader will define the horizon, cultivate shared purpose, mobilize partners, and shape the future of equitable care through influence, insight, and innovation. The CEO will guide the organization through growth and systems change, anchoring CHI’s mission in measurable outcomes for families and communities.

The role oversees CHI’s strategic direction, organizational health, partnerships, financial sustainability, and influence across the healthcare landscape. Working closely with the Board of Directors and Executive Team, the CEO will ensure CHI’s programs, operations, and governance are aligned with a long-term vision for scale, systems impact, and sustainable excellence.

The CEO will steward CHI through its next phase of growth, optimizing infrastructure, ensuring operational alignment with mission and strategy, and empowering leaders across the organization to thrive. This includes championing continuous improvement and change management across systems, partnerships, and culture to position CHI as a model for equity centered healthcare innovation.

As the organization’s chief steward, the CEO will ensure that CHI’s operations, programs, and governance adhere to the highest standards of transparency, accountability, and performance. They will represent CHI nationally, building trust, visibility, and influence with policymakers, funders, health systems, and community partners.

As a member of and leader for the Executive Team, the CEO will foster collaboration, promote excellence, and strengthen the organization’s capacity for innovation, advocacy, and sustained impact. Reporting to the CEO is the Chief Financial Officer, Chief External Engagement/Chief of Philanthropy Officer, Chief Operating Officer/Chief People & Culture Officer.

The strategic leader stepping into this role has an opportunity to set a clear vision and direction for CHI’s future, guiding the organization into a new era of relevance, reach, and systems-level influence.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to excel in each of its essential functions. CHI’s next CEO brings experience and a passion for leadership in the following areas, which are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

Key Responsibilities

People & Culture Leadership

  • Foster a culture of belonging, collaboration, and innovation grounded in equity and trust.

  • Inspire teams through vision and shared accountability rather than control or hierarchy.

  • Lead with empathy, authenticity, and a deep commitment to collective healing and growth.

  • Additional duties as assigned.

Strategic Leadership & Vision

  • Envision and communicate a compelling future for CHI that inspires alignment across the organization and its partners.

  • Lead with curiosity, creativity, and courage, embracing complexity and charting pathways for transformative change in healthcare systems.

  • Position CHI as a trusted thought leader and convener in maternal and reproductive health equity, driving national dialogue and systemic reform.

  • Proactively assess opportunities, risks, and emerging trends to guide long-term organizational strategy.

Governance & Organizational Stewardship

  • Partner with the Board of Directors to strengthen governance, strategic oversight, and long-term sustainability.

  • Model integrity, transparency, and accountability, ensuring that decisions reflect CHI’s mission and values.

  • Cultivate leadership across the organization, empowering a distributed and high performing team.

External Relations, Influence & Advocacy

  • Serve as the organization’s chief advocate and public voice—building alliances with funders, policymakers, health systems, and community leaders.

  • Expand CHI’s reach through strategic partnerships and public thought leadership.

  • Leverage storytelling, evidence, and policy engagement to advance equity-centered systems of care.

Financial Sustainability & Resource Development

  • Lead philanthropic strategy and strengthen diversified revenue, including grants, earned revenue, payer partnerships, and government contracts.

  • Own and maintain strong institutional relationships with current and prospective funders, partners, and investors.

  • Ensure financial stewardship, transparency, and multi-year revenue planning.

Reporting Structure and Key Relationships

Reporting to the CEO is the Chief Financial Officer, Chief External Engagement/Chief of Philanthropy Officer, Chief Operating Officer/Chief People & Culture Officer.

Qualifications and Requirements

Experience:

  • Continuous professional development and staying informed to ensure the organization operates within legal frameworks and consistent with the best practices in the field, is required.

  • Master’s degree in a relevant discipline preferred, or at least ten years of senior executive experience in healthcare delivery, maternal health, public health, or adjacent fields.

  • Experience working with or leading mission-driven, nonprofit, or healthcare organizations with national scope and complex stakeholder ecosystems.

  • Prior experience in nonprofit governance, board partnership, and systems-level strategy preferred.

Skills:

  • Outstanding interpersonal, teamwork, and collaboration skills;

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills;

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail;

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management software

  • Demonstrated ability to maintain the highest ethical standards, including confidentiality and handling sensitive situations and information with the utmost discretion and diplomacy.

  • A demonstrated record of visionary leadership in advancing health equity, systems transformation, or large-scale social impact.

  • Proven ability to mobilize cross-sector partnerships, influence policy and practice, and strengthen organizational governance.

  • Exceptional strategic thinker who can balance aspirational vision with disciplined, values-based decision-making.

  • Skilled communicator and coalition-builder who unites diverse voices around a shared purpose.

  • Integrity, emotional intelligence, and resilience to lead through change.

Cultural Sensitivity:

  • Commitment to ideals of justice, equity, diversity and inclusion; and to fostering an anti-racist work culture and to anti-racist principles and learning.

  • Ability to uphold our core values of Accountability, Diversity & Equity, Partnership, Data-Driven decision-making, and Community.

Working Conditions

The Chief Executive Officer operates in a remote office-like environment. While adhering to a standard full-time work schedule, working irregular hours may be necessary. We prioritize adaptability, iterative approaches, and cross-functional collaboration, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Communication:Regular check-ins via [communication tools, e.g., Slack, Zoom, email] are required to maintain alignment, productivity and collaboration.

Productivity:Must be able to meet deadlines and deliver high-quality work without direct supervision. This utilizes standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and audiovisual systems

Travel:Travel to various locations may be expected for attending conferences, staff meetings and retreats, and any other relevant event.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Hi 👋 — I'm Pavlos Kallis, Head of Engineering at Douleutaras (YourHero).
jobs.description:
Hi 👋 — I'm Pavlos Kallis, Head of Engineering at Douleutaras (YourHero). We're looking for a senior backend engineer who wants to own hard problems end-to-end, cares more about the person on the other side of the code than about the ticket, and leaves our systems better than they found them.

We're a tech-enabled company disrupting home services — a €6 Trillion global market where less than 5% is online. Since 2015 we've helped 1,000,000+ customers across Greece, Cyprus, and Ireland find the right professional. Our 18,000+ active pros have earned €100m+ through the platform, we've collected 250,000+ reviews, and we hold an NPS of 75+. We're backed by top-tier European investors.

What you'll actually work on

No adjectives — here's the range of problems our engineering team owns, drawn straight from what we've shipped this year:

  • The matching & bidding engine. When a customer posts a job, we decide which professionals see it, in what order, and how they bid for it — the ranking, pro-scoring (refreshed hourly), and Extra Bids systems behind "who gets this job." Flood a good pro or starve a customer of offers and the marketplace breaks.
  • Money that has to be right. Online payments, pro subscriptions, cashback and bonuses, promo codes, VAT in quotes — moving money between customers, pros, and us across three countries and currencies, wired into Stripe and our Softone ERP.
  • Keeping it fast and boring while it grows. We migrated the whole platform onto Kubernetes and run platform-wide performance epics. You'll help keep a zero-downtime system quick and unexciting to operate — the highest compliment infrastructure can earn.

And around all of that: trust & safety, a healthy experimentation culture (real A/B/C tests on live funnels), Salesforce/CRM integrations, and an AI stack (FastAPI + LangGraph agents doing RAG over pgvector). It's a broad surface; you won't run out of interesting problems.

How we work

You'll join our engineering squad — one tight, cross-functional team: 2 backend, 2 frontend, 1 mobile, 1 QA, 2 PMs, and a designer — working from a shared roadmap. You sit close to the whole product, not in a backend silo. In practice:

  • You ship to production continuously through a rock-solid GitLab CI → ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts GitOps pipeline. Deploys are boring on purpose.
  • You own features end-to-end — design, build, test, monitor — and you're trusted to make technical calls in your area.
  • We review each other's code seriously and hold a high bar. Refactoring is expected, not begrudged.
  • We pair, we write things down, and we help each other across disciplines.

AI-assisted development

AI-assisted coding is a normal part of how we build here, not a novelty. We give engineers access to tools like Claude Code. What we care about is judgment: you use it to move faster on the mechanical parts, and you review what it produces as critically as any teammate's code. We don't measure you by how much AI you use — and "the AI wrote it" is never an excuse for code you don't understand or can't stand behind.

Why you should — or shouldn't — apply

I'd rather you self-select honestly than be surprised in month two.

You'll thrive here if:

  • You can't stand corporate bureaucracy. We're one small team that moves fast with minimal process — few meetings, a short path from idea to production, and no red tape between you and shipping.
  • You take ownership of ambiguous, high-stakes problems. You build the right abstraction, not just the requested change.
  • You care deeply about correctness and data. When money and a pro's livelihood ride on your code, "it seems to work" isn't enough. You reach for tests, metrics, and EXPLAIN plans.
  • You balance speed and quality. We ship fast, but we're not cowboys — we've earned trust by being reliable.
  • You communicate with candor and welcome direct feedback without getting defensive.
  • You act like an owner — accountable, goal-oriented, and generous with teammates.

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • You picture "senior / staff / lead" as mostly reviewing designs and signing off on architecture. Our most experienced engineers spend most of their time building — we hand them our hardest problems. They set technical direction and help others plan the tough work, but that's earned influence, not a gate: nobody needs their sign-off to ship.
  • You lose the forest for the trees. Once you're deep in implementation it's hard for you to zoom back out to the whole project — and you'd rather everything be specced upfront than adjust as you learn.
  • You haven't owned a project end-to-end. You're most comfortable when a tech lead slices the work into tickets and hands them over. Here you take a problem brief and drive it yourself.
  • You want only greenfield work. Real systems mean production incidents, legacy corners (we're retiring an old Angular frontend and some Gulp tooling), and customer investigations shared across the team.

Our tech stack

We care about fundamentals over stack familiarity; how you think and how fast you learn matter far more than years-in-Django.

  • Backend: Python 3.10, Django 4.2, DRF, UV, Docker
  • Data: PostgreSQL 14 / PostGIS, Elasticsearch 7.x, Redis, Memcached
  • Async: Celery on RabbitMQ
  • AI: FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI + Anthropic (Claude), pgvector
  • Frontend (adjacent): React, TypeScript, Flutter/Dart
  • Platform: Kubernetes (EKS) on AWS, Terraform, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts, Cloudflare
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, New Relic, Sentry, PostHog

Requirements

What we'd love you to bring

  • 5+ years building and scaling production backend services, with strong Python / Django and REST API depth.
  • You've designed systems, not just implemented tickets — you define service and API boundaries, weigh architectural trade-offs, and can explain why you chose one over another.
  • Real PostgreSQL depth at scale — data modeling, query optimization, indexing, and keeping correctness under concurrency (this is a money-handling marketplace).
  • Asynchronous / distributed systems experience — background processing, queues (Celery or similar), and a healthy respect for their failure modes.
  • You own what you ship in production — comfortable with observability, debugging live incidents, and treating tests as part of the work, not an afterthought.
  • Experience leading projects end-to-end and lifting the engineers around you — technical direction, serious code review, mentoring by example.
  • Comfort with Docker + Kubernetes, a major cloud (AWS preferred), and CI/CD;
  • Excellent English and interest in joining a remote, multicultural team.

Bonus points: Terraform (IaC) · FastAPI · LLM & agentic experience (LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, pgvector) · payments/fintech or marketplace background · a startup or high-performance-team environment.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and potential stock options
  • Group Health Insurance
  • The workstation of your choice
  • A bespoke development plan to grow fast and reach your potential
  • The genuine ownership of impacting millions of customers and thousands of pros — on an international team that works hard and has fun doing it

jobs.description:
Space Inch is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our engineering function within a long-standing partnership with one of the largest investment managers in the U.S. Partnering closely with our CTO, you'll be the most senior engineering leader on the account: owning day-to-day operational and people leadership, serving as the senior engineering point of contact for the client's stakeholders, and driving AI adoption across the team. This client operates in a highly regulated environment with work spanning many technical stacks, so we want someone who thrives in that variety and brings real operational excellence and care for engineers to an agency environment.

This is first and foremost a people-leadership and communication role. We're looking for an exceptional communicator who earns the trust of engineers and senior client stakeholders alike. You must come from an engineering background, current or former, but hands-on technical depth isn't the primary requirement.

We're also still building out this account's leadership structure, so there's no layer of Engineering Managers under this role yet. You'll lead individual contributors and team leads directly and stay hands-on with delivery yourself, at least for now, with the opportunity to develop engineers on your team into Engineering Managers over time.

Our Mission, Vision, and Values

At Space Inch, we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members.

Working at Space Inch

  • Our remote-first team of around 80+ people is based across the EU (mostly Croatia), the US, and Latin America, with a growing presence in Brazil.
  • Occasional travel for client visits and company retreats.
  • This role is embedded within a single long-standing client partnership, though you'll draw on Space Inch's broader engineering community and practices.
  • We support work/life balance for our team.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in software development, with at least 5+ leading engineering teams, including technical delivery leadership (ideally in an agency, consultancy, or client-embedded environment). Distributed team experience is a plus.
  • Exceptional communicator and mediator who bridges client demands with team reality, builds real trust with engineers, and handles sensitive topics (compensation, retention, disengagement, underperformance) directly and with care. Strong across written, async, live, and cross-cultural communication
  • Proactive problem solver who spots delivery, scope, budget, and process breakdowns early (from PTO coverage gaps to missing test data) and fixes them without waiting for permission
  • Hands-on, demonstrable fluency with AI as a working tool: You've personally driven AI adoption in an engineering team with measurable outcomes (tooling rolled out, productivity gains, initiatives delivered); your credibility comes from execution, not commentary
  • Enough technical fluency across modern architecture, SDLC, and common stacks (e.g., React, Vue, Angular, Node.js, Python, Java, C#) to challenge assumptions, guide decisions, and turn vague client requests into execution plans alongside tech leads. You don't need to write production code
  • Experience coordinating multiple teams or workstreams in parallel, with strong stakeholder management on ambiguous or contentious topics, plus staffing, onboarding, interviewing, and resource planning
  • Strong commercial sensibility: translating technical work, operational fixes, and AI-driven gains into a value story clients understand and continue to invest in
  • A systems thinker: organized enough to hold many threads, decisive enough to act without waiting for permission, self-aware enough to loop in leadership after. Experience with internal developer platforms, MCP-style tooling, or prototype-to-production workflows is a plus

Key Responsibilities

  • People leadership, coaching, and retention: Build trust with engineers through regular 1:1s, candid feedback, and development support. Handle sensitive topics directly (compensation, disengagement, underperformance, burnout, departures) and resolve retention risks before they escalate.
  • Client stakeholder management and partnership: Be the senior point of contact for the client, building trust with senior stakeholders, managing shifting priorities, and turning ambiguous requests (a prototype, an HTML mockup, a new app idea) into practical execution plans.
  • Technical program coordination: Coordinate delivery across frontend, backend, DevOps, platform, and tooling workstreams; clarify ownership, align dependencies, and bridge communication gaps between internal teams and the client. Partner with tech leads on architecture and trade-offs.
  • Resourcing and operational ownership: Oversee hiring, onboarding, and staffing; keep engineers productive through client delays; spot and fix delivery, budget, and process breakdowns before they reach the client.
  • AI-driven team uplift: Lead a step-change in how the team uses AI (tooling, upskilling, workflow design) with standards tied to seniority and autonomy. Focus on measurable productivity and code-review quality, not adoption for its own sake.
  • Decisive action and commercial storytelling: Propose and execute fixes without waiting for permission, keeping the CTO informed of what you're doing and why. Translate delivery metrics, technical decisions, and AI gains into a value narrative for the client.

Typical Challenges You'll Be Solving

  • AI adoption that produces measurable outcomes, focused on actual productivity, code review quality, and autonomy.
  • Turning ambiguous client requests into execution plans across multiple workstreams.
  • Maintaining team morale and stability: keeping engineers motivated, engaged, and retention risk low through shifting client priorities, scope changes, or client access delays.
  • Creating clarity in messy space: stepping into situations where domain ownership is unclear, bridging fragmented cross-team conversations, and making sure everyone understands what needs to be done.
  • Balancing short-term delivery needs with longer-term team and technical health.

Qualities for Success

  • Exceptional communicator: empathetic, honest, and transparent. Engineers trust your guidance, feel supported in 1:1s, and follow your lead when priorities shift.
  • Credible in AI as a working tool, with practical experience to back it up.
  • A systems thinker who designs how work happens, quickly spots broken communication loops or process gaps, and fixes them before they escalate.
  • Comfortable making decisions and owning the outcome, even when the first attempt fails.
  • Adapts communication style across coaching, escalation, and client conversations.
  • Calm under client pressure, and doesn't pass that pressure to the team.

The Role Is Right for You If

  • You lead through trust, presence, and communication as much as technical depth, and you're just as comfortable mediating and coaching as you are talking architecture.
  • You're comfortable staying hands-on with delivery and team leadership while this account's structure is still being built out, rather than expecting a team of managers already in place.
  • You see leading AI adoption as one of the most important things a senior engineering leader can do right now, and you want to help engineers navigate a profession that's changing under their feet.
  • You enjoy turning ambiguity into action: spotting what isn't working, proposing a path, and trying it.
  • You're at home in messy situations between people, delivery, client communication, and operations, and take ownership without being asked.

The Role Is Not Right for You If

  • You want a primarily hands-on coding role.
  • You'd rather lead through technical authority than through relationships, trust, and communication.
  • You're looking for a role where a layer of managers already reports to you: that structure doesn't exist yet on this account.
  • You prefer leading through process and approval rather than presence and initiative.
  • You'd rather wait for direction than propose a way forward.

What's In It for You

  • Shape how AI shows up in this account's delivery: visible, measurable, tied directly to client value.
  • Partner with the CTO on engineering at scale.
  • Work across a range of high-impact initiatives within a long-standing client partnership.
  • Remote-friendly, collaborative, pragmatic culture.
  • Leadership team that values people-first thinking and technical excellence.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Monthly salary: $10,000-$13,000 for a full-time B2B collaboration (with flexibility for an exceptional candidate), based on experience and skills
  • Remote-first setup
  • Health & Wellbeing: PTO + 100% Paid sick leave + Annual health checkup

Role Summary

In support of Cigna Healthcare’s Individual Dental Plans sales, distribution, and partner channel strategies, the Agile Product Owner / Advisor leads business ownership, integration readiness, and delivery execution for multiple external partner solutions. This role serves as a strategic liaison between external enrollment partners, internal business stakeholders, technology teams, operations, and Agile delivery teams to ensure partner integrations are implemented effectively, maintained reliably, and continuously improved to support growth, service continuity, and a strong broker and customer experience.

The position combines Agile product ownership, technical account management, partner relationship management, and operational issue resolution. The Advisor translates business and partner needs into actionable requirements, manages priorities across a high-volume portfolio of partner-facing work, supports implementation and post-launch performance, and drives alignment across product, engineering, operations, compliance, sales, and external partner teams. The role is accountable for enabling scalable, compliant, and reliable integrated partner solutions across distribution channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as business owner and Agile Product Owner / Advisor for multiple integrated partner solutions, including external enrollment platforms, digital broker partners, distribution channels, and related operational integrations.
  • Act as the primary liaison between external partners and internal business, technology, operations, compliance, product, and scrum teams to align partner needs with delivery priorities and business outcomes.
  • Translate business objectives, partner requirements, regulatory considerations, and operational needs into clear features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery priorities.
  • Own and manage the backlog for partner-impacting initiatives, ensuring work is prioritized, refined, sequenced, and ready for Agile delivery teams.
  • Lead partner implementation readiness, including requirements validation, testing coordination, launch planning, go-to-market readiness, and operational handoff.
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, operations, sales, compliance, vendor, and partner teams to manage dependencies, mitigate risks, and maintain execution momentum.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic contact for external partners by supporting integration strategy, issue resolution, escalations, and ongoing performance management.
  • Manage post-launch support for partner solutions by monitoring operational performance, triaging issues, coordinating root-cause analysis, and guiding partner-impacting defects through resolution.
  • Support production stability and service continuity by partnering with technology and operations teams to resolve incidents, communicate impacts, and prevent recurrence.
  • Lead user acceptance testing, release validation, and business sign-off to ensure delivered solutions meet expected business, partner, customer, and broker outcomes.
  • Evaluate partner workflows, system performance, customer experience, broker usability, and operational impacts to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Support training, documentation, playbooks, and internal/external enablement materials to ensure consistent adoption of partner integration processes and capabilities.
  • Contribute to governance standards, intake routines, prioritization practices, and best practices for managing external partner integrations across the distribution ecosystem.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Agile product ownership, technical account management, partner integrations, systems analysis, product delivery, implementation management, or related business technology roles.
  • Experience supporting external partner integrations, enrollment platforms, distribution partners, vendor-supported systems, APIs, data exchanges, or digital sales/service platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, including backlog management, user story creation, acceptance criteria, refinement, sprint planning, release validation, and UAT coordination.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business, operational, regulatory, and partner requirements into actionable technology deliverables.
  • Experience managing escalations, production issues, partner-impacting defects, or operational support workflows from intake through resolution.
  • Ability to coordinate delivery across business, technology, operations, compliance, product, vendor, and external partner stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical and operational topics clearly to both business and technical audiences.
  • Experience using Jira or similar Agile backlog and workflow management tools.
  • Knowledge of health insurance operations, ACA marketplace processes, enrollment workflows, broker distribution, or regulated healthcare environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Individual and Family Plans, ACA marketplace enrollment, direct enrollment, web-based entities, broker platforms, or health insurance distribution channels.
  • Experience working with external digital broker partners, consumer platforms, call center platforms, quoting and enrollment engines, CRM platforms, or partner integration playbooks.
  • Experience supporting API integrations, XML/data mapping, rate or enrollment data workflows, payment-related integrations, or operational data handoffs.
  • Experience managing go-to-market readiness, partner launches, release communications, training, and post-launch stabilization.
  • Experience working in a scaled Agile environment with cross-functional product, engineering, architecture, QA, and operations teams.
  • Familiarity with compliance, regulatory, audit, privacy, and documentation requirements in a healthcare or insurance environment.

Key Skills & Behaviors

  • Partner- and customer-focused mindset with a strong commitment to service continuity, broker usability, and operational excellence.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with external partners and internal stakeholders while navigating competing priorities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to connect operational impacts, technical dependencies, and business outcomes.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, managing high-volume priorities, and driving clarity across complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong ownership and accountability for delivery execution, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to influence without authority and align stakeholders around shared priorities, risks, decisions, and timelines.
  • Agile mindset focused on learning, feedback, value validation, and predictable delivery.
  • Continuous improvement orientation with a focus on scalable processes, data-informed decision making, and repeatable partner integration practices.

You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and engaging beauty and wellness businesses in your region, combining proactive field sales activity with a consultative approach to build strong local relationships and drive commercial success.

L'équipe Science s'agrandit !

Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.

Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.

Ce que tu feras

Tu incarnes l'expertise scientifique d'AssessFirst au contact de nos clients. Tu conçois et livres nos projets d'accompagnement les plus complexes — études ROI, projets 360, analyses prédictives, débriefings collectifs — et tu transmets la lecture scientifique de nos solutions aussi bien aux clients qu'aux équipes internes.

Tu es le trait d'union entre la rigueur scientifique et son application concrète : capable de conduire une analyse de fond et de la restituer avec clarté, aussi bien à un dirigeant qu'à un opérationnel. Tu transformes cette expertise de terrain en valeur pour nos clients, nos équipes et notre produit.

Tes missions

Tu feras partie de l'équipe Science.

Tu travailleras également en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Customer Success (CSM) et Sales (AM/AE).

💼 Expérience confirmée du conseil ou de l'accompagnement client sur des sujets complexes.

🤖 Appétence forte et maîtrise avancée de l'IA appliquée.

Fourchette salariale : 60K-70K fixe

Autonomie & flexibilité : tu t'organises librement selon les priorités et les projets du moment.

Full remote : travaille d'où tu veux en Europe !

jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The Data Engineering team builds and operates the data platform that powers analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, and data-driven products across Nebius. We ingest data from internal and external systems, develop reliable transformation pipelines and data models, and make trusted datasets available to business and product teams.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to own substantial parts of our data platform and deliver complex data products end to end. You will turn ambiguous business needs into pragmatic technical solutions, make architecture and implementation trade-offs, and improve the reliability, scalability, and usability of our data ecosystem.

You will work closely with product, platform, and business teams, helping them use data effectively while ensuring that our systems remain maintainable and trustworthy as Nebius grows.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own the design, delivery, and operation of complex data pipelines, datasets, and platform components.
  • Translate business and analytical requirements into scalable data models, reliable data products, and clear technical plans.
  • Design and evolve data architecture, storage, processing, and orchestration patterns for large-scale workloads.
  • Improve data quality, observability, lineage, and incident response for critical datasets and pipelines.
  • Investigate and resolve challenging performance, reliability, and data-correctness issues in production.
  • Establish reusable tools, conventions, and automation that improve engineering productivity and reduce operational risk.
  • Work with product teams and business stakeholders to define data contracts, priorities, and success criteria.
  • Contribute to technical direction through design reviews, thoughtful trade-offs, and documentation.
  • Support and mentor other engineers through reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation and take ownership of improving the operational health of the systems you support.

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, backend engineering, or a related role; or equivalent experience delivering and operating production data systems.
  • Proven experience independently delivering complex data pipelines or data-platform capabilities from problem definition through production operation.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, including writing maintainable production code and optimizing non-trivial queries.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, including designing maintainable analytical models and data contracts for multiple consumers.
  • Solid knowledge of data architectures and storage systems, including the trade-offs between different processing and storage approaches.
  • Experience designing for reliability: testing, monitoring, data-quality validation, alerting, debugging, and incident resolution.
  • Ability to make technical decisions under ambiguity, explain trade-offs clearly, and collaborate effectively with engineers and non-technical stakeholder

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with real-time or event-driven data platforms and streaming technologies.
  • Experience building or operating cloud-native services with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform.
  • Experience with data governance, access control, privacy, and compliance requirements such as GDPR or SOC 2.
  • Experience with data observability and quality tools or frameworks, such as Great Expectations.
  • Experience improving engineering standards through shared libraries, platform tooling, technical documentation, or mentoring.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Role Summary

We are seeking experienced, detail-oriented Referral & Authorization Coordinators to join our growing Cardiology practice. Unlike a general front desk position, this is a dedicated specialist role that owns the complete lifecycle of office visit referrals and prior authorizations—from initial intake to final scheduling and resolution.

Working independently within Epic EMR, you will verify patient insurance eligibility, navigate HMO/PPO authorization rules, coordinate directly with referring provider networks, and keep patients informed throughout the clearance process.

Requirements

jobs.excerpt: Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back.
jobs.description:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we’ve spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we’re now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We’re at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.

We’re growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you’re energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!

What We’re Looking For

We’re seeking a Director of Field Salesto own in-person event strategy and execution across the MSP industry. You’ll sell at conferences and events, build the system around them, and develop the AE team into strong conference sellers who can eventually run the playbook without you.

The other half of the job is coaching. You set the standard for how AP shows up at a conference — how to work a room, how to run a booth conversation that leads somewhere, how to present on stage, how to turn a badge scan into a qualified meeting. You bring AEs to events, coach them in real time, and debrief afterward. Over time, the team should be able to execute the playbook without you at every event.

Community matters in this role. The MSP world runs on relationships and referrals. You’ll build a personal network within these communities that generates warm introductions, referral pipeline, and the kind of trust that makes people take a meeting because they know you, not because they got a cold email.

NOTE: This is a fully remote position, open to folks currently living in the US or Canada.
This role requires significant travel, including quarterly on-site visits to the Toronto office.

What You’ll Do

  • Own in-person events strategy across the MSP industry: which events we attend, what our commercial plan is at each, and how we measure success.

  • Execute at events personally: booth selling, stage presentations, executive dinners, hallway conversations, and after-hours relationship building.

  • Build the pre-event and post-event system: targeted outreach before each conference, structured follow-up afterward, and pipeline tracking tied to specific events.

  • Develop AEs into conference sellers. Bring them to events, coach them on-site, debrief afterward, and build their confidence at in-person pipeline generation.

  • Experiment with new event formats and tactics: different booth approaches, dinner structures, partnership activations, and regional meetup strategies. Measure results and iterate.

  • Build a personal network within the MSP communities that generates referral pipeline and warm introductions.

  • Collaborate with the Event Manager on logistics and the Director of Revenue Enablement on training materials, but own the commercial playbook and on-site execution.

  • Report on event ROI with real numbers: pipeline generated, meetings booked, deals influenced, cost per opportunity.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5–10 years in B2B SaaS or fintech sales with significant in-person and field selling experience.

  • Familiarity with the MSP ecosystem and IT channel events.

  • You’ve worked conferences, trade shows, and executive events — not just attended them. You know the difference between showing up and executing.

  • You’ve presented on stage to a room of 50–500 people and you’re good at it.

  • A track record of building relationships that turn into pipeline — the kind where people take your call because they met you at an event two years ago.

  • You’ve coached or mentored junior sellers on in-person selling skills, formally or informally.

  • You’re systematic about events: you plan before, execute during, and follow up after. You track what works.

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce for pipeline tracking.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building event ROI measurement frameworks.

  • Track record developing junior sellers into independent conference representatives.

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, dynamic, and high-impact environments.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.

  • The total compensation range for this role is $160,000 – $195,000 CAD (OTE), plus equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, education/training.

  • Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.

  • Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.

  • Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

Why Choose Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.

  • Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.

  • Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.

  • Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.

  • Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.

Want to see what we're actually building?

We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.

Our Values

  • Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we’re headed.

  • Resourcefulness & AI: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn’t obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.

  • Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.

  • Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.

  • Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.

Applying to Alternative Payments

We’re looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you’re excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

  • Use generative AI creative tools to enhance speed and volume of creative output while still applying the judgment needed to keep the work distinctlyFoundant
  • Build andmaintaina library of reusable templates and components that speed up production without sacrificing quality or consistency
  • Direct photography and illustration style and execution, whether shot, sourced, or AI-generated

  • A strategist that is genuinely energized by doing both brand strategy and execution—defining the frameworks and owning the tools to deliver amazing work
  • Experience briefing and managing freelancers or agencies
  • Experience designing for the social good sector preferred
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:

Accounts Payable Coordinator

About Exiro Nickel

Exiro Nickel is a newly established, well funded Canadian mining company formed to acquire and operate the Thompson Nickel Belt in Manitoba, one of the world's most significant nickel sulphide districts. Backed by strong financial partners and an experienced leadership team, Exiro Nickel is focused on revitalizing and growing a long-life, strategically important asset at a time when nickel is critical to the global energy transition.

Our approach is grounded in responsible resource development, operational excellence, and long-term value creation. We are committed to being a trusted partner to our employees, as well as local Indigenous communities, governments, and stakeholders. This includes fostering economic reconciliation by prioritizing the inclusion of Indigenous-owned and Indigenous-led businesses within our supply chain. Our values emphasize safety, integrity, respect, collaboration, and innovation. We believe in empowering our team, supporting local communities, and building a modern mining company that reflects Canadian leadership in critical minerals.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Treasury & Cash Management Lead, the Accounts Payable Coordinator is responsible for providing day-to-day administrative support for Exiro Nickel's accounts payable function. This role ensures the timely and accurate processing of supplier invoices, employee expenses, and payment documentation while delivering exceptional customer service to both internal stakeholders and suppliers.

Working closely with Procurement, Operations, Human Resources, and Finance, you will play an important role in maintaining an efficient procure-to-pay process, supporting vendor relationships, and contributing to the financial integrity of the organization. This position may be based at our Thompson site or performed remotely, depending on operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

  • Process purchase order (PO) and non-purchase order (non-PO) invoices accurately and within established service levels.
  • Monitor the Accounts Payable mailbox and respond to supplier and internal inquiries.
  • Verify invoice documentation and follow up to obtain required approvals.
  • Maintain electronic invoice records and supporting documentation.
  • Respond to supplier inquiries regarding invoices and payment status.
  • Assist with vendor onboarding and maintain vendor documentation.
  • Prepare payment remittances and investigate rejected or returned payments.
  • Administer employee expense reports and corporate credit card reconciliations.
  • Review receipts and expenses for compliance with company policies.
  • Prepare payment batches and support weekly payment processing.
  • Assist with treasury documentation and payment support activities.
  • Support month-end and year-end close activities by preparing reports, accrual support, and audit documentation.
  • Contribute to process improvements that enhance efficiency and service delivery.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you will possess:

  • Diploma or certificate in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • 2–5 years of experience in accounts payable, accounting, or financial administration.
  • Experience working with SAP ECC or Oracle ERP Cloud is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the Microsoft Office suite.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and customer service skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience within mining, industrial, manufacturing, or resource-sector organizations is considered an asset.

What Will Make You Successful

We are looking for someone who demonstrates:

  • A strong commitment to accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service abilities.
  • Effective problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • A collaborative approach to working with colleagues across the organization.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • A proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement.
  • Integrity, accountability, and professionalism in handling confidential financial information.

Working Environment

  • Position may be based at our Thompson, Manitoba site or performed remotely, depending on operational requirements.
  • Primarily office-based work with regular use of financial systems and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Frequent interaction with Procurement, Operations, Human Resources, Finance, suppliers, and employees.
  • Increased activity during weekly payment cycles, month-end, year-end, and audit periods.
  • Opportunity to contribute to the development and continuous improvement of financial processes within a growing mining organization.

Why Join Exiro Nickel?

At Exiro Nickel, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to a growing organization where your work makes a meaningful impact. We offer a collaborative work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the ability to help shape the future of our operations and business.

Application Information

The Talent Acquisition Partner is also responsible for developing new, creative recruiting ideas employing traditional and non-traditional sourcing strategies, and utilizing approved venues to identify and recruit appropriate candidates to fill positions at all levels. The Talent Acquisition Partner plays a critical role in ensuring the Company hires the best possible talent for all positions.

  • Coordinates full-cycle recruiting for open positions, including assisting managers with the identification of viable candidates, interviewing, and selection.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies

jobs.description:
Objectif du poste

Sécuriser l'adoption de l'application de fidélité via la gestion d’un un portefeuille de clients B2B (Retailers en matériaux de construction). L’objectif est de maximiser le ROI des programmes des membres (Mobile Application) et garantir le renouvellement de leurs inscriptions.

Missions principales

  • Onboarding des clients : Accompagner les nouveaux clients dans la configuration technique et stratégique de leur programme de fidélité.
  • Suivi de l'adoption : Analyser les données d'utilisation de l'application par les clients et les consommateurs finaux.
  • Conseil stratégique : Proposer des campagnes d'animation (promotions, défis, récompenses) pour booster l'engagement des consommateurs.
  • Rétention et renouvellement : Suivre la santé des comptes clients (Health Score) pour identifier les risques de désabonnement (churn).
  • Expansion de compte : Identifier les opportunités de vente additionnelle (upsell / cross-sell) de fonctionnalités premium.
  • Voix du client (VoC) : Remonter les retours d'expérience clients aux équipes produit pour améliorer l'application.
  • Expérience : 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en Customer Success, idéalement dans le secteur SaaS, l'E-commerce ou le Retail Tech.
  • Compétences techniques : Maîtrise des outils CSM (Gainsight, ChurnZero), des CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot) et des outils d'analyse de données (Tableau, Looker).
  • Expertise sectorielle : Solide culture marketing liée aux mécanismes de fidélisation, à la data client (CDP/CRM) et aux parcours d'achat.
  • Soft Skills : Excellente communication, orientation résultats, forte capacité d'écoute et sens de la négociation.
  • Langues : Maîtrise courante de l'anglais et du français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Nous offrons des salaires compétitifs, alignés sur les références du marché local et sur la portée et les responsabilités spécifiques de chaque poste. La rémunération est déterminée en fonction des compétences requises pour le poste, du niveau d'études et/ou de formation. Nous nous engageons à appliquer des pratiques salariales justes et équitables, conformément aux lois et réglementations en vigueur.

Industriel fabricant matériaux pour la construction, Sika est leader dans le développement et la production de systèmes et de produits pour le collage, l’étanchéité, le scellement, le renforcement et la protection dans les secteurs de la construction et de l’industrie. Sika possède des filiales dans 103 pays à travers le monde et fabrique dans plus de 400 usines. Sika emploie 33 000 personnes et a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 11,20 milliards de francs suisses au cours de l'exercice 2025.

Du möchtest nicht nur Tickets bearbeiten, sondern technische Herausforderungen ganzheitlich analysieren und nachhaltige Lösungen entwickeln?

Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Als IT Support Specialist (2nd Level) übernimmst Du Verantwortung für komplexe Fragestellungen rund um unsere Softwarelösungen. Du analysierst Ursachen, koordinierst Lösungswege gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und trägst aktiv dazu bei, unsere Produkte und Services kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Mit Deinem technischen Know-how, Deiner Lösungsorientierung und Deinem Blick für nachhaltige Verbesserungen sorgst Du dafür, dass sich unsere Kund:innen jederzeit auf unsere Lösungen verlassen können.

Was du bewirkst

  • Du analysierst und bearbeitest komplexe sowie eskalierte Supportanfragen eigenständig und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen für unsere Kund:innen.

  • Du übernimmst technische Fragestellungen aus dem 1st Level Support, priorisierst diese zielgerichtet und stellst eine effiziente Bearbeitung sicher.

  • Du analysierst technische Herausforderungen in Windows-, Client-Server-, Netzwerk- und Datenbankumgebungen und leitest passende Maßnahmen ab.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Produktmanagement und weiteren Fachbereichen zusammen, um Fehlerursachen nachhaltig zu beheben und unsere Software kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

  • Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder, führst Ursachenanalysen durch und unterstützt die Optimierung von Supportprozessen.

  • Du dokumentierst Lösungen und Best Practices, um Wissen nachhaltig im Team verfügbar zu machen.

  • Du bringst Ideen zur Verbesserung von Servicequalität, Prozessen und eingesetzten Tools aktiv ein.

Was du mitbringst

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Lösungsorientierung: Du gehst Ursachen strukturiert auf den Grund und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungsansätze.

  • Analytisches Denken: Du erkennst Zusammenhänge schnell und leitest fundierte Maßnahmen ab.

  • Teamorientierung: Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend zusammen und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Themen und treibst Lösungen voran.

  • Qualitätsbewusstsein: Du hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe und bringst Verbesserungen gezielt ein.

Unsere Benefits für dich

MEDIFOX DAN

Die MEDIFOX DAN Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Hildesheim gehört zur ResMed Corp. und beschäftigt über 900 Mitarbeitende an neun Standorten. Wir setzen auf Teamgeist, Kundenorientierung und Leidenschaft und arbeiten an zukunftsweisenden Softwarelösungen im Gesundheits- und Sozialwesen, um Innovationen voranzutreiben. About us

At RavenPack, we are at the forefront of developing the next generation of generative AI tools for the finance industry and beyond. With 23 years of experience as a leading big data analytics provider for financial services, we empower our clients—including some of the world's most successful hedge funds, banks, and asset managers—to enhance returns, reduce risk, and increase efficiency by integrating public information into their models and workflows. Building on this expertise, we are launching a new suite of GenAI and SaaS services, designed specifically for financial professionals.

Join a Company that is Powering the Future of Finance with AI

RavenPack has been recognized as the Best Alternative Data Provider by WatersTechnology and has been included in this year’s Top 100 Next Unicorns by Viva Technology. RavenPack has launched Bigdata, our Gen-AI platform tailored for finance, which is already being recognized as the #1 platform for powering financial AI agents.

European legal working status is required.

Project Scope & Core Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced Machine Learning / NLP Engineer to lead a high-impact, transformational infrastructure project. You will be responsible for designing, evaluating, and deploying advanced machine learning models to complement and enhance our large-scale, high-precision detection pipeline.

In this role, you will work closely with our core engineering, data, and technical leadership teams to ensure the seamless integration of new ML technologies with our existing systems.

The core objective of your role is to introduce modern, state-of-the-art ML approaches that run alongside our existing infrastructure to create a powerful, hybrid architecture. This is a unique opportunity to tackle complex challenges in low-latency inference, massive-scale entity resolution, and continuous learning systems.

Note: Due to the highly proprietary nature of our systems, the specific deliverables, architecture, and exact technologies will be discussed in detail under an NDA during your first interview.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Enhancement & Innovation: Design, train, and deploy state-of-the-art Natural Language Processing (NLP) models to complement and scale our existing high-throughput data architecture.

  • Architecture Integration: Build robust integration layers that allow new machine learning predictions to work seamlessly alongside our established production systems.

  • Continuous Improvement Pipelines: Develop automated feedback loops and learning mechanisms that enable our systems to adapt, update, and improve over time with minimal manual intervention.

  • Production Deployment & Optimization: Transition models from research/evaluation into full production, optimizing complex models for strict low-latency inference and high reliability.

  • Quality & Evaluation Frameworks: Establish rigorous evaluation benchmarks, automated testing harnesses, and monitoring dashboards to guarantee the accuracy and stability of ML implementations.

Revised Required Skills & Experience

  • Advanced NLP & Deep Learning: Deep theoretical and practical understanding of core NLP tasks, such as entity extraction, text classification, and contextual understanding.

  • Transformer Architectures: Proven experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying modern transformer-based models and encoding methods for complex text tasks.

  • MLOps & Production Engineering: Strong track record of optimizing models for low-latency environments (e.g., batch inference, model distillation, hardware acceleration) and deploying them at scale.

  • Evaluation & Metrics: Expertise in designing ML evaluation frameworks, building gold-standard baseline datasets, and tracking performance metrics to identify and resolve edge cases.

  • Complex System Integration: Experience combining probabilistic machine learning models with deterministic or legacy software architectures, including confidence scoring and A/B testing rollouts.

  • Software Engineering Best Practices: Strong coding skills with a focus on writing clean, scalable code, creating technical documentation, and maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines for ML models.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Що ти будеш робити

Яка кваліфікація та досвід необхідні

    • REST API / Microsoft Graph API – інтеграція з корпоративними системами, Custom Connectors

Плюсом стане

Soft Skills

jobs.description:
Client Success Manager – Cold Email & Deliverability

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible, with availability during U.S. business hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Client Success Manager to own client relationships, cold email campaign performance, deliverability, and retention.

This is a hands-on role combining client success, account management, cold email, lead generation, and campaign optimization. You’ll manage approximately 20–30 active client accounts and work closely with founders, developers, and outreach teams.

This is not a support-only role. You’ll be expected to understand campaign performance, troubleshoot problems, optimize cold email campaigns, and proactively prevent client churn.

What You’ll Own

Client Success & Account Management

  • Manage a portfolio of 20–30 active clients
  • Serve as the primary point of contact from onboarding onward
  • Lead client check-ins, performance calls, and campaign updates
  • Monitor account health and proactively identify churn risks
  • Manage client expectations and communicate next steps clearly
  • Build strong relationships with founders and executive stakeholders
  • Own client satisfaction, retention, and issue resolution

Cold Email Campaign Management

  • Monitor and optimize outbound cold email campaigns
  • Diagnose underperforming campaigns and identify root causes
  • Review targeting, prospect lists, messaging, sequencing, and campaign setup
  • Write and optimize cold email copy, subject lines, and CTAs
  • Quality-check campaigns before launch
  • Improve reply rates, positive response rates, and qualified lead generation
  • Step into campaign execution when additional support is needed

Email Deliverability

  • Monitor inbox placement, sender reputation, bounce rates, and campaign health
  • Troubleshoot deliverability and inbox placement issues
  • Understand domain warm-up and outbound email infrastructure
  • Identify problems affecting sender reputation or campaign performance
  • Collaborate with technical teams on infrastructure issues
  • Support scalable deliverability practices across multiple client accounts

Retention & Performance

  • Identify at-risk accounts before issues escalate
  • Build action plans for underperforming campaigns
  • Connect campaign metrics to measurable client outcomes
  • Maintain proactive communication during performance challenges
  • Track client health, campaign results, and retention risks
  • Help reduce churn and strengthen long-term client relationships

Processes & Operations

  • Build and improve client success playbooks and SOPs
  • Maintain organized tracking for client health, SLAs, campaign performance, and outstanding issues
  • Document campaign workflows and operating procedures
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend improvements
  • Use AI and automation tools to improve reporting and execution

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with developers on technical and email infrastructure issues
  • Coordinate with outreach teams on targeting, messaging, and campaign execution
  • Report client risks, campaign performance, and operational issues to leadership
  • Ensure client delivery remains organized and consistent as the business scales

Requirements
