jobs.title: Manager, Competitive Programs
jobs.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Competitive Programs team, which is part of the Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategic Programs team, is a new team dedicated to establishing and scaling Stripe’s Competitive Programs capability. Stripe operates in a dynamic and evolving competitive landscape. This role will help Stripe understand market developments and translate competitive insights into actionable guidance for teams and users.

The Competitive Programs team works alongside Market Intelligence to help Stripe identify meaningful threats and opportunities early, mobilize coordinated action across the company in priority situations, and turn market and deal signals into better Product, Marketing, and GTM decisions. We build the competitive operating system—program design, cross-functional coordination, deal-routing mechanisms, visibility, and accountability—while Product, Sales, PMM, Pricing, and other functions retain ownership for decisions and delivery in their domains.

This is a full-stack program manager role - the manager will be responsible for both building the team and running competitive programs. We are looking for a versatile leader who is excited to build something from the ground up and can apply the same skills to other high-priority GTM initiatives as the team’s mandate and Stripe’s needs evolve.

What you’ll do

You will lead and develop a team of program managers responsible for helping Stripe compete more effectively in its highest-priority competitive situations. You will turn an emerging capability into a durable operating model: establish the team’s goals and work plans, partner with Stripe leadership to determine where to deploy scarce program capacity, and ensure named competitor programs are well run, measurable, and connected to the functional teams that own decisions and delivery.

This is a high-ambiguity management role. You will work with senior leaders across Sales, Product, Product Operations, Marketing, Market Intelligence, Pricing, Finance & Strategy, and GTM Operations to turn unclear competitive problems into focused programs with clear objectives, owners, decision forums, operating cadences, and measures of success.

Initially, you will:

  • Lead and develop the Competitive Programs team, setting clear objectives, assigning work, coaching program managers, and maintaining a high bar for judgment, execution, and stakeholder management.
  • Establish the portfolio and operating model for centrally staffed P0 and P1 competitor programs, in partnership with Market Intelligence and GTM Strategic Programs leadership.
  • Manage the highest-complexity competitive programs directly, particularly where Stripe must coordinate across Product, GTM, Commercial, and executive stakeholders.
  • Build the repeatable playbooks and mechanisms that allow Stripe to respond to competitive threats quickly and learn at scale, without centralizing functional decisions that belong elsewhere.

You will be successful in this role if you are excited to build a new function from the ground up and tenacious at motivating XFN partners across the company to build a repeatable structure and deliver against Stripe’s top competitive priorities. You will be a trusted partner to executive leaders across Sales, Product, Product Operations, Marketing, Market Intelligence, Pricing, Finance & Strategy, and GTM Operations. You will help influence decision making around Product roadmap, commercial-policy, or account-strategy decisions and ensure the right functional owners are engaged, accountable, and able to make decisions at the pace required. You will need (1) superior communication skills to work across senior stakeholders from different functions and (2) are someone who thrives when solving complex problems with limited oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Set the team’s SOKRs, portfolio priorities in partnership with Stripe leadership, work plans, and success measures; allocate program-management capacity across the highest-priority competitive needs.
  • Develop, coach, and retain a high-performing team of program managers capable of operating independently in ambiguous, high-stakes environments.
  • Directly lead the design, launch, and lifecycle management of centrally staffed P0 and P1 competitor programs, including recommendations to continue, adjust, graduate, or re-elevate programs as the market changes.
  • Coach program managers as they also design, launch, and lifecycle management of centrally staffed P0 and P1 competitor programs, including recommendations to continue, adjust, graduate, or re-elevate programs as the market changes.
  • Build and continuously improve the program-management layer of Stripe’s competitive operating system, including playbooks, program standards, decision logs, operating reviews, escalation mechanisms, and executive reporting.
  • Partner closely with Market Intelligence to translate competitive, customer, and deal signals into prioritized program actions; partner with Product, PMM, Sales, Pricing, and Product S&O to ensure those actions have accountable functional owners.
  • Create clear, decision-oriented updates for senior leadership on program health, competitive risks, outcomes, capacity needs, and recommendations.
  • Lead the identification and operationalization of the “competing fiercely” cultural change, surfacing systemic friction, and ensuring the right functional teams own durable solutions.
  • Apply the team’s program-design and execution capabilities to other strategic GTM priorities as business needs evolve.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

You are a strategic, hands-on people leader who is energized by ambiguous, cross-functional business problems. You can set direction without waiting for perfect information, while maintaining enough operational rigor to ensure your team delivers durable results.

You know how to move between executive-level strategy and program detail: helping senior leaders make trade-offs, owning your own P0/P1 competitor programs all while ensuring teams have clear owners, milestones, decisions, and measures of success. You build trust across functions, but you are also comfortable naming risk, resolving ambiguity, and holding stakeholders accountable to commitments.

You are excited by the intersection of market dynamics, competitors, product strategy, commercial strategy, GTM execution, and organizational change. You recognize that a central Competitive Programs team should not replace functional ownership; its value is making the company faster, more coordinated, and more effective in priority situations.

Minimum requirements

  • 9+ years of experience in program management, business operations, GTM strategy, management consulting, or a related discipline, including experience in a Sales, Marketing, Product, GTM Operations, or other commercial organization.
  • 2+ years of people-management experience, including setting team objectives, assigning work, coaching and developing experienced individual contributors, and managing performance.
  • Comfort with being a player-coach. Works well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex and ambiguous cross-functional programs from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and durable operational handoff.
  • Experience managing global programs across regions, segments, and product lines, including experience establishing program goals, work plans, operating cadences, decision forums, and success measures for complex initiatives with multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment in prioritizing competing demands and allocating limited team capacity against the highest-value work.
  • Experience navigating senior stakeholders with differing incentives, priorities, and decision rights; ability to drive alignment while making trade-offs and escalation paths explicit.
  • Proven ability to structure ambiguous qualitative and quantitative inputs into clear recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including decision-oriented reporting, facilitation of senior working sessions and ability to communicate risks or trade-offs directly.

jobs.title: PROJECT MGR/BUSINESS ANALYST/SCRUM MGR
jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Project Manager / Business Analyst / Scrum Master is a cross-functional OBIWAN delivery role that bridges program management, business requirements, Agile execution, Oracle business-intelligence reporting, user support, and quality assurance.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Project Manager / Business Analyst / Scrum Master is a cross-functional OBIWAN delivery role that bridges program management, business requirements, Agile execution, Oracle business-intelligence reporting, user support, and quality assurance. The position supports the designated OBIWAN Program Manager by maintaining assigned plans and schedules, preparing customer-facing Program Management Review materials, facilitating Agile/Scrum activities, eliciting and documenting requirements, coordinating solution design with FAA business owners and the technical team, supporting Oracle Analytics/OBIEE reporting, monitoring production data, triaging ServiceNow tickets, and planning and executing functional, performance, and load testing.

OBIWAN is an FAA financial management and reporting platform overseen by the Capital Systems Branch (ABP-330) within the Office of Capital Budgets (ABP-300). It uses Oracle Analytics and related technologies to integrate and report data from FAA source systems including Delphi and PRISM. This position must translate business needs into controlled, testable technical requirements while helping the OBIWAN team sustain reliable daily operations and responsive user services.

This role may lead assigned workstreams, requirements, ceremonies, demonstrations, and deliverable development; however, it does not replace the contract-designated OBIWAN Program Manager unless ProSol formally assigns that authority.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain and update assigned portions of the OBIWAN Project Management Plan (PMP), integrated schedule, deliverable tracker, milestones, dependencies, and timelines; ensure changes are traceable to contract requirements and coordinated with the Program Manager.
  • Prepare customer-ready Program Management Review (PMR) presentations, status summaries, demonstrations, action-item updates, risks, decisions, and supporting materials for FAA leadership and program stakeholders.
  • Analyze the Statement of Work (SOW), task requirements, deliverables, and approved changes; translate contract requirements into actionable work items, requirements, acceptance criteria, schedules, and team assignments.
  • Facilitate Agile/Scrum execution within the OBIWAN team, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily coordination, demonstrations/reviews, retrospectives, impediment tracking, and alignment with SAFe or FAA-approved Agile practices.
  • Elicit and analyze requirements from FAA business owners, users, and internal organizations through interviews, workshops, brainstorming sessions, working sessions, and document reviews.
  • Develop and maintain Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs), functional specifications, use cases, process flows, conceptual models, data models, acceptance criteria, requirements traceability, and related analysis artifacts.
  • Coordinate with FAA business owners, OBIWAN developers, database/data-integration personnel, infrastructure staff, security stakeholders, and other authorized organizations to define practical solutions that satisfy functional and technical needs.
  • Evaluate proposed customizations and enhancements for feasibility, dependencies, functional fit, technical limitations, data impacts, performance implications, user impacts, and operational risk; identify potential issues before development or release.
  • Create wireframes and mockup screens using Balsamiq or comparable tools; present proposed user experiences and workflows to FAA stakeholders and the development team to validate requirements before implementation.
  • Guide the technical team on approved customizations and enhancements by clarifying business rules, screen behavior, report logic, data needs, workflows, and acceptance criteria throughout development and testing.
  • Document functional design for OBIWAN portals, reports, dashboards, and business processes; maintain clear, current documentation that supports configuration management, testing, user support, knowledge transfer, and future maintenance.
  • Perform business and data analysis using OBIWAN data and FAA source-system information; identify data-quality issues, inconsistencies, trends, reconciliation concerns, and reporting impacts.
  • Create, modify, validate, and demonstrate dashboards and reports using Oracle Analytics Server (OAS)/OBIEE, including reporting based on Delphi and PRISM data and approved business requirements.
  • Monitor production data, report execution, and operational results; promptly communicate errors, anomalies, or failed processing to the development/technical team and Program Manager, and support investigation through resolution.
  • Support the contract's time-sensitive data-integration and reconciliation mission by monitoring issues that may threaten required daily processing and reconciliation deadlines and helping coordinate corrective action.
  • Plan, document, and execute functional testing, regression testing, performance testing, and load testing for reports, dashboards, portal changes, and other OBIWAN enhancements; write test cases, expected results, defects, and test evidence.
  • Support user acceptance testing and demonstrations; confirm that implemented solutions satisfy approved requirements and document gaps, defects, limitations, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Triage, analyze, update, and respond to ServiceNow tickets; provide Tier 1/Tier 2 business-application support within role expertise, coordinate escalation to technical specialists when needed, and maintain accurate ticket documentation.
  • Facilitate Lunch and Learn sessions, user working sessions, demonstrations, and other knowledge-sharing activities to improve adoption, resolve recurring issues, capture feedback, and reduce avoidable support demand.
  • Maintain or contribute to knowledge-base content, user guidance, standard operating procedures, release notes, FAQs, and support documentation for software, reports, dashboards, business processes, and recurring issues.
  • Participate in root-cause analysis, corrective-action planning, risk/issue tracking, lessons learned, transition/knowledge-transfer activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide accurate inputs for Monthly Status Reports, Monthly O&M Reports, PMR materials, test plans, root-cause analyses, transition documents, and ad hoc FAA requests related to assigned work.
  • Protect sensitive FAA financial, procurement, system, and user information; follow FAA security, privacy, access-control, configuration-management, records-management, and acceptable-use requirements.
  • Perform other closely related duties required to sustain OBIWAN program performance and continuity within the authorized scope of the contract.

Required Technical and Professional Competencies

  • Strong business-analysis skills, including requirements elicitation, process analysis, requirements decomposition, functional specification development, use cases, acceptance criteria, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
  • Demonstrated Agile/Scrum facilitation experience, including backlog management, sprint ceremonies, impediment removal, stakeholder demonstrations, and coordination across business and technical teams.
  • Working knowledge of SAFe Agile practices and the ability to adapt Agile methods to a federal production-support and maintenance environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Analytics / OBIEE reporting, dashboards, report logic, prompts, filters, data validation, and business-intelligence user support.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data concepts, data analysis, conceptual/data modeling, source-to-report relationships, reconciliation, data quality, and testing.
  • Experience preparing BRDs, FRDs, functional designs, process flows, wireframes/mockups, test plans, test cases, defect reports, user guidance, and executive-ready presentations.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or comparable IT service-management tools for ticket triage, response, documentation, escalation, and closure.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with executives, business owners, end users, developers, database engineers, system administrators, security teams, and program-management personnel.
  • Strong facilitation, presentation, writing, organization, prioritization, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent requirements, tickets, testing activities, and deliverables while maintaining traceability, quality, and schedule discipline.

Minimum Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, business, data analytics, engineering, project management, or a related field. Directly relevant professional experience may substitute for a portion of the education requirement in accordance with ProSol policy.
  • At least five years of progressively responsible experience in business analysis, project delivery, Scrum/Agile coordination, enterprise application support, business intelligence, or a closely related discipline.
  • At least three years of experience eliciting and documenting requirements and coordinating solution delivery between business stakeholders and software-development teams.
  • Demonstrated experience with enterprise reporting, analytics, data-driven applications, or financial/procurement systems; Oracle Analytics / OBIEE experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing functional test cases and participating in performance, load, regression, and user-acceptance testing.
  • Experience supporting production applications and end users in a structured ticketing or service-management environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior FAA, Department of Transportation, federal financial-management, acquisition, procurement, accounting, or budget systems experience.
  • Experience with Delphi (Oracle Federal Financials), PRISM, Oracle Analytics Server, OBIEE, JIRA, Git, Jenkins, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Balsamiq, or comparable tools.
  • Experience working on a 5-7 person Agile/Scrum team supporting a production enterprise application.
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), SAFe Agilist, PMI-PBA, CBAP, PMP, or comparable credential.
  • Working knowledge of DevOps/DevSecOps, configuration management, release management, accessibility, cybersecurity, and federal system documentation requirements.

Contract and Operating Environment

  • OBIWAN is an FAA financial management and reporting platform overseen by ABP-330 and supported through Program Management, Operations and Maintenance, Data Integration/Reconciliation, Security/Compliance, Reporting, and User Services Support activities.
  • OBIWAN integrates data from FAA source systems including Delphi and PRISM. The contract requires time-sensitive data integration and reconciliation, proactive system monitoring, structured testing, documentation, and responsive user support.
  • FAA has confirmed that the software-development lifecycle uses Agile methods and that the environment typically operates with one 5-7 person Scrum team.
  • ServiceNow is the OBIWAN help-desk/ticketing platform. Contract escalation expectations are Tier 1 within three business days, Tier 2 within five business days, and Tier 3 within ten business days if unresolved.
  • A Public Trust suitability determination is required. Work is primarily remote / at the Contractor facility; limited pre-approved travel may be required if technical issues require support at the FAA Enterprise Data Center.

Performance Expectations

  • Requirements are complete, testable, traceable, approved by the appropriate stakeholders, and sufficiently detailed for development and acceptance.
  • PMR materials, assigned PMP/schedule updates, status information, and other program artifacts are accurate, customer-ready, and delivered on time.
  • Agile ceremonies are disciplined and useful; impediments, dependencies, risks, decisions, and action items are visible and actively managed.
  • OBIEE/OAS dashboards and reports accurately reflect approved business rules and source data, with defects identified through structured testing before release when practicable.
  • Production data issues and user tickets are triaged promptly, documented clearly, and escalated early enough to protect OBIWAN operational deadlines and service expectations.
  • Testing evidence, functional documentation, user guidance, and knowledge-transfer materials remain current, reproducible, and audit-ready.
  • Communications with FAA stakeholders are clear, professional, accurate, and within authorized contract scope.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position is not expected to have formal direct reports unless separately assigned by ProSol. It provides functional leadership to the Scrum team and assigned workstreams, facilitates collaboration, clarifies requirements and priorities, and coordinates activities across business and technical personnel. Personnel management, contractual authority, and overall task-order accountability remain with the designated OBIWAN Program Manager unless otherwise assigned in writing.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

Work is primarily performed in a remote office or Contractor facility using Government-furnished and company-provided technology. The role requires extended computer use, frequent virtual meetings, preparation and review of detailed documents and data, and sustained attention to time-sensitive operational and customer-support activities. The employee must be able to participate in scheduled FAA meetings and, when assigned, support early-morning operational windows associated with OBIWAN data processing. Occasional travel may be required. Reasonable accommodations may be provided in accordance with applicable law and ProSol policy.

Position Description Basis and Notes

This position description is based on the awarded OBIWAN Statement of Work, ProSol's final technical and price proposals, the FAA Questions and Answers, and the incumbent employee's task inventory provided to ProSol. The contract explicitly supports program management, Agile software development, data integration/reconciliation, reporting, testing, and user services. The employee task inventory further identifies Balsamiq mockups, SAFe practices, Lunch and Learn facilitation, BRD/FRD development, and hands-on OBIEE dashboard/report work; these items are retained as role-specific operational responsibilities because they support the awarded scope.

Recommended labor-category mapping is VETS2 Labor ID 173, Senior Computer Programmer, because the awarded price model includes one Senior Computer and Information Systems Manager for the designated Program Manager and four Senior Computer Programmer FTEs for the remaining technical scope. ProSol Contracts/Finance should confirm the billing category for the selected employee before assignment.

Position Description Disclaimer

This description summarizes the position's primary duties and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of every task that may be assigned. Duties may be adjusted to meet related business or contract needs within the employee's qualifications and the authorized OBIWAN scope. This document does not create an employment contract. Final labor-category mapping, FLSA classification, compensation, and suitability determinations must be confirmed by the appropriate ProSol functions for the selected employee.

Additional information

ProSol is an equal opportunity employer, all interested qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, EEO/D/M/V/F. ProSol welcomes and encourages diversity in the workforce. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
About Infiterra

Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.

Infiterra enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.

Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

OVERVIEW

We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team and take end-to-end ownership of a key product domain.

You will own the “what and why” for your domain: framing the customer and operator problems, shaping priorities against business outcomes, and ensuring that what reaches engineering is well-defined, validated, and ready to deliver. You will work side-by-side with Business Analysts, Engineering, Architecture, Customer Success, and Sales — and report into the Product organisation.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Infiterra’s platform is technically complex and business-critical for its customers. As a Product Owner, you ensure that what we build is the right thing — not just well-shipped, but well-chosen. Your decisions about what to prioritize, how to frame the problem, and where to cut the MVP directly shape product quality, delivery speed, and the outcomes our partners can deliver to their own customers.

WHO ARE YOU?

You're a problem-first thinker who instinctively redirects "let's build X" to "what problem are we solving and for whom?" — and you've killed features to prove it.

You operate at the intersection of business and engineering. You don't need to write code, but you can hold your own on APIs, data flows, and platform constraints — and you know when to defer to the people who do.

You write clearly, decide independently, and don't wait for a manager to define what good looks like. When sales over-commits and engineering under-scopes, you hold the line on both — with data and reasoning, not seniority.

You've worked in complex, messy domains before, and you didn't wait for perfect requirements to move. You earn trust across functions without formal authority, because people follow your prioritisation calls on the strength of your thinking.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the problem framing, prioritization, and outcomes for one product domain — measured by adoption, retention, margin, and time-to-onboard.

  • Ensure nothing enters a sprint without a validated problem statement, a defined success criterion, and acceptance criteria and shape an MVP that ships

  • Work with Architecture and Engineering to confirm that new capabilities respect platform constraints, multi-tenancy boundaries, and integration dependencies; so technical debt isn't the price of speed.

  • Translate leadership decisions and quarterly priorities into a ranked, sized, sequenced backlog your team can execute without ambiguity.

  • Hold the Definition of Ready — decide what enters a sprint, in what sequence, and at what MVP cut line

  • Maintain a continuous customer feedback loop, converting recurring signals into prioritized backlog

  • Convert ambiguous requirements into testable user stories and acceptance criteria before they reach engineering, eliminating rework from unclear scope.

  • Act as the single point of translation between stakeholders and the team, preventing conflicting direction from reaching engineering

REQUIREMENTS

  • 4+ years as a Product Owner, Senior Business Analyst, or Associate Product Manager in B2B SaaS or software product environments

  • Track record of taking features end-to-end: from problem statement to sprint-ready epic, including user stories and acceptance criteria

  • Strong product judgement — you instinctively redirect a “let’s build X” conversation to “what problem are we solving and for whom?”

  • Comfortable working closely with engineering teams in agile, sprint-based frameworks, and able to discuss APIs, integrations, and data flows at a meaningful level

  • Excellent written and spoken English; able to produce clear epics, decisions, and stakeholder updates without supervision

  • Confident challenging both business and technical stakeholders when needed, and able to defend a position with data and reasoning

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience working within B2B SaaS, platform, or indirect-channel businesses — particularly where the product involves complex billing models, multi-tenant architecture, or partner/reseller ecosystems — is a strong advantage.

  • Comfort using AI tooling for discovery, competitor research, and requirements work as part of daily work

Benefits

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme (travel and work)

  • Flexible working hours

  • Health and life insurance program

  • Learning & development budget

  • A passionate, international, and supportive team

We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: VFX Artist - GameSim - Talent Pipeline
jobs.excerpt: [English, French to follow]GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles.
jobs.description:
[English, French to follow]

GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles. We care about craftsmanship, collaboration, and shipping work we’re proud to put our names on. If you love building environments and believable spaces we’d like to meet you. Our headquarters is based in Orlando, FL!

Talent Pipeline Posting Notice
Please note that this posting is not tied to an immediate vacancy. We are proactively building a pipeline of qualified candidates in anticipation of potential hiring needs over the coming months. Applications will be reviewed and retained for future consideration as opportunities arise.

We are looking for a VFX Artist with strong real-time effects skills, solid technical judgment, and the potential to grow into broader lead responsibilities over time.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating high-quality visual effects while also helping teams stay aligned, organized, and efficient. Depending on the project, this person may contribute directly to hands-on VFX production, in-engine implementation, feedback, task breakdowns, optimization, workflow documentation, and cross-discipline collaboration.

Because our projects can vary widely in style, scope, platform, and client needs, we are looking for an adaptable VFX artist with strong fundamentals, a practical production mindset, and the ability to translate creative or design direction into clear, executable effects work.

This is a hands-on production role with opportunities to support small pods or strike teams, guide VFX quality, mentor other artists, and grow toward lead-level responsibilities.

This role offers flexible work options, including remote, hybrid or in-office arrangements.

Responsibilities

  • Create custom real-time visual effects and implement them in-engine using Unreal Engine 5, Unity, or proprietary tools.
  • Build high-quality effects for gameplay, environments, cinematics, atmosphere, combat, interaction, destruction, UI/game feedback, and other project needs.
  • Create all necessary textures, flipbooks, materials, meshes, simulations, and supporting assets for real-time VFX.
  • Maintain clean, readable, well-structured material graphs, Niagara systems, parameters, naming conventions, and reusable effect setups.
  • Use tools such as Photoshop, Substance Designer, Blender, Houdini, Maya, EmberGen, or other software as needed to support effect creation.
  • Work with complex material setups, Blueprints, scripting hooks, animation events, gameplay triggers, or engine-specific implementation needs.
  • Troubleshoot VFX issues in partnership with Technical Art, Engineering, Design, Animation, Audio, and other disciplines.
  • Own VFX optimization fundamentals, including particle counts, overdraw, shader cost, texture memory, spawn rates, scalability settings, and platform performance constraints.
  • Help ensure effects are readable, performant, and aligned with gameplay needs, art direction, timing, mood, and player feedback.
  • Review work from internal artists, partner studios, or external vendors and provide clear, constructive, actionable feedback.
  • Help maintain a consistent quality bar across a set of effects, a feature, a level, or a small team pod.
  • Support short-term planning by helping break down VFX requests into clear tasks, priorities, dependencies, risks, and definitions of done.
  • Proactively identify production risks, including missing gameplay hooks, performance spikes, unclear direction, pipeline gaps, dependency issues, or inconsistent style execution.
  • Collaborate closely with Designers, Concept Artists, Art Directors, Technical Artists, Engineers, Animators, Audio Designers, and Producers.
  • Support client-facing communication when needed by clarifying requirements, sharing WIP, explaining constraints, and aligning on expected outcomes.
  • Contribute to VFX workflow improvements, reusable templates, documentation, libraries, naming standards, or scalability rules when appropriate.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional game industry experience as a real-time VFX Artist or similar role.
  • At least one shipped game title.
  • Proven end-to-end real-time VFX workflow experience, from concept and asset creation through in-engine implementation and polish.
  • Strong experience implementing effects in Unreal Engine 4 or 5, with strong working knowledge of Niagara.
  • Strong particle animation fundamentals, including timing, rhythm, shape language, motion, impact, anticipation, dissipation, and readability.
  • Strong understanding of natural energies and materials such as fire, smoke, water, electricity, magic, dust, debris, explosions, atmospherics, and environmental effects.
  • Strong material and texture creation skills using tools such as Photoshop, Substance Designer, or similar software.
  • Ability to create clean, readable, and well-constructed material graphs and VFX systems.
  • Demonstrated understanding of real-time VFX optimization, including particle counts, overdraw, memory usage, material cost, scalability, and performance constraints.
  • Ability to balance visual impact, gameplay clarity, technical cost, and production schedule.
  • Strong communication skills, including clear written updates, verbal communication, documentation, and actionable feedback.
  • Ability to interpret vague creative, design, or client direction and turn it into clear VFX tasks or implementation plans.
  • Experience mentoring, reviewing, or guiding other artists. A formal Lead title is not required, but leadership behaviors are important.
  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and working with design, engineering, technical art, production, and art direction.
  • Strong ownership, follow-through, organization, and problem-solving ability.
  • Interest in growing into broader leadership responsibilities over time.

Nice to Have

  • Proficiency with common production tools such as Perforce, Jira, Miro, and Confluence.
  • Houdini experience.
  • EmberGen experience.
  • Unity experience.
  • Substance Designer experience.
  • Experience with proprietary engines or custom VFX tools.
  • Scripting or coding skills, such as C#, Python, Blueprint, or similar.
  • 2D animation or traditional animation experience.
  • 3D animation, simulation, or procedural content creation experience.
  • Experience creating both stylized and realistic effects.
  • Experience with foliage, atmospherics, environmental effects, weather, destruction, or ambient world VFX.
  • Experience working with outsourcing, co-development teams, partner studios, or external vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with teams across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
  • Experience establishing VFX standards, templates, naming conventions, libraries, scalability rules, or pipeline documentation.
  • Experience supporting client reviews, milestone deliveries, or cross-studio feedback loops.
  • Experience leading a small pod, strike team, feature group, or informal group of artists.

Portfolio Requirements

Please include a portfolio that clearly demonstrates your real-time VFX capabilities.

Your portfolio must include:

  • Real-time VFX assets with strong readability, timing, shape language, and clearly understandable visual elements.
  • At least one example shown in a real-time gameplay context, preferably a video of the effect happening in-game or during interactive gameplay.
  • Examples of strong material definition and texture work, with clean, readable, well-constructed setups.
  • Effects that demonstrate fundamentals such as composition, mood, color choices, timing, motion, impact, readability, and understanding of natural energies.
  • Examples of effects implemented in-engine, preferably in Unreal Engine 4 or 5 / Niagara.
  • Breakdowns showing your process, including textures, materials, emitters, timing, implementation, optimization, or technical setup where applicable.
  • Clear explanations of what you personally created, especially for any team-created work.

Strongly preferred portfolio examples include:

  • Before/after examples showing how you improved an effect through feedback, mentorship, optimization, or art direction.
  • A small set of effects that demonstrate consistent style, quality bar, or gameplay readability across a feature or content set.
  • Examples of templates, libraries, material systems, naming conventions, scalability setups, or pipeline improvements you helped create.
  • Examples that show how you balanced visual quality with performance constraints.

Please note: if your portfolio is mostly isolated effects in presentation scenes without runtime gameplay context, this may not be the right fit. We are looking for artists who understand how VFX function inside real-time gameplay, not just how they look in isolation.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a strong hands-on VFX artist who also thinks about how the whole team succeeds.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Care about making effects that are beautiful, readable, performant, and useful to gameplay.
  • Understand that great VFX is not just visual polish, but timing, feedback, clarity, mood, and technical execution.
  • Can work from vague direction and help define what an effect needs to communicate.
  • Can explain VFX decisions clearly to artists, designers, engineers, producers, clients, and other stakeholders.
  • Give feedback in a way that is specific, respectful, and actionable.
  • Notice risks early and communicate them before they become production problems.
  • Are comfortable working across different styles, teams, pipelines, engines, and project needs.
  • Enjoy helping others improve while still staying hands-on in production.
  • Are interested in growing toward lead responsibilities over time.

This position is currently open to candidates residing in the following Canada Provinces: Ontario, Quebec, or British Columbia.

Salary Range: $65,000 CAD to $70,000 CAD

What's in it for you?

  • Opportunity to work on different projects
  • 3 weeks of paid leave
  • Benefits package including medical, dental and vision
  • Sick Leave
  • Disability Coverage
  • Corporate holidays
  • Professional Development

GameSim is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, and alignment with the role.

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides for equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

By providing your information in this application, you understand that we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information, please see our Applicant Privacy Notice at .

GameSim est un studio de développement vidéoludique qui collabore avec des clients afin de créer des jeux aux styles artistiques variés, que ce soit sur PC ou sur console. Nous avons à cœur le savoir-faire, la collaboration et la livraison de produits auxquels nous sommes fiers d’être associés. Notre siège social est situé à Orlando, en Floride!

Avis d’offre d’emploi (vivier de talents)

Notez que cette offre d’emploi n’est pas associée à un poste actuellement vacant. Nous étoffons de manière proactive un vivier de candidat(e)s qualifié(e)s afin d’anticiper les embauches nécessaires au cours des mois à venir. Les candidatures seront analysées, conservées et considérées lorsque les occasions se présenteront.

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) artiste en effets visuels avec de solides compétences en effets en direct, un jugement technique solide et le potentiel d’évoluer vers des responsabilités de direction plus importantes au fil du temps.

Ce rôle est idéal pour une personne adorant créer des effets visuels de haute qualité tout en aidant les équipes à rester alignées, organisées et efficaces. Selon le projet, cette personne pourrait contribuer directement à la production d’effets visuels, à l’intégration dans le moteur, à la collecte des commentaires, à la décomposition des tâches, à l’optimisation, à la documentation des flux des travaux et à la collaboration interdisciplinaire.

Nos projets peuvent varier considérablement en termes de style, d’envergure, de plateforme et de besoins des clients. Ainsi, nous recherchons un artiste en effets visuels polyvalent possédant de solides bases et un esprit pratique en matière de production, capable de traduire une direction de création ou de conception en un travail d’effets clair et exploitable.

Il s’agit d’un rôle de production pratique offrant des opportunités de soutenir les petites équipes ou des groupes d’intervention, de guider la qualité des effets visuels, d’encadrer d'autres artistes, et de se développer vers des responsabilités de gestionnaires.

Ce rôle offre des options de travail flexibles, incluant des aménagements à distance, hybrides ou au bureau.

Responsabilités

  • Créer des effets visuels personnalisés en temps réel et les implémenter dans le moteur à l’aide d’Unreal Engine 5, d’Unity ou d’outils propriétaires.
  • Créer des effets de haute qualité pour les mécaniques de jeu, les environnements, les cinématiques, l’atmosphère, les combats, les interactions, la destruction, l’IU et les commentaires de jeu et autres besoins du projet.
  • Créer toutes les textures, « flipbooks », matériaux, maillages, simulations et ressources complémentaires pour les effets visuels en temps réel.
  • Maintenir des graphiques de matériaux, des systèmes Niagara, des paramètres, des conventions de nomenclature et des configurations d’effets réutilisables propres, lisibles et bien structurés.
  • Utiliser des outils tels que Photoshop, Substance Designer, Blender, Houdini, Maya, EmberGen ou d’autres logiciels selon les besoins pour soutenir la création d’effets.
  • Gérer des configurations de matériaux complexes, des « Blueprints », des points d’ancrage de script, des événements d’animation, des déclencheurs liés à la jouabilité ou des besoins d’implémentation propres au moteur.
  • Résoudre les problèmes liés aux effets visuels en partenariat avec les équipes techniques, d’ingénierie, de conception, d’animation, audio et autres disciplines.
  • Maîtriser les bases de l’optimisation des effets visuels, incluant le nombre de particules, le surdébit, le coût des shaders, la mémoire des textures, les taux d’apparition, les paramètres d’évolutivité et les contraintes de performance de la plateforme.
  • S’assurer que les effets sont lisibles, performants et alignés sur les besoins de jouabilité, la direction artistique, la dynamique, l’ambiance et les commentaires des joueurs.
  • Passer en revue le travail des artistes internes, des studios partenaires ou des fournisseurs externes et fournir des commentaires clairs, constructifs et concrets.
  • Aider à maintenir un seuil de qualité constant pour un ensemble d’effets, une fonctionnalité, un niveau ou une petite équipe.
  • Soutenir la planification à court terme en aidant à décomposer les demandes d’effets visuels en tâches claires, priorités, dépendances, risques et critères de validation.
  • Identifier de manière proactive les risques liés à la production, incluant les ancrages de jouabilité manquants, les pics de performance, une direction floue, les lacunes du processus, les problèmes de dépendance ou une exécution de styles incohérente.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les concepteurs, les artistes conceptuels, les directeurs artistiques, les artistes techniques, les ingénieurs, les animateurs, les concepteurs audio et les producteurs.
  • Contribuer à la communication avec les clients, selon les besoins, en clarifiant les exigences, en partageant les travaux en cours, en expliquant les contraintes et en s’alignant sur les résultats visés.
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration des flux de travaux d’effets visuels, des modèles réutilisables, de la documentation, des bibliothèques, des normes de nomenclature ou des règles d’évolutivité, selon les besoins.

Exigences

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle dans l’industrie des jeux vidéo en tant qu’artiste en effets visuels en temps réel ou dans un rôle similaire.
  • Au moins un titre de jeu livré.
  • Expérience éprouvée dans les flux des travaux en effets visuels en temps réel de bout en bout, depuis la conception et la création des ressources jusqu’à la mise en œuvre et le peaufinage dans le moteur.
  • Solide expérience de la mise en œuvre d’effets dans Unreal Engine 4 ou 5, avec une excellente connaissance pratique de Niagara.
  • Solides bases en animation de particules, incluant en matière de dynamisme, de rythme, de langage des formes, de mouvement, d’impact, d’anticipation, de dissipation et de lisibilité.
  • Solide compréhension des énergies et des matériaux naturels tels que le feu, la fumée, l’eau, l’électricité, la magie, la poussière, les débris, les explosions, les phénomènes atmosphériques et les effets environnementaux.
  • Solides compétences en création de matériaux et de textures avec des outils tels que Photoshop, Substance Designer ou des logiciels similaires.
  • Capacité à créer des graphiques de matériaux et des systèmes d’effets visuels propres, lisibles et bien construits.
  • Compréhension démontrée de l’optimisation des effets visuels en temps réel, incluant le nombre de particules, du surdébit, de l’utilisation de la mémoire, du coût des matériaux, de l’évolutivité et des contraintes de performance.
  • Capacité à trouver un équilibre entre l’impact visuel, la clarté de la jouabilité, le coût technique et le calendrier de production.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, incluant dans la création de mises à jour écrites claires, de communications verbales, de documentation et de commentaires exploitables.
  • Capacité à interpréter des directives créatives, de conception ou clients vagues et à les transformer en tâches d’effets visuels claires ou en plans de mise en œuvre.
  • Expérience en mentorat, en analyse ou en soutien d’autres artistes. Un titre officiel de chef d’équipe n’est pas exigé, mais les comportements associés sont importants.
  • Aisance à collaborer entre différentes disciplines et à travailler avec les équipes de conception, d’ingénierie, d’art technique, de production et de direction artistique.
  • Grand sens des responsabilités, rigueur d’exécution, organisation et capacité à résoudre les problèmes.
  • Intérêt pour évoluer vers des responsabilités de gestion plus larges avec le temps.

Atouts

  • Maîtrise des outils de production courants tels que Perforce, Jira, Miro et Confluence.
  • Expérience avec Houdini.
  • Expérience avec EmberGen.
  • Expérience avec Unity.
  • Expérience avec Substance Designer.
  • Expérience avec des moteurs propriétaires ou des outils d’effets visuels personnalisés.
  • Compétences en scriptage ou en programmation, comme C#, Python, Blueprint ou équivalent.
  • Expérience en animation 2D ou en animation traditionnelle.
  • Expérience en animation 3D, en simulation ou en création de contenu procédural.
  • Expérience dans la création d’effets stylisés et réalistes.
  • Expérience avec le feuillage, les atmosphères, les effets environnementaux, météorologiques, de destruction ou d’effets visuels d’ambiance.
  • Expérience de travail avec des fournisseurs externes, des équipes de codéveloppements, des studios partenaires ou des fournisseurs externes.
  • Expérience à collaborer avec des équipes issues de différents pays, cultures et fuseaux horaires.
  • Expérience dans l’établissement de normes, de modèles, de conventions de nomenclature, de bibliothèques, de règles d’évolutivité ou de documentation de processus pour les effets visuels.
  • Expérience pour soutenir les examens clients, les livraisons de jalons ou les boucles de rétroaction interstudios.
  • Expérience dans la gestion de petites équipes, d’équipes d’intervention, de groupes de travail ou de groupes informels d’artistes.

Exigences du portfolio

Veuillez inclure un portfolio qui démontre clairement vos compétences en effets visuels en temps réel.

Votre portfolio doit comprendre :

  • Ressources d’effets visuels en temps réel avec une lisibilité, un minutage, un langage des formes et des éléments visuels facilement compréhensibles.
  • Au moins un exemple dans un contexte de jeu en temps réel, de préférence, une vidéo montrant l’effet en jeu ou pendant une session de jeu interactive.
  • Exemples de définition des matériaux et de travail de textures solides, avec des compositions nettes, lisibles et bien créées.
  • Effets qui démontrent des bases telles que la composition, l’ambiance, le choix des couleurs, la dynamique, le mouvement, l’impact, la lisibilité et la compréhension des énergies naturelles.
  • Exemples d’effets implémentés dans le moteur, de préférence dans Unreal Engine 4 ou 5, ou Niagara.
  • Schémas détaillés montrant votre processus, incluant les textures, les matériaux, les émetteurs, la dynamique, l’implémentation, l’optimisation ou la configuration technique, le cas échéant.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

The Governance, Risk, and Compliance Automation Specialist is responsible for assisting in assessing third-party risk across Samsara’s new and existing systems and building automated workflows to support a scaling program.

You take Security seriously, but understand there is a business to operate and strive to build low friction solutions and decisions made in close partnership with others. On a typical day, you might work with Samsara’s legal or procurement team to discuss an ongoing review of a vendor, build and refine AI enabled workflows to scale the vendor risk program, and collaborate with teams across the business to understand and define vendor use cases and data flows.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Work with the Manager and Sr. Director of Platform Security and Compliance to provide programmatic updates and communicate both program, third-party, and technical risk to the broader Information Security leadership team
  • Drive automation and efficiency in the TPRM program through the use of third-parties, such as Zip and Vanta, and creating native solutions; ensuring security reviews and reassessments scale with company growth.
  • Partner with Procurement, Legal, and Privacy to ensure vendor risks are identified, documented, and mitigated throughout the vendor lifecycle.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2-4 years of experience in the governance, risk, and compliance space
  • Experience implementing or maintaining vendor-risk programs
  • Experience performing security and maturity assessments
  • Supporting the creation or maintenance of risk registers, compliance inventories, and control mappings across internal and external systems
  • Ability to work with systems teams to collaboratively implement security controls across a diverse range of systems, such as Okta, Slack, Salesforce, and internal tooling
  • Professional experience coordinating and interacting with external auditors, internal engineering teams, business stakeholders, senior leadership, and security operations teams on procurement activities, audit controls and compliance requirements
  • Experience conducting vendor risk assessments, including reviewing security certifications, penetration tests, and policies.
  • Strong understanding of vendor integration risks and permission scoping across SaaS platforms (eg. Slack, Google Workspace, and Salesforce)
  • Ability to translate complex technical findings and requirements into clear business risks and requirements to non technical stakeholders.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with NIST Cybersecurity Framework profiles, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar frameworks
  • Experience creating workflows through automation and AI assistance
  • Experience working within common GRC and procurement platforms such as Zip and Vanta.
  • Experience managing high volumes of vendor requests and competing priorities.
  • Prior assessment experience in the Software-as-a-Service industry

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Belonging at Samsara

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Mission Success & Performance
jobs.excerpt: About the roleMuon seeks a Senior Systems Engineer, Mission Success & Performance to join our Mission Engineering team.
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon seeks a Senior Systems Engineer, Mission Success & Performance to join our Mission Engineering team. As we scale the Muon Mission Foundry, we need a strategic architect of mission success, someone who champions predictable mission outcomes across the entire Mission Execution process, ensuring our operational and business objectives are achieved consistently and reliably. The ideal candidate has deployed revenue-generating systems in the field, understanding the nuances and practicalities of transitioning from technology demonstrations to scalable operational capacity.

This is not a traditional, compliance-heavy Mission Assurance role. This is a highly cross-functional role that spans the full lifecycle of mission design and execution, guaranteeing the technical integrity of our process as we “build the machine that builds the machines”. During the pre-launch activities, you will act as the vanguard for mission readiness, working with Mission Lead System Engineers (MLSEs) to drive right-sized Verification & Validation (V&V) campaigns that balance rigor and risk-tolerance with speed of Assembly, Integration, and Test (AI&T). Post-launch, you will work with operators to maximize the operational reality and business value of the assets, analyzing performance to close the loop between space and the future platform designs. Bridging both of these phases is a heavy focus on our autonomy and resilience capabilities, working on roadmap capabilities where you will shape fault management to drastically reduce operator toil.

Parallel to all these efforts, you will act as a key technical stakeholder for the internal tooling roadmaps that enable this scaling. At Muon, "right-sizing" goes beyond technical risk; you will ruthlessly prioritize engineering efforts, balancing the need to fix painful internal processes against the drive to improve gross margins and overarching business outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Enable the Muon Mission Foundry by driving processes and architectural decisions that allow Muon to scale spacecraft production and mission operations reliably and repeatably, moving beyond legacy quality assurance paradigms.
  • Partner with Mission Systems Engineers to own and track V&V compliance, verification progress, and test coverage campaigns.
  • Streamline AI&T workflows by identifying V&V bottlenecks and championing pragmatic Test Like You Fly (TLYF) standards.
  • Analyze on-orbit telemetry and platform operations to squeeze maximum utility and capacity out of deployed assets
  • Drive predictable outcomes by ensuring on-orbit performance closely matches pre-flight models, monitoring trends and impacts to mission SLAs, and understanding and proving the accuracy of the specifications we sell to customers.
  • Own the fleet-learning loop for cross-cutting technical issues that affect multiple missions or the platform baseline: deciding what warrants dedicated engineering focus, chartering multidisciplinary teams to drive root cause and prevention, and closing the loop back into design so lessons compound across the constellation
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to align requirements, resolve interface ambiguities, and keep delivery synchronized on cross functional autonomy and resilience efforts
  • Act as a key technical stakeholder supporting product roadmaps for internal tooling (e.g., MuSim, power analysis, data throughput), and utilizing your own software skills to build upon and extend baseline code, ensuring the tools enable the scaling of the Foundry.
  • Business-Driven "Right-Sizing": Make pragmatic decisions that balance engineering pain points against direct business outcomes, prioritizing work that moves the needle on revenue over simply policing internal processes.

Qualifications

  • M.S. or higher degree in an engineering field plus 8+ years of experience working in a multi-disciplinary environment, ideally with exposure to mission design, spacecraft operations, and systems architecture
  • Experience with deployed systems in the field, operating in high reliability, performance critical environments
  • Proven business acumen within an engineering context, understanding how asset capacity, uptime, and system resilience directly impact gross margins and revenue generation.
  • Extensive experience in AI&T workflows and V&V strategies, specifically tracking defect escape rates, and test coverage
  • Strong software skills (e.g., Python, Julia) with the ability to build upon existing codebases, coupled with a collaborative approach to supporting internal tooling roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated ability to model system performance (power, thermal, data throughput) and validate those models against real-world, on-orbit data.
  • Excellent communication and prioritization skills, with the ability to confidently balance technical risk with agile business constraints.
  • Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a high-paced, rewarding work environment

Nice-to-have Skills

  • Deep understanding of spacecraft autonomy and fault management architectures, including FMECA, tiered response design, and the operational integration of FSW and GSW, with the ability to translate a fault management philosophy into concrete monitor definitions, safe mode designs, and recovery sequences
  • Able to write requirements that software teams can implement and review FSW designs and code base for autonomy behavior.
  • Experience as a lead systems engineer or technical stakeholder in an agile environment
  • Remote sensing instrument experience across multiple modalities (e.g. optical, multispectral, RF), and their associated data pipelines
  • Hands-on experience developing, extending, or utilizing complex simulation environments
  • Familiarity with software engineering tools and processes (version control, code review)

Salary

The salary range for this role is $142,000 - $208,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. The Company may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.
