jobs.excerpt: We're looking for an E-Commerce Copywriter who understands that great product copy is about more than describing what a product does.
jobs.description:
We're looking for an E-Commerce Copywriter who understands that great product copy is about more than describing what a product does. You understand the relationship between products, customers, messaging, SEO, and conversion—and you know how to turn product features into compelling reasons to buy.

The Role

As our E-Commerce Copywriter, you'll help shape how Zulay Kitchen's products are presented across our e-commerce channels. You'll write and optimize product listings, develop messaging for new products, research customers and competitors, and continuously look for ways to make our copy more compelling and conversion-focused.

We're looking for someone who is a strong writer, customer-focused, creative, curious, and obsessed with figuring out what makes people click—and buy.

What You'll Do

E-Commerce Copywriting

  • Write and optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, and other e-commerce content.
  • Create compelling product copy that clearly communicates what the product does, why it matters, and why customers should choose it.
  • Turn product features into customer-focused benefits and persuasive messaging.
  • Develop copy for Amazon listings, Shopify product pages, A+ Content, social media, email campaigns, product packaging, and other customer-facing marketing materials.
  • Write messaging for new product launches, promotions, and other marketing initiatives.
  • Maintain a consistent and recognizable Zulay Kitchen brand voice across product content.

Conversion & Product Messaging

  • Review existing product listings and identify opportunities to improve clarity, engagement, and conversion.
  • Analyze customer reviews, questions, feedback, and competitor listings to understand what customers care about.
  • Identify customer pain points, objections, motivations, and purchasing triggers.
  • Develop messaging that addresses customer concerns and makes the value of our products immediately clear.
  • Help identify the strongest selling points and differentiators for each product.
  • Continuously test and refine messaging based on performance and customer response.

SEO & Marketplace Optimization

  • Conduct keyword research and incorporate relevant search terms naturally into product copy.
  • Optimize listings for search visibility without sacrificing readability or persuasive messaging.
  • Stay current on Amazon and e-commerce SEO best practices.
  • Research competitors and identify opportunities to differentiate Zulay Kitchen products.
  • Keep up with changes in marketplace algorithms, customer behavior, and e-commerce trends.

Research & Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to develop and execute product messaging and content strategies.
  • Collaborate with Category Managers, Amazon Sales Specialists, Designers, and other team members to understand products and their target customers.
  • Conduct product and market research before developing copy.
  • Partner with the creative team to make sure copy and visuals work together to tell a strong product story.
  • Take feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your work.

You'd Be a Great Fit If...

You don't just look at a product and ask "What does it do?"

You ask:

"Why would someone want this?"

"What problem is this solving?"

"What would make a customer choose this over the competition?"
"What might stop someone from buying?"
"How can we communicate the value in a way that makes people want to click 'Add to Cart'?"

You're able to take a product with a list of features and turn it into copy that makes the customer understand why they need it.

You're equally comfortable researching competitors and customer reviews, analyzing an existing product listing, and sitting down to write a strong headline or product description.

You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be improved. You're constantly looking for opportunities to make our listings clearer, more compelling, and more likely to convert.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional copywriting experience, preferably in e-commerce, DTC, retail, or consumer products.
  • Proven experience writing product listings or conversion-focused copy.
  • Excellent written English, grammar, and editing skills.
  • Strong understanding of customer psychology and persuasive writing.
  • Experience with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces is highly preferred.
  • Understanding of e-commerce SEO and keyword optimization.
  • Strong research skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple products and deadlines independently.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on copy.
  • A strong instinct for what makes copy clear, engaging, and convincing.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Amazon A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content.
  • Familiarity with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar tools.
  • Shopify experience.
  • Experience working with physical consumer products, particularly kitchen, home, or lifestyle brands.
  • Experience collaborating with designers, photographers, or creative teams.
  • Experience using AI tools to support research and content workflows while maintaining originality and brand voice.

LTL Operations Specialist (Remote)

About the job

ARS Logistics (Authorized Agent of Trinity Logistics) is a family owned and operated Third Party Logistics company with 20+ years of history. We are proud of what we have built through strong and lasting relationships with our customers and team members.

The LTL Operations Specialist is responsible for delivering operationally excellent transportation services within our less-than-truckload (LTL) division. This role manages the day-to-day execution of LTL shipments, serving as the key link between carriers, internal stakeholders, and customer representatives. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, solutions-driven, and thrives in a fast-paced logistics environment.

Start Date:ASAP

Why you’ll like working here

•Direct impact — you own the LTL outcome for our customers, and the team relies on your judgment.

•Real problem-solving — reclasses, reweighs, OS&D, missed pickups; no two days are the same.

•Collaborative team — a supportive group of logistics professionals who value open communication and follow-through.

•Structured upward mobility — clear growth path within the company as the LTL division scales.

What you’ll do

•Track and trace LTL and common-carrier shipments from booking through delivery; proactively identify and communicate exceptions, delays and service failures before the customer has to ask.

•Review LTL invoices and freight bills for discrepancies (reweighs, reclasses, accessorials, duplicate billing) and advise the customer service and account management teams on billing exceptions, disputes and resolution.

•Guide customer-facing teams on proper LTL order construction — freight class (NMFC), packaging, dimensions, weight and carrier selection — to optimize cost, service and compliance.

•Coordinate with LTL carriers on overages, shortages and damages (OS&D) and manage freight claims through to resolution on behalf of our customers and the company.

•Monitor LTL carrier performance — on-time %, exception rates and service trends — and report findings to management.

•Maintain accurate, timely data in the TMS; identify efficiency, cost-saving and process improvements and help implement them.

•Support general LTL operations as needed: system updates, reporting, customer-facing documentation and rate analysis.

What you need to bring

•2+ years of hands-on LTL experience at a freight brokerage / 3PL or an LTL carrier (customer service, operations, billing or claims).

•Working knowledge of NMFC freight classification, density-based pricing, accessorials and how to read an LTL freight bill.

•Experience with a brokerage TMS and LTL carrier portals (booking, tracking, documents, disputes).

•Clear, professional written and spoken English — you will be corresponding with U.S. carriers and customers daily.

•Detail-oriented, accurate and efficient; able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment with dependability and initiative.

•Reliable remote setup: backup power, backup internet, backup computer, and 2 to 3 screens.

•Availability during core U.S. Eastern business hours (see engagement details).

Preference given to

•Prior experience working for or with a third party logistics company

•Experience filing and winning LTL freight claims (Carmack, concealed damage, OS&D documentation).

•Familiarity with CRM and business-intelligence / reporting tools.

•Experience working with distributed, remote teams across time zones.

Engagement details

•Engagement type:Remote independent contractor. Open to qualified candidates in any country.

deine rolle bei uns

sechs gute gründe für uns

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT EVERYDAY DOSEEveryday Dose is a functional coffee company on a mission to help people feel better, think clearer, and perform at their best, without the crash that comes with regular coffee.
jobs.description:
ABOUT EVERYDAY DOSE

Everyday Dose is a functional coffee company on a mission to help people feel better, think clearer, and perform at their best, without the crash that comes with regular coffee. We're a fast-growing, nine-figure D2C brand with a loyal, high-retention subscriber base, and we're scaling our retention function to match our ambitions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Supply Chain Specialist to help drive the day-to-day execution of our growing supply chain operation. Reporting to the Supply Chain Manager, you’ll own the daily and weekly cadence of inventory planning, purchasing, production coordination, inventory reconciliation, and co-manufacturer execution.

Our supply chain spans overseas ingredient suppliers, domestic co-manufacturers, freight partners, and 3PL warehouses. Your job is to keep the pieces moving accurately and on time—from ensuring materials are available for upcoming production runs to reconciling inventory and following up with suppliers.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. We’re looking for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and energized by closing loops. You’ll work closely with the Supply Chain Manager on priorities and supplier direction while owning the execution needed to keep our supply chain running smoothly.

This role is fully remote, with a hybrid option available for candidates based in Austin, TX.

Requirements

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You’ll take primary ownership across several core areas of our supply chain operation:

  • Planning & Inventory: Run inventory planning across raw materials, packaging, and finished goods while maintaining safety stock, reorder points, and planning models.
  • Purchasing & Supplier Performance: Support sourcing and purchasing activities, maintain pricing and contract information, monitor supplier performance and risk, and ensure open items get closed.
  • Co-Manufacturing & Production: Serve as a day-to-day operational partner to our co-manufacturers and keep production schedules, materials, and inventory aligned.
  • Inventory Accuracy: Drive cycle counting, reconciliation, FEFO management, and traceability across co-manufacturers and 3PL locations.
  • Operational Execution: Maintain the models, processes, reporting, and follow-up cadence needed to keep production and supply chain activities running on schedule.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Run inventory planning: Manage inventory planning across raw materials, packaging, and finished goods and maintain appropriate safety stock and reorder points by SKU and material.
  • Support S&OP: Prepare inputs, run scenarios, publish outputs, and track follow-up actions for production planning and the monthly S&OP cycle.
  • Maintain planning models: Build and maintain formula-driven, auditable planning models and run-rate tools that provide clear visibility into inventory and production needs.
  • Support sourcing: Partner with the Sourcing Manager on supplier negotiations through cost analysis, quote comparisons, and should-cost modeling.
  • Maintain supplier information: Keep contract and pricing records accurate and track expirations, volume commitments, and renewal dates.
  • Monitor supplier performance: Track supplier OTIF and quality performance, support scorecard reviews, and identify areas requiring follow-up or improvement.
  • Manage supply risk: Monitor single-source exposure, tariff changes, capacity constraints, supplier financial health, and other potential risks while maintaining contingency options.
  • Manage aging inventory: Identify aging and obsolete inventory early and coordinate escalation and disposition before it becomes a write-off.
  • Support invoice accuracy: Ensure 3-way invoice matching across suppliers and co-manufacturers and help resolve discrepancies.

  • Monitor production performance: Track yield and scrap against standards, investigate variances, and help drive root-cause resolution.
  • Maintain traceability: Ensure batch and lot traceability from raw materials through finished goods.
  • Track production costs: Monitor production costs against standards and identify and explain variances.
  • Reconcile inventory: Execute inventory reconciliations and raw-material cycle counts across co-manufacturers and 3PLs.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

NICE TO HAVE

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first 90 days, you’ve developed a strong understanding of our co-manufacturer network, supplier base, products, materials, and distribution channels. jobs.title: Économiste principal·e
jobs.excerpt: Qui sommes-nous? L’Alliance pharmaceutique pancanadienne (APP) réunit les gouvernements provinciaux, territoriaux et fédéral dans le but d’accroître et de gérer l’accès à des médicaments utiles sur le plan clinique et rentables.
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous?

L’Alliance pharmaceutique pancanadienne (APP) réunit les gouvernements provinciaux, territoriaux et fédéral dans le but d’accroître et de gérer l’accès à des médicaments utiles sur le plan clinique et rentables. Grâce à des négociations collectives, l’APP a réalisé des économies globales pour les gouvernements (au 1er avril 2025) de 3,94 milliards de dollars par année sur les médicaments de marque et de 935 millions de dollars par année sur les médicaments génériques, pour un total de 4,87 milliards de dollars par année. L’APP offre un environnement de travail entièrement à distance (au Canada).

À propos du poste

La personne titulaire du poste d’économiste principal·e fait appel à son expertise et son leadership pour soutenir l’Alliance pharmaceutique pancanadienne (APP) dans la prise de décision en matière de planification, de coordination et de gestion des négociations pour les médicaments de marque et de l’évaluation de médicaments génériques. Pour ce faire, elle s’appuie sur des évaluations de l’économie de la santé et d’autres analyses financières en vue d’obtenir la meilleure valeur possible pour les régimes publics d’assurance médicaments fédéraux, provinciaux et territoriaux.

Relevant de la gestion, Analyses, cette personne dirige des projets visant à appuyer les négociations menées par l’APP, grâce à des données probantes. Elle participe également à des comités réunissant diverses parties prenantes en vue de planifier, coordonner et de mettre en place des stratégies et des processus de négociation. La personne titulaire du poste d’économiste principal·e occupe des responsabilités liées à une ou plusieurs des activités fondamentales de la division des analyses :

  • Soutien analytique et leadership à l’égard des négociations de l’APP
  • Analyses exhaustives du marché pharmaceutique, englobant les médicaments de marque et les médicaments génériques, ainsi que du marché pharmaceutique en plein essor (par exemple, médicaments biosimilaires, thérapies cellulaires et géniques)
  • Analyses économiques et financières visant à évaluer les politiques relatives aux médicaments ou le rendement de l’organisation

La personne recherchée doit faire preuve d’une capacité à traiter des questions d’une grande complexité de manière autonome et à assurer un leadership technique auprès des économistes et des analystes de la division.

Livrables spécifiques

  • En collaboration avec l’équipe des négociations de l’APP et les partenaires du fédéral, des provinces et des territoires, élaborer des stratégies de négociation, établir des mandats et réévaluer les offres et contre-offres entre l’APP et les fabricants pharmaceutiques afin d’obtenir des résultats axés sur la valeur au terme des négociations.
  • Effectuer des analyses exhaustives de manière indépendante (p. ex. systèmes financiers, utilisation des médicaments, études sur le milieu) dans lesquelles les résultats de recherche pertinents sont synthétisés et présentés afin d’étayer la prise de décisions fondées sur des données probantes quant aux négociations menées par l’APP.
  • Cerner et analyser les problèmes internes et externes comme les enjeux réglementaires et les dépendances contractuelles pouvant avoir une incidence sur les négociations et, au besoin, examiner les répercussions juridiques afin d’offrir des conseils sur mesure concernant les négociations menées par l’APP.
  • Mener de nouvelles analyses ciblées sur le coût-utilité, la réduction des coûts ainsi que des analyses d’impact budgétaire, qui comprennent les prix confidentiels des sociétés pharmaceutiques ou d’autres hypothèses formulées par les fabricants ou des agences d’évaluation des technologies de la santé, de manière à en évaluer la plausibilité et l’incidence.
  • Réaliser une analyse critique des propositions complexes et confidentielles de prix par les fabricants, y compris les éléments contractuels liés aux patient·es ou à l’utilisation du médicament. Dans certains cas, examiner les éléments propres aux indications afin de quantifier l’incidence financière pour chacune des administrations publiques et pour l’ensemble du pays.
  • Évaluer les stratégies de l’APP et du fabricant liées à des offres fondées sur les résultats, notamment sur l’évaluation appropriée, la complexité d’administration et l’incidence sur le système de santé à l’échelle du pays.
  • Conduire ou appuyer la recherche quantitative portant sur l’écosystème pharmaceutique. Cette recherche porte, entre autres, sur l’évaluation des économies réalisées grâce aux ententes conclues par l’APP, l’analyse chronologique du cycle de vie des médicaments (c.-à-d. l’accès au marché et l’exclusivité du marché), le calcul des remises en prenant en compte différents éléments contractuels, ainsi que les répercussions financières des changements apportés à la politique de remboursement des produits pharmaceutiques.
  • Diriger ou codiriger tous les aspects des négociations avec les fabricants de médicaments pour le compte de l’APP. Cela comprend l’élaboration des mandats, l’établissement des objectifs, et l’obtention de résultats conformes à l’orientation et à la stratégie globale de l’APP.
  • Élaborer et parfaire les processus et les structures permettant d’assurer l’uniformité des négociations menées par l’APP et appuyer la mise au point de normes de négociation provinciales/territoriales conformes avec les pratiques exemplaires.
  • Faire preuve d’un leadership efficace dans la gestion de projets, incluant la détermination de la portée du projet, l’établissement des paramètres du projet, y compris l’évaluation des ressources et la mise en œuvre du projet. Pour ce faire, la personne recherchée devra veiller à la bonne progression du projet, réfléchir à différentes options possibles pour déployer les solutions les plus efficaces pour résoudre les problèmes de manière proactive et préparer les livrables (p. ex. rapports, plans de mise en œuvre, documents de communication).
  • Diriger la préparation de documents de formation et de ressources.

Livrables généraux

  • Recueillir, organiser et interpréter les données pour les membres de l’équipe des analyses, le personnel de l’APP ou les personnes-ressources des administrations publiques membres.
  • Diriger l’élaboration et l’évaluation de rapports et d’analyses portant sur l’APP ou sur l’écosystème pharmaceutique, ou participer au processus.
  • Coordonner, préparer et rédiger des solutions, des documents sur les politiques, des diaporamas, des notes de service, de la correspondance, des notes d’information et des rapports pour la haute direction et les cadres supérieurs concernant diverses questions liées aux médicaments. Il peut s’agir notamment de présenter des options stratégiques et des recommandations aux équipes de gestion des régimes publics d’assurance médicaments, aux groupes de travail et aux comités intergouvernementaux en vue d’appuyer la prise de décision fondée sur des données probantes.
  • Mener à bien des consultations importantes et assurer la liaison avec les régimes publics d’assurance médicaments fédéraux, provinciaux et territoriaux, et avec d’autres administrations publiques et spécialistes (p. ex. des domaines médicaux, juridiques et financiers) au sujet d’ententes de remboursement de médicaments.
  • Soutenir les analystes dans la préparation d’indicateurs internes et destinés au public. Parmi ceux-ci, on compte des indicateurs de rendement clés, des indicateurs de risque clés et des indicateurs ciblés mesurant le volume, la rapidité et l’efficacité des négociations pour les médicaments de marque et pour l’évaluation de médicaments génériques.
  • Guider la mise au point, la révision ou l’analyse des politiques, des programmes et des initiatives ayant trait aux négociations.
  • Encourager et entretenir des relations avec les administrations fédérale, provinciales, territoriales, ainsi qu’avec d’autres groupes externes afin d’élaborer et mettre en place des interventions concertées dans plusieurs domaines.
  • Représenter l’APP et participer à des groupes de travail ou à des comités et agir en tant qu’intermédiaire entre les partenaires externes et les organismes consultatifs concernés.
  • Appuyer l’élaboration de plan d’affaires.
  • Se tenir au courant des tendances du milieu.

Supérieur·e hiérarchique

  • Relève de la gestion, Analyses

Qualités requises

Études et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en économie de la santé, en finances, en administration des affaires, dans une discipline clinique ou scientifique (notamment en pharmacie, en pharmacologie ou en sciences médicales), ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • De 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en évaluation de l’économie de la santé (analyses sur le coût-utilité, le coût-efficacité) et en analyse d’impact budgétaire, notamment la direction de l’interprétation et de l’estimation d’évaluations économiques et d’analyses d’impact budgétaire, ainsi que la capacité à modifier de telles analyses pour y intégrer d’autres paramètres ou hypothèses.
  • Au moins 3 ans d’expérience à effectuer des analyses quantitatives détaillées (p. ex. financières, utilisation des médicaments, analyses de l’environnement) afin d’étayer la prise de décisions.
  • Au moins 3 ans d’expérience à travailler avec des données pour appuyer les activités d’analyse, de recherche ou stratégiques.
  • Expérience dans la préparation de rapports, de notes d’information ou de présentations visant à communiquer des résultats.
  • Une expérience de travail dans le milieu des sciences pharmaceutiques, de la recherche sur les services de santé; dans la sphère gouvernementale ou de la réglementation est requise.
  • Expérience dans le mentorat ou l’encadrement de membres du personnel (un atout).
  • Expérience dans la supervision de groupes de travail et d’équipes de projet (un atout).
  • Expérience à soutenir des stratégies de négociation par le biais d’une expertise économique et financière (un atout).

Compétences et capacités

  • Comme l’anglais est la principale langue de travail à l’APP, des compétences exceptionnelles en communication orale et écrite en anglais sont requises, en plus de la capacité avérée à effectuer des présentations destinées à des auditoires techniques et généralistes.
  • Bonnes compétences en communication orale et écrite en français (un atout).
  • Compréhension approfondie de l’industrie pharmaceutique canadienne et des processus gouvernementaux.
  • Compétence avérée à effectuer des présentations à des parties prenantes internes ou externes.
  • Capacité exceptionnelle à mobiliser les partenaires, à répondre à leurs besoins et à nouer des relations de travail avec toutes les parties prenantes, favorisant ainsi une culture organisationnelle efficace et dynamique.
  • Solides capacités à résoudre des problèmes et à prendre de manière autonome des décisions fondées sur une compréhension approfondie des procédures établies et sur la prise en compte des facteurs contextuels pertinents.
  • Aptitude à diriger et à établir un consensus en l’absence d’autorité.
  • Sens aigu des affaires et du numérique.

Conditions d’emploi  

  • L’échelle salariale pour ce poste permanent à temps plein, de classification A7, est de 97 747$ à 137 711$. Cette échelle reflète le salaire des candidat·es dont les niveaux d’expérience, les connaissances et la qualification professionnelle se rapportant au poste varient. Les offres particulières seront fondées sur les antécédents et la qualification de la personne désignée.
  • Ce poste fait partie de l’unité de négociation de l’Association of Management, Administrative, and Professional Crown Employees of Ontario (« AMAPCEO »), et est régi par les dispositions décrites dans la convention collective.
  • Le nombre hebdomadaire d’heures de travail pour ce poste totalise 36,25 h.
  • L’APP offre également aux membres du personnel un ensemble complet d’avantages sociaux collectifs dès leur premier jour de travail. 
  • La personne idéale doit avoir le droit de travailler au Canada et pourra travailler à partir de n’importe quel endroit au Canada.
  • Ce poste exige des déplacements fréquents dans différentes provinces et différents territoires, y compris des voyages périodiques de plusieurs jours avec nuitées.

Si ce poste vous intéresse, veuillez transmettre candidature d’ici la fin de la journée du 17 septembre 2026.

Nous remercions toutes les personnes intéressées; toutefois, nous communiquerons seulement avec celles qui ont été retenues pour les étapes suivantes.   

L’APP souscrit au principe de l’équité en matière d’emploi. Conformément à la Loi canadienne sur l’accessibilité de 2019 et à toutes les normes d’accessibilité provinciales et territoriales applicables, l’APP offrira, sur demande, des mesures d’adaptation aux candidat·es en situation de handicap tout au long du processus de recrutement, de sélection ou d’évaluation.

jobs.excerpt: Requistion ID: 83800 Dentsply Sirona is the world’s largest manufacturer of professional dental products and technologies, with over a century of innovation and service to the dental industry and patients worldwide.
jobs.description:
Requistion ID: 83800

Dentsply Sirona is the world’s largest manufacturer of professional dental products and technologies, with over a century of innovation and service to the dental industry and patients worldwide. Dentsply Sirona develops, manufactures, and markets a comprehensive solutions offering including dental and oral health products as well as other consumable medical devices under a strong portfolio of world class brands.

Dentsply Sirona’s products provide innovative, high-quality, and effective solutions to advance patient care and deliver better and safer dental care. Dentsply Sirona’s headquarter is located in Charlotte, North Carolina. The company’s shares are listed in the United States on NASDAQ under the symbol XRAY. Visit for more information about Dentsply Sirona and its products.

This position can be a remote working arrangement. Candidates must be located in the US, ideally in the eastern time zone.

Job Summary:

The primary job responsibility for of the Regulatory Affairs Manager is overseeing the day-to-day functions of the Dentsply Sirona Implants and Prosthetics team. This role develops regulatory strategies for existing, new, and modified medical devices and other (regulated) products. This role manages and submits 510ks for the products and manages communications with FDA including pre-subs. The individual will also be responsible for mentoring and providing guidance to their direct reports and cross-functional product development teams on US and EU regulatory requirements.

This role works closely with business partners for registrations in their respective countries to ensure compliance globally and acts as an internal champion for initiatives aimed at improving business systems and compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develops and implements regulatory strategies to obtain and maintain regulatory approvals for medical devices and other regulated products globally.
  • Leads and manages regulatory submissions, including 510(k) submissions, and technical files for CE marking.
  • Manages communications with FDA and EU notified bodies on behalf of the company for FDA pre submissions, FDA 510(k) submissions and EU technical files submissions.
  • Provides regulatory guidance and support to cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle. Reviews and interprets regulatory requirements and guidance documents to ensure compliance.
  • Coordinates regulatory activities with internal teams and external regulatory agencies.
  • Reviews and approves product labelling and claims for the US and EU markets.
  • Stays current with regulatory requirements and updates affected policies and procedures.
  • Fosters professional interactions with internal and external stakeholders through various communication channels, enhancing business relationships.
  • Manages day-to-day activities for less senior Regulatory Affairs professionals, including but not limited to mentoring, coaching, performance reviews, developmental plans, and succession planning.
  • Complies with company and departmental policies and administrative requirements.
  • Performs other duties as assigned or as needed.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as life sciences, regulatory affairs, or a related discipline.
  • Regulatory Certification (such as RAC from the Regulatory Affairs Professionals Society) or Master’s degree in a scientific discipline is a plus.

Years and Type of Experience:

  • 5(+) years of experience in regulatory affairs, preferably in the medical device industry.
  • Experience with leading regulatory submissions and managing regulatory projects.
  • In-depth knowledge of FDA 510(k) and international regulations (e.g., EN ISO 13485, EU MDR).
  • Experience with software as a medical device, AI and/or medical devices containing software is a plus

Required Computer / Software Skills:

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
  • Proficiency with Regulatory software

Key Required Skills, Knowledge, and Capabilities:

  • Strong leadership, project management, and organizational skills including attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Prior technical writing experience and proven track record with FDA and EU regulatory submissions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and independently.
  • Knowledge of regulatory affairs principles and practices.
  • Ability to critically review detailed scientific information and assess whether technical arguments are presented clearly, and conclusions are adequately supported.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new processes and technologies.
  • Leadership experience within medical device organizations.

Key Leadership Behaviors:

  • Actively articulates and promotes Dentsply Sirona’s vision and direction.
  • Advocates on behalf of the customer.
  • Values driven with an insistence on excellence.
  • Promotes high performance, innovation, and continual improvement.
  • Consistently meets Company standards, ethics, and compliance requirements.
  • Strong results orientation and analytical skills.
  • Clear and effective communication with key stakeholders, which span across multiple levels, socio-geographic areas, and functional expertise.
  • Resolves conflicts and fosters a positive working environment.

The base salary and target annual incentive for this remote role is between $154,000 - $165,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific office location.

All qualified applicants will be considered without unlawful discrimination or regard for race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, sexual or gender identity, national or ethnic origin, age, marital status, disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable local law.

About the Role

Social is one of the most visible surfaces of the LP brand, and it's ready for a strategic owner. You'll set the direction for how LP shows up across every platform, from LinkedIn to Reddit, and turn that presence into a real growth channel rather than a content calendar that runs on its own.

This is a build role. You'll define the strategy, prove that social drives pipeline, and make the function a reliable partner to the rest of marketing. You'll work closely with our CEO on his thought leadership presence and with content, demand gen, and sales on campaigns that need social to land.

What You'll Do

  • Build and publish a documented social strategy within your first 90 days: channel priorities, content pillars, posting cadence, and voice guidelines, reviewed quarterly against performance data.

  • Own a quarterly social-sourced pipeline target, set jointly with sales and RevOps, and build the reporting that shows a clear line between social activity and business results.

  • Grow share of voice for LP's core narrative through follower growth, reach, and impressions on flagship content, including our CEO's thought leadership and our Reddit presence.

  • Manage community health end to end: engagement rate, response time, and sentiment, with a clear before-and-after benchmark from your first day.

  • Make social a dependable contributor to at least one other function's goals within your first year, such as the newsletter's social section, video series distribution, or webinar promotion, with a documented handoff process.

  • Own real-time judgment calls. Reddit threads and comment sections move fast, and there's no playbook for every scenario. You'll decide when to engage, when to escalate, and how to protect the brand without waiting for direction.

What We're Looking For

Skills and Experience

  • 4-6 years in social media or community management, with at least 2 years owning strategy rather than executing someone else's calendar.

  • Deep working knowledge of how platforms actually behave, not a one-size-fits-all approach to LinkedIn, Instagram, Reddit, YouTube, and TikTok.

  • Comfortable pulling and interpreting engagement, reach, and conversion data, and adjusting strategy based on what the numbers say.

  • Strong brand voice discipline. You can make LP sound like LP everywhere, including in fast-moving, informal spaces like Reddit.

  • Hands-on content creation or art direction skill, whether that's producing content yourself or briefing designers and videographers effectively.

Attributes

  • You operate as a strategic owner of the function, not an execution arm. You spot opportunities and act on them rather than waiting to be asked.

  • You have strong judgment under ambiguity. When something goes sideways in public, you own it end to end.

  • You hold a high quality bar even at volume. Social is often a prospect's first touchpoint with LP, and you know sloppy content undercuts the brand.

  • You work fluidly across functions. Social touches nearly everything else in marketing, and you're comfortable coordinating with content, demand gen, sales, and leadership.

  • You stay ahead of platform shifts and cultural moments instead of catching up to them weeks later.

We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

Role Summary

The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. The CLO serves as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and executive leadership team, ensuring the organization operates within legal and regulatory frameworks while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

  • Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.
  • Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.
  • Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.
  • Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.
  • Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.
  • Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.
  • Develop legal risk mitigation frameworks and compliance controls.

4. Contracts & Commercial Transactions

  • Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of significant commercial agreements.
  • Oversee contract management processes and legal documentation standards.
  • Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements adequately protect organizational interests.

5. Litigation & Dispute Resolution

  • Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.
  • Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.
  • Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.
  • Ensure effective management of legal claims and liabilities.

6. Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Transactions

  • Lead legal due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and investments.
  • Structure transactions to minimize legal and regulatory risk.
  • Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.
  • Support post-merger integration activities from a legal perspective.

7. Ethics, Compliance & Corporate Integrity

  • Promote a culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance.
  • Oversee whistleblower programs, investigations, and ethics policies.
  • Ensure adherence to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, and corporate conduct standards.
  • Lead internal investigations involving legal and compliance matters.

8. Legal Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing legal and compliance function.
  • Manage legal budgets and external counsel expenditures.
  • Develop legal talent and succession planning initiatives.
  • Establish legal operations processes and performance metrics.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Juris Doctor (JD), LLB, or equivalent law degree.
  • Licensed attorney admitted to practice in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • 15+ years of progressive legal experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a senior legal leadership role (General Counsel, CLO, Head of Legal, Legal Director).
  • Experience advising executive leadership and boards of directors.
  • Strong background in corporate law, governance, compliance, commercial contracts, and regulatory matters.
  • Experience managing complex legal transactions and litigation.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Senior Customer Success Manager on Twilio’s Segment team.

About the job

At Segment, we believe companies should be able to send their data wherever they want, whenever they want, with no fuss. We make this easy with a single platform that collects, stores, filters, transforms, and sends data to hundreds of business tools with the flip of a switch. More recently, we also developed the ability to let customers enrich their data in real time using computations they specify. Our goal is to make it easy to understand, extract value, and protect the integrity of data. We are creating a world where engineers spend their time working on their core product, letting us take care of the complexities of processing their customer data reliably at scale. We’re in the running to take over the entire customer data ecosystem, and we need the best people to take the market.

The Customer Success Management team at Segment is the central touchpoint for our customers, orchestrating the post-sales customer lifecycle in partnership with professional services, sales and support. The team manages the customer relationship, coordinates internally within Segment, drives product adoption and guides the customer to take full advantage of our ecosystem. Fundamentally, the CSM team ensures customers derive value from our platform, and ultimately renew and grow their relationships with us.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic accounts you will be at the forefront of driving customer satisfaction by developing tailored strategies that align with both customer goals and company objectives. Your work will directly impact customer retention and growth, as you will solve complex challenges, influence strategic decisions and advocate for customer needs across executive stakeholders. We are looking for CSMs who are passionate about first party data and how it can transform organizations. As a CSM, you will have the opportunity to help some of the world’s most influential companies solve their toughest data problems. So if you get excited about things like defining culture and process, you may be the Customer Success Manager we’re looking for!

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Ensure customer success by driving full value realization of the Segment platform.
  • Develop and execute strategic roadmaps for product adoption, customer satisfaction, and advocacy.
  • Manage the customer relationship, acting as a trusted advisor to executive and senior leadership in Engineering, Product, Business Analytics, and Marketing.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with IT, engineering, and development teams to drive engagement.
  • Identify and expand opportunities to deepen customer engagement and account growth.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to optimize implementations and resolve complex technical challenges.
  • Build and nurture new stakeholder relationships to unlock expansion opportunities.
  • Partner with Sales on account renewals and expansion strategies.
  • Analyze your portfolio to prioritize high-impact risks and opportunities.
  • Proactively identify risks, prioritize opportunities, and develop mitigation plans for high-impact accounts.
  • Become a Segment platform expert while staying current with industry trends in data and analytics.
  • Ensure execution of customer maturity and technical discussions via coordinating solutions internally across engineering, marketing, product, and support teams.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 2+ years managing enterprise customers with portfolios of $200k+ ACV per client
  • 3+ years in customer-facing roles (CSM, account management, or consulting)
  • Proven experience working within or supporting Fortune 500 companies or similarly large organizations.
  • Expert in customer strategy development, bringing data-driven insights and best practices to optimize client success.
  • Proven ability to build and sustain relationships with stakeholders across all levels and business units within an organizations
  • Intellectually curious, asks critical questions, and challenges ideas for better solutions
  • Develops and implements strategies to maximize revenue growth and product adoption for the assigned portfolio, leveraging insights into client needs, market trends, and financial metrics.
  • Excellent communication skills for engaging executive stakeholders through presentations and discussions.
  • Skilled in problem-solving, able to simplify complex issues and develop actionable strategies for clients.
  • Strong collaboration and influence skills to align internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Thrives in dynamic environments, adept at creating structure and processes for high-impact customers.
  • Focus on customer satisfaction and retention, with a track record of anticipating needs and delivering tailored solutions.
  • Passionate about leveraging data and technology (e.g., analytics, APIs, SQL) to drive business outcomes.

Location

This role will be remote but is not eligible to be hired in San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, San Jose, CA, or the surrounding areas.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.
The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:
  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $92,624 - $115,780
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $97,768 - $122,210
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $102,912 - $128,640
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
  • This role is eligible to earn commissions.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until October 1, 2026 but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.excerpt: About Pear Suite Pear Suite is an early-stage digital health company building software for community-based care.
jobs.description:
About Pear Suite

Pear Suite is an early-stage digital health company building software for community-based care. Our care navigation platform equips community health workers, doulas, care navigators, and the organizations that support them with tools to collect, visualize, and act on social determinants of health data. We help community-based organizations, health systems, and government-funded care programs deliver more coordinated, person-centered care.

Why Pear Suite?

We’re a mission-driven team committed to health equity and innovation in community-based care. You’ll thrive here if you’re eager to take initiative, value autonomy, and enjoy building structure where none exists. Join us to build scalable, human-centered technology that empowers frontline workers and improves lives across the U.S.

About the role

This role is designed for the Nurse Practitioner who values flexibility, thrives in a virtual care environment, and is excited to grow alongside a company that is scaling quickly. You will start on a PRN basis, picking up shifts based on your availability and patient demand with a genuine pathway to a more consistent, long-term role as volume increases and service footprint expands.

In this role, you will conduct clinical assessments enabling patients to access Community Health Worker (CHW) services, helping them overcome barriers to care, social services, improve stability and achieve better health outcomes through appropriate referrals and utilization of medical and social services. This is a patient-centered role that blends clinical judgment with care coordination in a value-based, whole-person care model.

Why This Role Matters

For many patients, health outcomes are shaped as much by housing instability, transportation challenges, and access to resources as determined by clinical conditions. This role plays a critical part in identifying those barriers and activating the right supports. As a Nurse Practitioner on this team, you serve as the clinical gateway to CHW services, helping to improve patient experience, reduce avoidable emergency department use, improve continuity of care, and ensure patients receive the right support at the right time.

What you'll do

  • Conduct telehealth visits (typically 99202/99203 level).
  • Perform comprehensive clinical assessments to identify health needs and social barriers to care.
  • Provide medical clearance and referrals for CHW services if indicated including care coordination and community based support.
  • Develop individualized care plans addressing both clinical needs and social determinants of health factors.
  • Collaborate closely with Community Health Workers to support patient engagement and follow-through.
  • Manage prescription refills and ongoing primary care needs as appropriate.
  • Document visits accurately to meet state, federal, payor and program requirements,
  • Help patients navigate complex healthcare systems and connect to community resources.

Qualifications

  • Active unrestricted Nurse Practitioner license with prescriptive authority.
  • Must be licensed in at least one of the following states: AZ, CA, HI, MI, AK, LA, NM or NY. Multistate compact licensure strongly preferred.
  • Primary care, urgent care, behavioral health or chronic disease management experience preferred, telehealth experience a plus.
  • Experience working with Medicaid and Medicare populations.
  • Strong understanding of social determinants of health and their impact on patient outcomes.
  • Comfortable with telehealth platforms and building rapport virtually.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to engage patients from diverse backgrounds.
  • Familiarity of state and federal requirements for CHW referrals or a willingness to learn.
  • Spanish or other language fluency strongly preferred

Compensation

  • The hourly rate for this role starts at $80.00.

Compensation Range Disclosure

Pear Suite is a fully remote organization so compensation may be adjusted upward for candidates residing in higher-cost labor markets. These geographic adjustments are not reflected in the posted range.

jobs.excerpt: About Net at Work Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses.
jobs.description:
About Net at Work

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

About this Position

The Consulting Manager - MSP leads the people, client experience, and service delivery operations of Net at Work's Managed Services practice, which provides 24x7 service and support to clients across North America.

Above all, this leader sets the standard for Net at Work's Client Champion value - ensuring the organization understands what matters to clients, anticipates needs, identifies risk early, communicates clearly, and follows through on commitments. Success requires building a high-performing team and operating model that delivers consistently without depending on heroic intervention.

The Consulting Manager oversees day-to-day delivery across Service Desk, NOC, SOC, field services, project execution, and other shared delivery functions. The role leads through team managers and subject matter experts, establishing clear accountability, operating discipline, and visibility while stepping in directly when leadership involvement is needed.

The Consulting Manager partners closely with the Practice Director, who owns commercial practice strategy and P&L. The Consulting Manager is responsible for service execution, managing the operational drivers that influence financial performance and providing timely insight to support decisions. The role also partners across Sales, Client Experience, PMO, Support and other Net at Work practices to create a connected One Net at Work experience for clients.

Job Responsibilities

Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

  • Oversee reliable 24x7 operations across Service Desk, NOC, SOC, field services, project execution, and other Managed Services delivery functions.
  • Ensure performance against established service levels, response and resolution expectations, quality standards, client commitments, and internal operating metrics.
  • Maintain clear operational visibility across ticket volume, backlog, escalation trends, recurring incidents, service quality, utilization, capacity, and other key indicators.
  • Establish effective escalation paths and clear accountability across team leads and delivery teams; step in directly when leadership involvement can change the outcome.
  • Identify patterns behind recurring issues and drive root-cause resolution so the organization continuously improves rather than repeatedly solving the same symptoms.
  • Establish and continuously improve processes, documentation, standards, and operating practices that enable consistent, scalable service delivery.
  • Align staffing and capacity to current and anticipated demand, and champion appropriate use of automation, AI, and integrated technology to improve quality, efficiency, and employee effectiveness.

People Leadership

  • Attract, develop, engage, and retain high-performing Managed Services talent.
  • Set clear performance expectations and create meaningful accountability for client outcomes, service quality, teamwork, and operational discipline.
  • Develop strong team leads and future leaders who can independently run significant portions of the operation.
  • Provide consistent coaching, feedback, and career development; recognize strong performance and reinforce behaviors aligned with Net at Work's values.
  • Address performance gaps early and constructively, taking decisive action when sustained underperformance is not improving.
  • Build succession plans, bench strength, and team capabilities aligned with current and future client needs.
  • Manage utilization, workload, capacity, and resource allocation to support client commitments, employee sustainability, and practice performance.

Commercial & Practice Performance

  • Understand Managed Services economics and actively manage the operational drivers that influence financial performance, including utilization, capacity, resource mix, delivery efficiency, service quality, and agreement performance.
  • Monitor agreement and service performance for trends that create client or financial risk and initiate corrective action early.
  • Partner with the Practice Director on workforce planning, forecasting, resource investments, service offering improvements, and decisions that affect practice performance.
  • Provide timely, accurate visibility into operating metrics, risks, and opportunities; reinforce disciplined time capture, documentation, and other practices needed to manage the business effectively.

One Net at Work Partnership & Growth

  • Partner with the Practice Director to execute Managed Services strategy and priorities, bringing forward operational insight, resource needs, risks, and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Client Experience, Support, PMO, and other practices to establish realistic client expectations, create smooth transitions, and solve needs that cross organizational boundaries.
  • Identify unmet client needs and appropriate expansion opportunities, connect them to the right Net at Work resources, and maintain productive relationships with strategic third-party partners.

Client Experience Leadership

  • Maintain client health, including satisfaction, relationship risk, recurring issues, renewal or retention concerns, and commitments requiring leadership attention.
  • Identify and address deteriorating client health early, creating clear recovery plans and ownership before issues become executive escalations whenever possible.
  • Build trusted relationships with key client stakeholders and executives, engaging personally where leadership involvement can strengthen the relationship or improve an outcome.
  • Ensure strategic client conversations connect service performance to the client's business priorities, technology risks, accomplishments, future needs, and measurable value.
  • Lead significant client escalations through resolution, ensuring clear ownership, credible recovery plans, proactive communication, and consistent follow-through.
  • Use CSAT, NPS, client feedback, service data, and relationship intelligence to identify systemic opportunities to improve the client experience and reinforce a culture of Client Champion behavior.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients view Net at Work as a proactive, trusted partner; satisfaction and retention are strong, and material client risks rarely surprise leadership.
  • Service delivery is predictable and reliable; commitments and service levels are consistently met, escalations are well managed, and recurring issues decline because root causes are addressed.
  • The team is high performing, engaged, and accountable; leaders are being developed, expectations are clear, and workload and capacity are managed sustainably.
  • Client, service, and operational data are used to identify risk early, prioritize action, and drive visible continuous improvement.
  • Utilization, capacity, agreement performance, and delivery efficiency are actively managed in support of the Practice Director's financial objectives.
  • Clients experience One Net at Work through effective collaboration, smooth handoffs, and shared ownership across Managed Services, Sales, Client Experience, PMO, and other practices.

Job Requirements

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in Managed IT Services, or an MSP environment, including meaningful leadership responsibility for service delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading 24x7 managed services operations, including Service Desk, NOC, SOC, or comparable functions of teams over 50 people in multiple remove locations.
  • Proven record of improving client satisfaction, retention, service performance, and/or operational maturity.
  • Experience building and leading teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, resource allocation, and capacity management.
  • Strong business acumen and working knowledge of recurring-services economics, utilization, agreement performance, and delivery efficiency.
  • Strong financial literacy, understanding P&L, and service revenue and team structure optimization for target contribution margins.
  • Executive presence and the ability to lead high-stakes client conversations and escalations with tact, credibility, sound judgment, and clear communication.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use operational data to identify root causes, prioritize improvements, and drive accountability; able to move comfortably between executive-level oversight and hands-on problem solving when needed.
  • Ability to lead across functions and influence without relying on direct authority; strong written and verbal communication skills; willingness to travel periodically as client and business needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience; current industry certifications are a plus.
  • Experience with pre-sales, client technology roadmaps, service catalog development, EOS, and/or automation and AI-enabled service delivery.

Customer Requirements

This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

Core Competencies

  • Client Champion – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
  • Problem Solver – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge-seeker that thrives on a challenge.

jobs.description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About the Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
  • Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
  • Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
  • Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
  • Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage
  • Must possess excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
  • Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing effective coaching and feedback to team members

The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.
